Sun Bane

plugin.target: 發出一顆猶如陽光的球狀體，造成不死者 <mag> 點的損傷。

plugin.source: Fireball
A fiery explosion for <mag> points of damage in a 15 foot radius. Targets on fire take extra damage.
plugin.target: 射出一團火焰並爆炸，會在 15 呎的範圍內造成 <mag> 點傷害。目標著火後加重傷害。

plugin.source: Chain Lightning
Lightning bolt that does <mag> points of shock damage to Health and half to Magicka.
plugin.target: 發出一束閃電，對生命造成 <mag> 點閃電傷害，以及半數的法力傷害。

plugin.source: Ice Storm
A freezing whirlwind that does <mag> points of frost damage per second to Health and Stamina.
plugin.target: 吹出一團極寒旋風，造成每秒 <mag> 點生命和耐力寒霜傷害。

plugin.source: Conjure Gargoyle Sentinel
Summons a Gargoyle Sentinel for <dur> seconds.
plugin.target: 召喚一具石像鬼索敵者，約 <dur> 秒。

plugin.source: Restore Health Area
Heals everyone close to the caster <mag> points.
plugin.target: 治療施法者周圍所有人 <mag> 點。

plugin.source: Armor - Stone
Improves the caster's armor rating by <mag> points for <dur> seconds.
plugin.target: 提升施法者的防禦力 <mag> 點，持續 <dur> 秒。

plugin.source: Sun Fire
Sunlight explosion that does <mag> points of damage in a 15 foot radius.
plugin.target: 陽光爆發造成半徑 15 呎內均受到 <mag> 點傷害。

plugin.source: Elemental Fury
Equipped weapon swings faster for <dur> seconds.
plugin.target: 武器揮動更快，持續 <dur> 秒。

Stamina regenerates <mag>% faster.

plugin.source: Grelka's Satchel
Kaie's Sword of Leeching
Kaie's Sword of Harvesting
Dunore
Bandit
Nubaree
Razita
Saryn
Lorion
Kaie
Imperial
Breton
Gargoyle Sentinel
Noble
Noble
Fort Dawnguard
Volkihar Keep
Whiterun Stables
Burguk's Longhouse
Irkngthand Arcanex
The Winking Skeever
Larak's Longhouse
It's... nothing...
For Skyrim!
Die, vampire!
Just... stand still!
This what you want?
Ha! I think you're bleeding!
Weren't expecting that, were you!
Not impressed!
You're nothing!
I'd better get going.
It's been a pleasure.
See you around.
Yeah yeah...
Bye.
I'm not allowed to stand on furniture.
plugin.target: 他們不讓我站在傢俱上。

plugin.source: Watch what you're doing.
Put that down.
Careful with that.
Hmph.
What do you want, little elf?
Speak, elf.
What do you want, cat?
What do you want, lizard?
What do you want, Imperial?
Speak.
Yes, yes. I haven't got all day...
plugin.target: 是啊是啊。一整天都沒啥意思。

plugin.source: Is there... something I can do for you?
Hi there.
What can I do for you?
What do you want?
What are you starin' at?
You want something from me?
Speak quickly.
Make it quick.
Yeah? What?
Good afternoon.
Good evening.
Khajiit.
Breton.
Imperial.
Redguard.
Nord.
Argonian.
Never should have come here...
It's a shame, isn't it?
Welcome, child.
Collect the Rueful Axe from Rimerock Burrow, and I believe we'll have a deal.
plugin.target: 去霧淞岩地洞那裡把悔恨之斧拿回來。然後我們可以好好談談。

plugin.source: What do you need, guardian?
Yes, champion of Azura?
The Twilight watches us all, guardian.
plugin.target: 暮光女士正在望著我們，守護者。

plugin.source: You want to talk to me? After everything you've done?
plugin.target: 在做了這些事情之後，你還想和我說話嗎？

plugin.source: Divines smile on you, friend.
I hope the wilds claim you, one of these days.
plugin.target: 總有一天你會暴屍荒野的。

plugin.source: What do you need, my friend?
I've had just about all I'm willing to take from you. What is it?
plugin.target: 我和你已經沒什麼話可以談了。你還有什麼事嗎？

plugin.source: You and me, we're the only people around who aren't complete fools.
plugin.target: 你和我。我們是這地方唯一還帶點理智的人了。

plugin.source: Now why would I want to talk to you?
plugin.target: 那我為什麼要和你說話？

plugin.source: Friends like you are hard to find and very valuable to me.
plugin.target: 想你這樣的朋友不好找，對我來說也非常珍貴。

plugin.source: Something you need, you miserable wretch?
Good to see you. Finally someone useful is around.
plugin.target: 很高興見到你。終於見到一個有用點的人了。

plugin.source: I don't like talking to someone who holds their honor so cheaply.
plugin.target: 我不和寡廉鮮恥的人說話。

plugin.source: Good to have you by my side, friend. I need reliable people around.
plugin.target: 很高興有你支持我，朋友。我身邊需要可靠的人。

plugin.source: You have something to say, dog? Something on your mind?
plugin.target: 你有什麼話要說嗎，走狗？你到底在打什麼主意？

plugin.source: You're someone who can get things done. I like that.
plugin.target: 你是那種能辦得成事情的人。我喜歡。

plugin.source: I should bash your face in after all you've done.
plugin.target: 我應該為你的所做所為扇你幾個巴掌。

plugin.source: You've been a good friend to me. That means something.
plugin.target: 你是我的好朋友，我不會虧待你的。

plugin.source: What do you want? You've caused enough trouble.
plugin.target: 你想要什麼？你惹的麻煩已經夠多了。

plugin.source: Good to see you again, friend.
You. What do you want?
Now here's a man I'm glad to see.
Now here's a woman I'm glad to see.
You! You're gonna hurt me again aren't you? Just stay away.
plugin.target: 你！你又想來傷害我嗎？離我遠點行嗎？

plugin.source: It's so good to see you again.
I don't mean you any trouble. Just leave me alone.
plugin.target: 我不想和你惹麻煩。離我遠點。

plugin.source: Divines bless you. May the ground you walk quake as you pass.
plugin.target: 諸神賜福你。願你的步伐震天撼地。

plugin.source: Gods strike you down.
My favorite drinking buddy. Let's get some mead.
plugin.target: 我最棒的酒友啊，我們去弄點喝的吧。

plugin.source: Just looking at you makes me upset.
plugin.target: 光是看到你就讓我覺得噁心。

plugin.source: Good to see Skyrim still has such fine people. You give an old man hope.
plugin.target: 真高興天霜還能有你這麼友善的人。我這個老頭覺得有點希望了。

plugin.source: You're just rotten. No good.
plugin.target: 你真是一塊爛肉。沒用的傢伙。

plugin.source: I hope your parents are proud of you. They have a lot of reason to be.
plugin.target: 希望你的父母以你為榮。他們一定會的。

plugin.source: Leave me alone. Can't an old man have some peace?
plugin.target: 離我遠點。就不能讓我這老頭子一個人靜一靜嗎？

plugin.source: You're not as dumb as you look.
plugin.target: 你比你看起來聰明多了。

plugin.source: Here to shame an old woman? Leave me be.
plugin.target: 想找我這個老太婆的麻煩嗎？離我遠點。

plugin.source: Well, look at you. If only everyone acted like you did.
plugin.target: 哦，你真是太棒了。真希望每個人都能像你一樣。

plugin.source: You. Every time I look at you my blood boils.
plugin.target: 是你。每次看到你我的血液都快要沸騰了。

plugin.source: It's a fine day with you around.
You're nothing but trouble.
Good day, friend! Keeping well?
Worthless. Everyone like you is completely worthless.
plugin.target: 真沒用。像你這樣的人存在著一點價值都沒有。

plugin.source: Good to see you. At least you know how to treat someone properly.
plugin.target: 很高興見到你。至少你懂得如何待人接物。

plugin.source: Every time I think of you, I imagine a saber cat closing its claws around your face.
plugin.target: 每次看到你，我都想讓一隻劍齒虎在你臉上劃幾道。

plugin.source: It's so good to see you again.
You're mean. I hate you. I hate you forever and ever and ever.
plugin.target: 你真小氣。我恨你。我會永遠永遠記恨你的。

plugin.source: You're the best! Can you be my father?
plugin.target: 你真是太棒了！你能做我的爸爸嗎？

plugin.source: You're the best! Can you be my mother?
plugin.target: 你真是太棒了！你能做我的媽媽嗎？

plugin.source: I hope monsters come and eat you.
I bet you could slay one of those mean old dragons. I bet you could do anything.
plugin.target: 我打賭你一定能殺掉那些可怕的巨龍。我想你什麼事都能辦得到。

plugin.source: The gods know what you've done.
plugin.target: 諸神會知道你的所作所為。

plugin.source: A fine day to you, friend. May you die with a sword in your hands.
plugin.target: 你好啊，朋友。願你在戰鬥中光榮地死去。

plugin.source: What do you want, milk drinker?
plugin.target: 你想幹什麼？乳臭未乾的傢伙。

plugin.source: May the gods watch over your battles, friend.
plugin.target: 願諸神在你戰鬥時注視著你，朋友。

plugin.source: Absolutely no time to deal with lowlifes these days. Go away.
plugin.target: 我沒空和你們這些下等人說話。走開。

plugin.source: Oh, it's you. I was wondering why I was smelling something unpleasant.
plugin.target: 哦，是你啊。難怪我怎麼覺得周圍這麼難聞呢。

plugin.source: So nice to have pleasant company for a change.
plugin.target: 能與你有如此愉快的合作，真是一件讓人感到高興的事。

plugin.source: There are so few pleasures in life as fine as your company.
plugin.target: 生活中真的少有能像和你合作這麼愉快的事情了。

plugin.source: There are so many delightful ways I've pictured you dead.
plugin.target: 你要是死了，生活該會變得多麼的美好啊。

plugin.source: We're one of the same kind, you and I. I'm glad to have met you.
plugin.target: 你和我，我們是同一類人。很高興能認識你。

plugin.source: Azura's wisdom to you, friend.
plugin.target: 願阿祖拉的智慧指引你，我的朋友。

plugin.source: Filth. Run to the horizon before I hunt you down.
plugin.target: 賤人。在我發作之前給我消失。

plugin.source: What do you want? Aren't your hands coated with enough blood?
plugin.target: 你還想要什麼？你手上的鮮血還不夠多嗎？

plugin.source: May your next fight bring you victory, friend.
plugin.target: 祝你在下次戰鬥中取得勝利，我的朋友。

plugin.source: For your crimes, may Malacath boil your blood and grind your bones.
plugin.target: 就憑你的所作所為，真希望瑪拉凱斯把你撕成碎片。

plugin.source: May your weapons be sharp and your prey fresh.
plugin.target: 願你的武器永葆鋒利，你的敵人無處可逃。

plugin.source: Khajiit wishes for you to go away. You have done us too much harm.
plugin.target: 凱季特人希望你離遠點。你已經給大家造成太多傷害了。

plugin.source: These sands are cold, but Khajiit feels warmness from your presence.
plugin.target: 雖然外面很冷，但是有了你的出現，凱季特人心裡依然覺得很暖和。

plugin.source: Its scent is foul, unclean. Hurtful.
plugin.target: 一聞就知道你愚蠢、噁心而又是全民公害。

plugin.source: Speak. Khajiit will listen until all the sugars in the world turn sour.
plugin.target: 說吧。凱季特人就算到了世界末日也會耐心聽你說完的。

plugin.source: It fills us with rage. What harm does it bring to us now?
plugin.target: 我們之間只有仇恨。你還想怎麼樣？

plugin.source: Ours is to smile at your passing, friend.
plugin.target: 我們為你的到來感到高興，朋友。

plugin.source: It annoys us. What does it want to take from us now?
plugin.target: 真討厭。你又想要做什麼？

plugin.source: It is our most favored company.
plugin.target: 這是我們最歡迎的朋友。

plugin.source: Hello, my friend? What can I do for you on such a fine day?
plugin.target: 你好啊，我的朋友？今天我能為你做些什麼？

plugin.source: Such a fine day, smell the air! Isn't it wonderful?
plugin.target: 美好的一天啊，聞聞空氣中的味道！這一切不是很美好嗎？

plugin.source: You look like you've seen your share of adventure.
plugin.target: 看起來你的冒險經歷也相當豐富了。

plugin.source: It's no easy thing to make a living in the wilds of Skyrim.
plugin.target: 要在天霜的荒野生存下去可真不容易。

plugin.source: You hear all this talk about a war? I hope it never comes here.
plugin.target: 你聽說過戰爭的事情了嗎？希望不要波及到這裡。

plugin.source: Seen some mean-spirited folk pass through lately. Thought I was rid of those sorts when I left Markarth.
plugin.target: 最近有一些卑鄙的傢伙經過。我還以為離開馬卡斯城就可以遠離這些人了呢。

plugin.source: I'm hoping to run my own inn someday.
plugin.target: 我希望有一天我自己也能開一家旅店。

plugin.source: Faida's teaching me the innkeeper's trade. She runs the Four Shields.
plugin.target: 菲達教我如何當一個旅店老闆。她是四盾牌的老闆。

plugin.source: First the war and now there's talk of dragons. What's next?
plugin.target: 先是戰爭，然後又是巨龍的傳言。誰知道下一次會是什麼東西？

plugin.source: Working hard gives a man reason for drinking hard! Well, that and putting up with a wife like mine.
plugin.target: 勞累的工作實在是豪飲的最佳理由了！何況，我還有這麼一個老婆。

plugin.source: You're a well-traveled sort, I can tell just looking at you.
plugin.target: 你肯定去過不少地方，我從你的外表能夠看出來。

plugin.source: You been to Markarth? They've got a tavern called the Silver-Blood Inn. Best ale this side of Skyrim.
plugin.target: 你去過馬卡斯城嗎？那裡有一家酒館叫做銀血旅店，裡面有全天霜最棒的麥芽酒。

plugin.source: Money's been tight since the mill burned down. My wife won't let me forget it.
plugin.target: 自從鋸木廠關門以來手頭就一直很緊。我老婆總是不停地嘮叨。

plugin.source: They say a strong drink, a sharp axe and a good woman are all a Nord needs to be happy. Two out of three's not bad.
plugin.target: 人們常說一個快樂的諾德人要有好酒量、鋒利的斧頭和一個好老婆。三樣當中我已經有了兩樣，也還不賴。

plugin.source: Rest a spell! Can't work every minute of your life.
plugin.target: 休息會兒吧！你總不能每時每刻都在工作吧。

plugin.source: Got nothing to say to strange folk.
plugin.target: 我和陌生人沒什麼可談的。

plugin.source: Faida's the name. I keep the inn.
plugin.target: 我是菲達。我是這個旅店的老闆。

plugin.source: Something different about you, I can tell. Hope you ain't here to cause trouble.
plugin.target: 我能察覺得到你有與眾不同的地方。希望你不是來惹麻煩的。

plugin.source: The meals I serve ain't what I'd call a Jarl's feast, but they'll fill your belly.
plugin.target: 我這裡的飯菜雖然談不上山珍海味，不過填飽肚子是絕對沒問題的。

plugin.source: You met the Lylvieves? Quiet family, but they're the heart of Dragon Bridge.
plugin.target: 你見過李維弗斯了嗎？這個家族可真是的，不過他們畢竟是龍橋鎮的核心。

plugin.source: I think the dragons are here to test us, and make sure we're still true Nords.
plugin.target: 我認為巨龍是來考驗我們的，看看我們還算不算是真正的諾德人。

plugin.source: I was a barmaid at the Winking Skeever when I met my husband, rest his soul. Wasn't for him, I'd still be working there!
plugin.target: 我遇到我丈夫的時候還在眨眼雪鼠做女侍呢。願他的靈魂安息。要不是他的話我搞不好還在那裡工作呢！

plugin.source: Mind you don't cross Tasius. He's in charge around here.
plugin.target: 希望你別惹到塔西留斯。他是這一帶的負責人。

plugin.source: Don't start any trouble and I think we'll get along just fine.
At least, if you're gonna cause trouble, go somewhere else, okay? Please?
plugin.target: 如果你想惹麻煩的話請到別處去，好嗎？拜託？

plugin.source: Are you a mercenary? You won't find much work here.
plugin.target: 你是傭兵嗎？這裡沒你可做的工作。

plugin.source: I have a message from Brynjolf.
plugin.target: 我這裡有布林喬夫的口信。

plugin.source: I knew when we were married, this would come between us one day. I don't want to lose what we have, so I'll pay him gladly.
plugin.target: 當初我們結婚的時候我就想好了，總有一天我們得面對這一切的。我不想放棄我們現在的關係，所以我願意付錢。

plugin.source: Darling, Brynjolf sent me. We both know what that means.
plugin.target: 親愛的，布林喬夫派我來的。我們都知道這是什麼意思。

plugin.source: I have a message from Brynjolf.
plugin.target: 我這裡有布林喬夫的口信。

plugin.source: Then I thank you for showing me mercy. Here, take this coin to him. If it keeps us together, it's worth its weight.
plugin.target: 很感謝你能饒了我。來，把這些錢給他。無論我們情誼長存與否，這都是值得的。

plugin.source: Darling, Brynjolf sent me. We both know what that means.
plugin.target: 親愛的，布林喬夫派我來的。我們都知道這是什麼意思。

plugin.source: I should never have come to Markarth.
plugin.target: 我真的不該來馬卡斯城的。

plugin.source: Unless you're here to solve this nightmare problem, I don't need you.
plugin.target: 我們之間沒什麼可說的，除非你是來解決這場夢魘的。

plugin.source: The Jarl is... tired. Be mindful of that.
By the Divines, I'm tired.
I'm not going to warn you again.
Once more and I'm going to have to kill you.
plugin.target: 要是再來我就只能殺了你了。

plugin.source: Don't do that again. Last warning.
plugin.target: 別再來了。最後一次警告。

plugin.source: You're pushing your luck.
What's the matter with you?
Stop that.
Watch it!
Hey, be careful!
I'm on your side!
What are you doing?
I'll wait here.
I'm ready, let's continue.
All set, let's go.
Lead on, friend.
Take my advice. Never gamble. Damn Irnskar has me in debt up to the eyes.
plugin.target: 聽我的，別賭博。可惡的艾恩斯卡讓我輸的傾家蕩產。

plugin.source: Life's hard enough with all these men propositioning me. But that bard is the worst.
plugin.target: 身邊圍繞著一堆蒼蠅就夠討厭了。想不到那個吟遊詩人更煩人。

plugin.source: We're used to getting by on scraps, but the Shatter-Shields want everything for nothing.
plugin.target: 我們已經習慣了微薄薪水，但碎盾卻連一塊錢都不想給。

plugin.source: Poor Roggi. If you're feeling charitable, buy the Nord a mead. He's good for it.
plugin.target: 可憐的羅吉。如果你是好心人，給那個諾德人買杯蜂蜜酒吧。他很需要。

plugin.source: Ranmir beg a drink from you, yet? That's gold wasted, friend.
plugin.target: 蘭米爾有向你討酒喝嗎？那只是浪費錢，朋友。

plugin.source: No. Never mind.
Very well.
All right.
Yes. Let me show you.
Right.
Do you still need me for something?
So, did you still need my assistance?
I need you to do something.
J'zargo is listening.
Anything, as long as I get to fight.
plugin.target: 沒問題，只要有架給我打就行。

plugin.source: Name it.
What do you need?
All right. What is it?
What do you need?
Go ahead. What is it?
What is it?
Fine. What?
Yes, Thane. What is it?
As you command.
I'm sorry, but I'm not going to do something like that. Even for you.
plugin.target: 我很抱歉，但是我不會去做那種事，就算是為了你也不成。

plugin.source: Anything else before you go?
I'm sorry, that can't be done.
No problem, I'll handle it.
Yes, my Thane?
Did you need something?
Do you hunt? The plains outside Whiterun are ripe with game.
plugin.target: 你打獵嗎？白漫城外面的平原可是打獵的個好地方。

plugin.source: Oh! You startled me. I wasn't expecting company out here.
plugin.target: 哦！你嚇到我了。我沒想到在這也會有人。

plugin.source: Shhh. You'll scare the deer.
You look rather pale. Could be Ataxia. It's quite a problem back home in Cyrodiil.
plugin.target: 你看起來臉色真蒼白。可能是運動失調症的緣故。如果在希羅帝爾的話這會是個大麻煩。

plugin.source: Welcome to Belethor's General Goods. Welcome, indeed.
plugin.target: 歡迎來到貝萊托爾的雜貨鋪。非常歡迎。

plugin.source: I might just be a servant among lords, but don't think for a moment I don't take my duties as seriously as the Jarl himself takes his!
plugin.target: 我可能只是貴族們的一個僕人而已，但是你必須清楚我和領主本人一樣盡忠職守！

plugin.source: If my cleanin' gets in your way, just say the word an' I'll be off.
plugin.target: 如果我打掃衛生妨礙到你的話，告訴我一聲我就會馬上離開。

plugin.source: This here is Dragonsreach, an' it's my task to see it looks fit for a Jarl, night an' day.
plugin.target: 這是龍臨堡，我的工作就是要讓它隨時隨地的符合領主的身分。

plugin.source: Ain't nobody high and mighty in these halls, exceptin' the Jarl. And don't you forget!
plugin.target: 在這些大廳中不是所有人都高大有力，除了領主。你可不要忘了這一點！

plugin.source: Don't you go trackin' your dirty boots on my clean floor!
plugin.target: 別在我乾淨的地板上留下你骯髒的腳印！

plugin.source: Soldiers! They're everywhere these days. And not a one of them knows how to pick up after themselves.
plugin.target: 那些臭士兵！這陣子他們到處都是，而且沒一個人知道要善後。

plugin.source: My poor Fralia thinks Thorald's still alive, but I know better.
plugin.target: 我可憐的法利亞認為索拉德還活著，其實我心知肚明。

plugin.source: We Gray-Manes got just as much to be proud of as them Battle-Borns, but you won't see us with our noses in the air.
plugin.target: 我們灰鬃氏族和他們戰狂氏族同樣驕傲，但是我們不像他們那樣目中無人。

plugin.source: Bits and baubles for sale, all crafted by the best blacksmith in Skyrim.
plugin.target: 販售馬銜和各類小玩意兒，全出自天霜最好的鍛匠之手。

plugin.source: Shiny trinkets for your good lady! All crafted by the great Eorlund Gray-Mane himself!
plugin.target: 閃亮的首飾，專為您的佳人所準備！全部出自偉大的厄倫德·灰鬃之手！

plugin.source: My Eorlund is the finest blacksmith in Skyrim, and that's not just a wife's boasting.
plugin.target: 我的厄倫德是天霜最優秀的鍛匠，這可不是身為妻子的自誇喔。

plugin.source: I enjoy this work well enough, but I'm ready to retire. I've been thinking of selling the inn to Ysolda. Anyway, what do you need?
plugin.target: 我很喜歡這個工作，但是我準備好退休了。我一直在考慮把酒館賣給伊索爾達。算了，你想要點什麼？

plugin.source: I'm just out and about. The Bannered Mare can do without me for a bit, I suspect.
plugin.target: 我要出去走走了，親愛的。敕旗母馬旅店沒有我也可以，我想應該是這樣的。

plugin.source: If it's work you're looking for, Hulda's the one to talk to.
plugin.target: 你如果在找工作的話，去找胡爾妲談談吧。

plugin.source: If you need more food or drink, speak to Hulda.
plugin.target: 你如果需要更多吃喝話，去找胡爾妲吧。

plugin.source: Oh, I'm a good keeper of secrets. Have to be, in this hall.
plugin.target: 噢，我是個稱職的守密者。在這座大廳下，我必須這麼做。

plugin.source: I hope you're looking at me like that because you want to buy something?
plugin.target: 我希望你那樣看著我是因為你想買點什麼？

plugin.source: I spend a lot of time at the market stalls so I can learn the merchant's trade.  I need more experience if I'm going to run an inn someday.
plugin.target: 我在市場花了很多時間才學到了經商之道。但為了要在哪天能夠經營旅店，我還需要更多的經驗。

plugin.source: Nothing like a good adventure or romance to lose yourself in.
plugin.target: 沒有什麼比一段傳奇的冒險或者浪漫的愛情更能讓你投身的了。

plugin.source: I import books whenever I can. Most Nord works are too bawdy and violent for my tastes.
plugin.target: 只要我可以的時候我就進口一些書籍。大多數諾德人的工作對我來說都太下流太暴力了。

plugin.source: You're in my home. That's right. This here place, Breezehome, it belongs to old Terek.
plugin.target: 你在我家裡。對。就是這個地方，微風閣，它屬於老特理克。

plugin.source: Looking for a horse? I own these stables, but Skulvar can help you with a purchase.
plugin.target: 想買匹馬嗎？這間馬廄雖然是我的，但要買馬的話就去找斯庫瓦吧。

plugin.source: Do you like horses? You should visit the stables. I own them, you see. And our stock is excellent.
plugin.target: 你喜歡馬嗎？你應該去參觀白漫馬廄。正如你所知，我是那的主人。而且我們的馬匹很優秀。

plugin.source: Do you get to the Cloud District very often? Oh, what am I saying - of course you don't.
plugin.target: 你常去雲頂區嗎？哦，我在說什麼呀——你當然不常去啦。

plugin.source: I own the Pelagia Farm, just outside the city walls. Nimriel takes good care of things for me.
plugin.target: 我擁有佩拉吉烏斯農場，就在城牆外面。尼姆瑞爾替我打理。

plugin.source: Got some good pieces out here, if you're looking to buy. More inside.
plugin.target: 外面有一些不錯的，如果你想買的話。裡面還有更多。

plugin.source: The task of Steward is more important than you realize. The Jarl often asks for my invaluable council.
plugin.target: 總管的工作比你意識到的更加重要。領主總問我一些沒價值的建議。

plugin.source: I'm kept so busy, I don't get to see my daughter as often as I'd like. Perhaps you've met her? Adrianne? She owns the shop, Warmaiden's.
plugin.target: 我一直非常忙，沒辦法經常去看我女兒。或許你曾經見過她？阿德琳妮聽過嗎？她開了一家叫做「戰少女」的店。

plugin.source: You should be talking to my Steward.
plugin.target: 你應該和我的總管說話。

plugin.source: I'm the commander of the guard here in Whiterun.
plugin.target: 我是白漫的衛兵指揮官。

plugin.source: Need a horse? Talk to my father, Skulvar.
plugin.target: 需要匹馬？去跟我父親談，斯庫瓦。

plugin.source: Old lady Maiden-Loom owns the stables. But my father and me, we run things.
plugin.target: 年長的女織女士是這座馬廄的主人。但由我父親和我負責打理一切。

plugin.source: So I mostly sweep and shovel. You got a problem with that?
plugin.target: 所以我主要做些清掃工作。你有問題嗎？

plugin.source: Ready to get moving?
So, what's the plan?
We heading out?
We going?
Ready to get going?
You are ready to move, yes?
We are leaving?
Waiting.
Still standing here.
Mara protect us both.
I'm itching for a fight.
I'm right behind you.
Still here.
I've got your back.
Ours is to follow, friend.
Khajiit guards your back.
plugin.target: 凱季特人會守護你的背後。

plugin.source: An Orc follows to the death.
We've stopped. What is it?
plugin.target: 我們停下來了。怎麼回事？

plugin.source: I'm still here.
Let's get going.
Help! Murder!
What the...?!
Help, someone!
Murdered! In cold blood!
Ysmir's beard!
By the gods, did that really just happen?!
Murder! Murder!
Help! Somebody, help!
Put that down, you mangy cat!
plugin.target: 給我放下，你這骯髒的貓人！

plugin.source: You thieving little elf!
You dirty, filching lizard!
plugin.target: 你這個骯髒的蜥蜴臭賊！

plugin.source: I find your wolfish grin... unsettling.
plugin.target: 我發現你有種狼一般的笑容……令人不安。

plugin.source: Have a look around. I buy and sell just about anything.
plugin.target: 隨意看看吧，我這裡幾乎什麼都交易。

plugin.source: I'm always happy to see a customer, but I won't deal in stolen goods. That's trouble I don't need.
plugin.target: 歡迎你的光臨，不過這裡從來不賣贓物，我可不想惹上麻煩。

plugin.source: Make yourself at home, please. Let me know if I can be of any assistance.
plugin.target: 請自便，需要幫忙務必告訴我。

plugin.source: Spare a coin for a poor old woman?
plugin.target: 施捨我這老太婆一枚硬幣吧。

plugin.source: A few septims for my supper is all I ask.
plugin.target: 我只要幾枚賽普汀吃頓晚飯而已。

plugin.source: I ask only for a little charity.
Will you spare a few coins to help someone who's got nothing?
plugin.target: 你願意幫幫我這個一無所有的人嗎？

plugin.source: I ain't askin' for much, just a few septims.
plugin.target: 我要得不多，就幾枚賽普汀幣。

plugin.source: The Divines smile on those who show mercy an' charity.
plugin.target: 聖靈總會贊許那些仁愛寬容的人。

plugin.source: A few septims ain't nothing. You can spare that, can't you?
plugin.target: 幾枚賽普汀幣應該枚什麼，你一定拿得出，對吧？

plugin.source: Feast your eyes on my strange and wondrous collection of curiosities.
plugin.target: 看看我收集的奇珍異寶，大開眼界吧。

plugin.source: For a few septims, I'll give you a brief tour that includes some of my most unusual items.
plugin.target: 只要幾枚賽普汀幣，我就會帶領你參觀一趟，包括我最神奇的幾件東西。

plugin.source: The objects you see here might look mundane at first glance, but I assure you, behind each is an unusual tale.
plugin.target: 這些東西也許一眼看起來平凡無奇，但是我向你保證，每一件的背後都有一段傳奇的故事。

plugin.source: What were you arguing about?
plugin.target: 你們之前在爭吵什麼呢？

plugin.source: What are you arguing about?
Morthal doesn't need any trouble. You keep your nose clean, understand?
plugin.target: 墨索爾城不需要麻煩。你還是先看好你自己吧，明白？

plugin.source: I'm just here to protect the Jarl, not to chat.
plugin.target: 我在這是為了保護領主，而不是聊天。

plugin.source: Morthal has enough problems without you bothering me.
plugin.target: 就算你不打擾我，墨索爾城的麻煩也夠多了。

plugin.source: I'm under a lot of pressure. If you don't leave me alone, I won't be held responsible.
plugin.target: 我承受著很大的壓力。如果你不能讓我自己待會的話，我就不能盡職了。

plugin.source: Well, aren't you the handsome one. You and I should spend some time together.
plugin.target: 啊，帥哥，我們找點樂子吧。

plugin.source: Well, aren't you the pretty one. I bet all the men chase after you.
plugin.target: 嗯，你是個美女哦，有不少男性追求者吧。

plugin.source: Seems there's no end to the needs of the Imperials. But what can I help you with?
plugin.target: 似乎帝國人的需求好像無窮無盡啊，但是我能做點什麼呢？

plugin.source: When the Stormcloaks took Solitude, I thought for sure things would slow down. But they keep me just as busy as the Imperials.
plugin.target: 當風暴斗篷佔據獨孤城的時候我以為我不會再那麼忙了，但是他們和帝國人一樣讓我很忙。

plugin.source: I got some fine armor, if you're lookin'.
plugin.target: 我有一些護甲，想看看你喜不喜歡。

plugin.source: Need a weapon? Hmmm... By the looks of ya, yeah... Think I've got somethin' you can use.
plugin.target: 需要武器？嗯……看你的樣子……我想想有什麼適合你的。

plugin.source: Ahh... It's good to be away from the forge for a bit.
plugin.target: 啊……你最好離鍛爐遠一點。

plugin.source: Good evening. I'm Pantea Ateia, the Master Vocalist.
plugin.target: 晚安，我是潘提亞·阿提亞，著名歌手。

plugin.source: You're new here, right? Welcome to the Bards College. It's like a... a musical museum.
plugin.target: 你是新來的，對吧？歡迎來到詩人學院。這裡就像……一個音樂博物館。

plugin.source: Hello. I'm Gisli. But you can just call me Erikur's sister. Everyone does.
plugin.target: 你好，我是吉斯莉。你只要叫我艾瑞庫爾的妹妹就行了，大家都這麼叫。

plugin.source: Quickly, if you please. I'm quite busy running errands for my bastard of a brother...
plugin.target: 拜託你快點，我正忙著幫我哥家的小雜種跑腿兒呢……

plugin.source: You get around, right? If you come across any Stormcloaks... gut one for me, huh? They did the same to my brother in Whiterun.
plugin.target: 你要去走走，對嗎？如果見到風暴斗篷……給我來一件。他們在白漫給我哥弄了一件。

plugin.source: You don't look so tough. I'll bet I could take you.
plugin.target: 你看起來不怎麼強。我打賭我能撂倒你。

plugin.source: Don't take offense to the nicknames, morsel. I'm a werewolf. Hard not to think of you as a snack.
plugin.target: 別為外號生氣，小點心。我是狼人，很難不把你看成食物。

plugin.source: I'm going to find whoever did this.
plugin.target: 不管是誰做的我都會把他揪出來。

plugin.source: Kynareth preserve us.
Better this one than me.
Agh! Dead body!
Poor bastard's better off.
What a waste.
Another corpse for the pile.
Such a shame.
Damn shame.
Dead? Oh my goodness!
Shouldn't leave things around to trip over...
plugin.target: 不該留下這些礙腳的東西……

plugin.source: Oh my word, this is terrible.
Agh! Who did this?
Another poor soul lost.
plugin.target: 又一個可憐人丟了性命。

plugin.source: Dead? How did this happen?
Oh... what happened?
My father Kleppr is the one you want to talk to. I just clean up.
plugin.target: 你們應該和我父親克萊珀談談。我只負責打掃。

plugin.source: Out of my way, kinsman.
Out of my way, outsider.
My father is more generous than he lets on. Gives me plenty of spending money.
plugin.target: 我父親比他看起來要慷慨很多。給我不少零用錢。

plugin.source: They don't like us talking to people when we work.
plugin.target: 他們不喜歡我們在工作的時候還跟別人說話。

plugin.source: Busy with the smelter.
Got metal to shape.
Can't talk. Mulush will beat me if I stop working.
plugin.target: 不要跟我說話。我要是停下手邊工作，穆魯什會揍我的。

plugin.source: I spill just a bit of metal, and Mulush takes it out of my hide.
plugin.target: 我只要灑出一點金屬屑來，穆魯什就會來懲罰我。

plugin.source: Can't you see I'm working? Beat it.
plugin.target: 沒看見我在工作嗎？走開。

plugin.source: You need a sword? Uh, how about a small sword? Nail-sized?
plugin.target: 要把劍嗎？小一點的怎麼樣？釘子大的？

plugin.source: I have to work, or Anton will rip my head off.
plugin.target: 我得工作，否則安東會把我的頭擰下來的。

plugin.source: It's been a hard day cleaning. Good, honest work I say.
plugin.target: 今天打掃的真是辛苦。我得說打掃的不錯，也很用心。

plugin.source: By Shor, you're hauling around a lot of junk. Best stop in at the Arnleif and Sons Trading Company, sell it off.
plugin.target: 朔爾啊，你拖著這堆垃圾做什麼。還是去「阿雷夫父子商行」把它們賣了吧。

plugin.source: Every night, I walk around the Gray Quarter and let them gray-skins know what I think of 'em.
plugin.target: 每晚我都在灰色居住區走走，讓他們知道我有多麼看不起他們。

plugin.source: Did you know that candle on the mantle hasn't gone out in over a hundred years?
plugin.target: 你知不知道那斗篷上的蠟燭一百多年都沒熄滅過？

plugin.source: I made my fortune as a sea captain, but now I'm retired.
plugin.target: 作為船長，我獲得了許多財富，但現在我退休了。

plugin.source: The townsfolk call me "captain" because I used to be a sailor.
plugin.target: 鎮上的人叫我「船長」，因為我曾經是個水手。

plugin.source: The milk drinkers in this town wouldn't last five minutes in a real battle.
plugin.target: 一打起仗來，城裡的懦夫們撐不了五分鐘。

plugin.source: I own Hollyfrost Farm outside the city. It's honest work, if a bit dull.
plugin.target: 我是城外冬青霜農場的主人。這是份腳踏實地的工作，儘管可能有些無趣。

plugin.source: Pantea, perhaps you should attend to your students, and leave the politics to me.
plugin.target: 潘提亞，也許你該去跟你的學生在一起，把政事留給我。

plugin.source: That is precisely why we remain neutral. Ours is to tell tales of empires, not to make or break them.
plugin.target: 這恰恰是我們保持中立的原因。我們該做的是講述帝國的傳說，而不是捏造或者掩蓋它們。

plugin.source: Aia, please be quiet. Viarmo and I are discussing matters of national politics.
plugin.target: 艾雅，請安靜。我和維阿墨在討論國家大事。

plugin.source: Aia, this is a delicate matter. Why don't you review your lessons and be silent for a while.
plugin.target: 艾雅，這是個棘手的問題。你為什麼不複習一下課上講的內容，安靜一會呢。

plugin.source: But I'm sure those Skyrim dogs would stand down if the keepers of the tales showed their patriotism!
plugin.target: 但我敢肯定，如果傳說的捍衛者顯示出他們愛國的決心，那些天霜的走狗會退讓的！

plugin.source: Maybe if we stopped singing about their silly Nord heroes, the rebels would stop making such a fuss!
plugin.target: 說不定我們只要不再歌頌那些傻乎乎的諾德英雄，反叛者就不會來搗亂了！

plugin.source: Lady Ateia, it is the official position of the college to remain neutral in all political affairs. We cannot risk our history by choosing sides.
plugin.target: 阿提亞女士，對外，學院是要在政治上保持中立的。我們不能背叛傳統，比如加入某一陣營。

plugin.source: Now, now, our duty is to record the great tales of history, not to pick sides in them. Best to stay out of the warfare, I feel.
plugin.target: 現在，現在，我們的任務是記錄好重大的歷史事件，而不是從中選擇陣營。我覺得應該保持旁觀者的態度。

plugin.source: Viarmo, the college really must take a stand on the war!
plugin.target: 維阿墨，學院必須在戰爭中選擇一個立場了！

plugin.source: Viarmo, don't you think it's time that the Bards College officially declared support for the Empire?
plugin.target: 維阿墨，你不覺得現在是詩人學院正式宣佈支持帝國的好時機嗎？

plugin.source: You can buy me whatever you want!
Oh, yes please!
Come now. You'll want to show up in Sovngarde refreshed. You got an eternity of merrymakin' ahead of you.
plugin.target: 別這樣。你會在沉睡淨土改頭換面，還會永遠在那裡飲酒作樂。

plugin.source: Guess the headsman's been busy with all of your friends. Ha ha ha ha ha!
plugin.target: 大概是因為劊子手一直忙著照顧你的朋友們。哈哈——！

plugin.source: Please, ma'am, I've got nowhere to go...
plugin.target: 拜託了，夫人，我無處可去……

plugin.source: Name's Ennis. If you've got friends who do business in Whiterun, they might know me.
plugin.target: 我叫埃尼斯。如果你有朋友在白漫做生意，他們可能認識我。

plugin.source: If you've got some business in Rorikstead, you should start by speaking to Jouane.
plugin.target: 如果你想在洛利克鎮做生意的話，你得先和喬安內談談。

plugin.source: Sorry, I don't mean to be rude but Jouane's the one who deals with people. I'm afraid I lost my charm years ago.
plugin.target: 對不起，我不想無禮但是喬安內才是和人打交道的。我很久以前就魅力不在了。

plugin.source: Thank you so much for taking care of those thieves. The Riverwood Trader is back to the way it used to be!
plugin.target: 多謝你解決了那幫盜賊。河木鎮貿易商行終於可以照常營業了！

plugin.source: Thanks for bringing the claw back.
It means so much to us to have the claw back where it belongs. Thank you!
plugin.target: 龍爪得以回歸對我們意義重大。謝謝你！

plugin.source: Thanks for bringing the claw back.
You have some nerve coming back here after what you did to Keerava.
plugin.target: 你對基拉瓦作了那些事之後，竟然還有臉回這裡。

plugin.source: Welcome to the Bee and Barb, milord. If I can interest you in one of our special drinks, you let me know.
plugin.target: 歡迎來到「蜂與鉤」，先生。如果您對我們的特色飲料感興趣的話，請告訴我。

plugin.source: Welcome to the Bee and Barb, milady. If I can interest you in one of our special drinks, you let me know.
plugin.target: 歡迎來到「蜂與鉤」，夫人。如果您對我們的特色飲料感興趣的話，請告訴我。

plugin.source: Be brief Imperial, there's only so long I can stand being downwind of your stench.
plugin.target: 有話快說，帝國人。我對你們可沒什麼耐性。

plugin.source: New in town, eh? Here for the fishing I'd guess.
plugin.target: 新來的？我想你是來釣魚的吧。

plugin.source: To Oblivion with all of you! You rich piles of dung walking by us like we're not there! Pretending we don't exist! How dare you!
plugin.target: 去你們的！你們這些有錢的人渣就這樣旁若無人般的走過我們的面前！當我們不存在！你們算什麼！

plugin.source: If it's horses you want, you're talking to the right person.
plugin.target: 如果你想要馬匹，你就找對人了。

plugin.source: If it's horses you want, I'm not sure I can help you. I have too much on my mind as it is.
plugin.target: 如果你是要馬匹的話，我不一定能幫到你。我現在要操心的事情太多了。

plugin.source: If it's horses you want, you'll want to speak to Hofgrir at the stables.
plugin.target: 如果你想要馬匹，去馬廄那裡與霍夫圭爾談談吧。

plugin.source: If it's horses you want, you'll want to speak to Hofgrir. I'm afraid I'm in too much trouble to help you.
plugin.target: 如果你想要馬匹，去馬廄那裡與霍夫圭爾談談吧。我有些棘手的事情要處理，恐怕幫不了你。

plugin.source: Alvor and I, we got a daughter. Little Dorthe.
plugin.target: 阿爾沃和我有一個女兒。小朵西。

plugin.source: He would dote on her so much. Let her work the forge and everything. I miss him so.
plugin.target: 他十分溺愛她。讓他在鍛爐邊玩，什麼都答應她。我很想念他。

plugin.source: My girl likes to work the forge with her papa.
plugin.target: 我女兒喜歡和她爸爸在鍛爐邊工作。

plugin.source: All of that blacksmithing... It's not good for a little girl. Ain't... ladylike.
plugin.target: 那些鍛匠活……並不適合女孩子。很不……淑女。

plugin.source: Dorthe needs to spend more time in the garden. I could use the help.
plugin.target: 朵西最好多幹些農活，我需要幫助。

plugin.source: It don't matter what I grow - my Alvor, he'll eat anything.
plugin.target: 不管我種什麼菜—阿爾沃他什麼都吃。

plugin.source: Maybe I'll do turnips next. Hmmm... Or maybe radishes?
plugin.target: 也許我該種點大頭菜了。嗯……或者是蘿蔔？

plugin.source: New to Riverwood? If you're looking for work, go see Hod at the mill.
plugin.target: 初到河木鎮？要是你在找工作，去鋸木廠找胡德。

plugin.source: I'm composing a new song. A ballad, for Camilla Valerius.
plugin.target: 我在寫一首新歌，獻給凱米拉·瓦勒琉斯的小曲。

plugin.source: Some day Camilla will know my affections. Some day...
plugin.target: 總有一天凱米拉會知道我對她的愛。總有一天……

plugin.source: You met Camilla yet? Wouldn't mind getting my hands on those trunks. He he he he.
plugin.target: 你見過凱米拉嗎？那樹幹（軀幹）摸上去感覺應該不錯。呵呵——。

plugin.source: Riverwood's agreeable enough, I suppose. For a Nord village.
plugin.target: 對於一個諾德村莊來說，河木鎮夠討人喜歡的了。

plugin.source: Maybe you've already met Camilla Valerius?
plugin.target: 也許你已經見過凱米拉·瓦勒琉斯了？

plugin.source: If only Camilla shared my affections. Or even knew about them.
plugin.target: 要是凱米拉也有同感就好，或者也喜歡就更好。

plugin.source: My sister Camilla or I will be happy to help you.
plugin.target: 我妹凱米拉和我都樂意為你服務。

plugin.source: My boy fancies that Camilla Valerius. She'll come around soon enough.
plugin.target: 我兒子迷上了凱米拉。她應該很快就會被追到了吧。

plugin.source: Camilla, I've seen her talking to that Faendal. Filthy elf needs to keep to his own kind...
plugin.target: 凱米拉，我見過她和法恩達爾談話。那骯髒的精靈最好守規矩點……

plugin.source: Skyrim belongs to the Nords!
Your kind has no place here!
You should've stayed in your precious forests, elf!
plugin.target: 你該好好待在你那寶貝樹林裡面的，精靈！

plugin.source: Die, you Orc filth!
I'm gonna wear that tail as a belt!
plugin.target: 我會把那尾巴當成腰帶的！

plugin.source: You'll make a fine rug, cat!
plugin.target: 你會是一面好地毯的，死貓！

plugin.source: You remind me of my cousin's cat. Killed that, too!
plugin.target: 你讓我想起了我表弟的貓，被我弄死了！

plugin.source: Shor have mercy on you!
I'll rip your heart out!
Victory or Sovngarde!
I'll show you what a real Orc can do!
plugin.target: 讓你見識下獸人的強大！

plugin.source: No one bests an Orc!
I'll paint the snow with your blood!
Sovngarde awaits you!
And you thought I was just a pretty face!
plugin.target: 別以為我只是個小白臉。

plugin.source: You dare fight a Dunmer?
Azura curse you!
Nerevar guide me!
Foul blood drinker!
Until next time, guardian.
It's been an honor, guardian.
It's an honor to see you, the keeper of Namira's ring.
plugin.target: 很榮幸見到你，娜米拉指環的守護者。

plugin.source: You're one of Namira's faithful now.
plugin.target: 你現在是娜米拉信任的人了。

plugin.source: Dengeir deserves more respect than his nephew, Jarl Siddgeir, affords him.
plugin.target: 丹格爾應該受到他侄子西德蓋爾領主更多的尊敬。

plugin.source: These graves hold the sons and daughters of Falkreath.
plugin.target: 這些墓裡躺著佛克瑞斯的兒女們。

plugin.source: Show respect while you're here and you and I will be fine.
plugin.target: 在這裡舉止要莊嚴肅穆，這樣你我就能相安無事。

plugin.source: You have the look of a killer.
Someone new, perhaps someone looking for me to mix something up for them?
plugin.target: 新來的，是來找我配藥劑的嗎？

plugin.source: A hearty welcome to Falkreath! All of Skyrim's true sons are welcome here!
plugin.target: 歡迎你來到佛克瑞斯！我們歡迎真正的天霜子民！

plugin.source: Stay out of my way, boot.
I can't believe we let provincials like you wander Skyrim.
plugin.target: 真不敢相信我們讓你這樣的鄉巴佬在天霜四處遊蕩！

plugin.source: Can I get you something?
Shor's bones! A handsome man in Falkreath.
plugin.target: 朔爾之骨！真是佛克瑞斯少有的美男子。

plugin.source: I'm sorry, I should really go now.
I can't really help you, I'm just Dengeir's maid.
plugin.target: 我真的幫不了你，我只是丹格爾的女僕。

plugin.source: My nephew has always been handed things, even the title of Jarl.
plugin.target: 老是有人送我侄子各種東西，甚至是領主的頭銜。

plugin.source: Stendarr protect Falkreath until Skyrim's Sons rise.
plugin.target: 斯丹達爾會保護佛克瑞斯，直到天霜之子崛起那一天。

plugin.source: Yes? What is it that you want?
Bolund speaks much about the war and the Stormcloaks, but he knows who provides.
plugin.target: 博蘭德說了很多關於這場戰爭和風暴斗篷的事，儘管他知道是誰提供的。

plugin.source: Kust is responsible for the cemetery here in Falkreath, I take care of the Shrine.
plugin.target: 管理佛克瑞斯公墓的是卡斯特，我是負責聖壇的。

plugin.source: The number of graves in this cemetery never decreases.
plugin.target: 公墓裡的墓碑從來都是只增不減。

plugin.source: War is not new to Falkreath. You have only to stand in our cemetery to see that.
plugin.target: 戰爭對佛克瑞斯來說並不陌生。你只要到我們的公墓裡看看就能知道。

plugin.source: Dengeir deserves more respect than his nephew, Jarl Siddgeir, affords him.
plugin.target: 丹格爾應該受到他侄子西德蓋爾領主更多的尊敬。

plugin.source: Without birth there is no life, without death there is only stasis. Such is the truth of Arkay.
plugin.target: 沒有分娩就沒有生命，沒有犧牲就沒有進步。這就是阿爾凱的法則。

plugin.source: These graves hold the sons and daughters of Falkreath.
plugin.target: 這些墓裡躺著佛克瑞斯的兒女們。

plugin.source: Show respect while you're here and you and I will be fine.
plugin.target: 在這裡舉止要莊嚴肅穆，這樣你我就能相安無事。

plugin.source: You have the look of a killer.
Arkay helps us find peace with death.
plugin.target: 阿爾凱幫助我們平靜的接受死亡。

plugin.source: Indara and I like to keep to ourselves and run our farm.
plugin.target: 我和因達拉喜歡照料我們的農場並自給自足。

plugin.source: My wife, Indara, has a gift with animals. It makes her a better farmer than anyone I've ever seen.
plugin.target: 我的妻子，因達拉，有飼養動物的天賦。她是我見過的最出色的農民。

plugin.source: Runil has been a true friend to my wife and I in our time of need.
plugin.target: 魯尼爾在我和我妻子需要幫助的時候總是傾力相助。

plugin.source: This war isn't needed. Imperials like my wife can be hard to handle, but we Nords could work with them. I should know.
plugin.target: 這場戰爭毫無意義。雖然像我妻子那樣的帝國人可能不太好相處，但是我們諾德人不該排斥他們。我很清楚這點。

plugin.source: I don't know if the war is Arkay's will or man's, but it's none of my doings.
plugin.target: 我不知道這場戰爭是阿爾凱的旨意還是人的私心，但反正沒我的事。

plugin.source: Falkreath is a hard place and tending a farm here is thankless work.
plugin.target: 在佛克瑞斯這種艱苦的地方開農場是件吃力不討好的事。

plugin.source: Mathies is a kind and wise man. The Nords could use more like him. So could the Imperials.
plugin.target: 瑪西亞斯是個溫和且睿智的人。諾德人應該重用這樣的人。帝國人也是。

plugin.source: How could people see all the graves in Falkreath and still want to make war?
plugin.target: 怎麼會有人看了佛克瑞斯的公墓後還想發動戰爭？

plugin.source: Only a hearty soul travels the road these days.
plugin.target: 現在也只有心靈強健的人才會旅行。

plugin.source: The war bleeds Skyrim. It bleeds her dry and I think none of us are the better for it.
plugin.target: 戰爭使天霜流血。她的鮮血流盡，對所有人來說有害無益。

plugin.source: Men and women join the war, they travel far on these roads to spill each other's blood.
plugin.target: 男女競相從戎，他們長途跋涉只為殺戮對方。

plugin.source: Falkreath's warriors always return, one way or another.
plugin.target: 佛克瑞斯的戰士總會歸鄉，不論生死。

plugin.source: Someone new, perhaps someone looking for me to mix something up for them?
plugin.target: 新來的，是來找我配藥劑的嗎？

plugin.source: If either these Nords or Imperials had some red in their blood this war would be over.
plugin.target: 諾德人和帝國人哪怕有一方有點良知的話這戰爭早就結束了。

plugin.source: Falkreath's warriors always return, one way or another.
plugin.target: 佛克瑞斯的戰士總會歸鄉，不論生死。

plugin.source: Stay out of my way, boot.
I can't believe we let provincials like you wander Skyrim.
plugin.target: 真不敢相信我們讓你這樣的鄉巴佬在天霜四處遊蕩！

plugin.source: That Valga Vinicia is a gossip and a troublemaker.
plugin.target: 瓦爾加·維尼西亞喜歡搬弄是非，惹了不少麻煩。

plugin.source: You'll find my brother Solaf and I are the only true Nords in Falkreath.
plugin.target: 你會發現我和我的兄弟索拉夫是佛克瑞斯僅存的純正諾德人。

plugin.source: Can I get you something?
Don't mind Bolund. He's young and gets riled easily.
plugin.target: 不要介意布倫德的脾氣。他只是有點年輕氣盛。

plugin.source: Looking for something?
What do you need, stranger?
Shor's bones! A handsome man in Falkreath.
plugin.target: 朔爾之骨！真是佛克瑞斯少有的美男子。

plugin.source: You're going to have the men around here wrapped around your finger in no time.
plugin.target: 沒多久就會有很多人來跟你搭訕的。

plugin.source: Anything I can get you?
Can I get you a drink?
Welcome to Dead Man's Drink.
In Falkreath if I don't know it, it's not worth knowing.
plugin.target: 佛克瑞斯的事除了沒必要知道的，我都知道。

plugin.source: I escaped fighting in Cyrodiil only to have it track me down again in Skyrim.
plugin.target: 我躲得了希羅帝爾的戰爭，卻躲不過天霜的。

plugin.source: I'm sorry, I should really go now.
I can't really help you, I'm just Dengeir's maid.
plugin.target: 我真的幫不了你，我只是丹格爾的女僕。

plugin.source: Be mindful. My maid Tekla has been known to pass information to Siddgeir.
plugin.target: 要留心一點。我的女僕苔卡拉一直在給我那自大的侄子西德蓋爾通風報信。

plugin.source: My nephew has always been handed things, even the title of Jarl.
plugin.target: 老是有人送我侄子各種東西，甚至是領主的頭銜。

plugin.source: Stendarr protect Falkreath until Skyrim's Sons rise.
plugin.target: 斯丹達爾會保護佛克瑞斯，直到天霜之子崛起那一天。

plugin.source: Enemies and ears. Both are everywhere.
plugin.target: 敵人和耳目。這兩種人無處不在。

plugin.source: The war has changed Falkreath, even our neighbors can be our enemies.
plugin.target: 戰爭改變了佛克瑞斯，連我們的鄰居都有可能變成我們的敵人。

plugin.source: Nenya's history of service is impeccable. She truly is the Steward of Falkreath.
plugin.target: 南雅一貫盡職盡責。她無愧於佛克瑞斯總管的頭銜。

plugin.source: Falkreath's cemetery reminds each of us that war is not new here.
plugin.target: 佛克瑞斯的公墓時時提醒我們這片土地飽受戰爭之苦。

plugin.source: Being Housecarl of Falkreath is an honor.
plugin.target: 能成為佛克瑞斯的侍衛是一種光榮。

plugin.source: Dengeir was a good Jarl in his day. Even if his day has passed.
plugin.target: 丹格爾曾經是一位好領主。這個事實永遠不會改變。

plugin.source: I'm the Steward here. I serve under Jarl Siddgeir and Jarl Dengeir before him.
plugin.target: 我是這裡的總管。在他之前我曾侍奉西德蓋爾領主和丹格爾領主。

plugin.source: Siddgeir can sometimes act too quickly, but he does listen to Helvard and I.
plugin.target: 西德蓋爾有時候行事太過莽撞，但是他還是很聽我和黑爾沃德的話的。

plugin.source: For Falkreath and I this is just one more war in a long line.
plugin.target: 對我和佛克瑞斯來說這只是在諸多戰爭中又添了一場。

plugin.source: Stand aside. I don't need to speak to you.
plugin.target: 閃開。我不需要和你說話。

plugin.source: Bolund speaks much about the war and the Stormcloaks, but he knows who provides.
plugin.target: 博蘭德說了很多關於這場戰爭和風暴斗篷的事，儘管他知道是誰提供的。

plugin.source: The Stormcloaks want freedom but don't understand its price.
plugin.target: 風暴斗篷想得到自由，但他們不懂得所要付出的代價。

plugin.source: There are opportunities everywhere. Why don't you go find them?
plugin.target: 機會到處都是。你何不去找找呢。

plugin.source: No time, I have business to conduct.
plugin.target: 我沒空，我有生意要照顧。

plugin.source: Unless you intend to bury someone this isn't the place you're looking for, traveler.
plugin.target: 旅行者，除非你想舉行葬禮，否則這裡不是你要找的地方。

plugin.source: Falkreath was once full of wanderers and warriors like yourself. Those were better days.
plugin.target: 佛克瑞斯曾經有很多像你這樣的流浪者和戰士。那是段好日子。

plugin.source: Skyrim's history of war is well documented here in Falkreath's graveyard.
plugin.target: 佛克瑞斯的墓園完整地記載了天霜的戰爭史。

plugin.source: My brother Dengeir can be... difficult. Take his words with a grain of salt.
plugin.target: 我的兄弟丹格爾可能……不太隨和。他說的話你別太往心裡去。

plugin.source: Can I make a request?
Sure, what can I do for you?
plugin.target: 當然，能為您做些什麼嗎？

plugin.source: Sure, what can I do for you?
plugin.target: 當然，能為您做些什麼嗎？

plugin.source: For a generous fellow traveler? But of course. What would you like to hear?
plugin.target: 為一個慷慨的旅人朋友？當然。你想打聽些什麼？

plugin.source: Can I make a request? (25 gold)
plugin.target: 我能點首曲子嗎？（25枚金幣）

plugin.source: Sorry friend, but it looks like you're a bit light in the purse, and the wayward minstrel can't afford to do free performances.
plugin.target: 抱歉朋友，似乎你的錢不太夠呢，那個任性的吟遊詩人可不會免費表演的。

plugin.source: Can I make a request? (25 gold)
plugin.target: 我能點首曲子嗎？（25枚金幣）

plugin.source: Why are you bothering me, kinsman?
The College of Winterhold is an amazing sight. I've never set foot on the grounds, but always wanted to.
plugin.target: 冬駐學院是處神奇之地。我從未踏進那個地方，但我一直渴望。

plugin.source: The Forsworn haven't been kind to Karthwasten. I've heard rumors that they've attacked this place without mercy.
plugin.target: 拒誓者對西卡斯鎮從不友好。有傳聞說他們殘忍地攻擊了此地。

plugin.source: I grew up in the Pale. This land was my home for most of my life... and for a Dunmer, that's quite a statement, I assure you.
plugin.target: 我在蒼原長大。我在這片土地上生活了大半輩子……對於一個丹莫來說，那真的很難得，我向你保證。

plugin.source: We should bow our heads in silent reverence for those who are interred in Falkreath's cemetery.
plugin.target: 我們該為那些埋葬在佛克瑞斯公墓裡的人們低頭默哀。

plugin.source: I've always wanted to make a pilgrimage here to the Temple of Mara. Thank you for bringing me here... you've made me quite happy.
plugin.target: 我一直想從這裡出發去瑪拉神殿朝聖。謝謝你把我帶到了這裡……你讓我很開心。

plugin.source: Watch your step, Markarth has quite a reputation thanks to the Silver-Blood family. I wouldn't advise crossing them.
plugin.target: 小心行事，馬卡斯城的銀血家族惡名昭彰。我可不建議你得罪他們。

plugin.source: What an amazing city. I've actually never managed to visit Whiterun, but I always wanted to.
plugin.target: 多麼神奇的城市。我實際上從未計劃造訪白漫，但我一直渴望。

plugin.source: Windhelm is absolutely freezing. How can these people tolerate it?
plugin.target: 風舵城氣候嚴寒，這裡的人是怎麼忍受得住？

plugin.source: I was a student at the Bards College for a short time... until my affiliation with Vaermina was discovered. I haven't been back to Solitude since.
plugin.target: 我曾在詩人學院學習過一小段時間……直到我和瓦爾迷納的關係被人發現。從那之後我就沒回過獨孤城。

plugin.source: I heard Riften's home to the worst Skyrim has to offer. I hope we don't run into any trouble while we're here.
plugin.target: 我聽說裂谷城是天霜所有苦難的發源地。我希望在這別碰上什麼麻煩。

plugin.source: Her Benevolence has taught me patience and mercy, but these vampires deserve none of it.
plugin.target: 她的善行教會了我耐心與仁慈，但吸血鬼卻不值得憐憫。

plugin.source: A good friend of mine was infected by a vampire long ago. He killed himself rather than change into one of those... things.
plugin.target: 我的一個好朋友很久之前被吸血鬼感染了。他寧願自殺也不願變成那種……東西。

plugin.source: Vampires are utter abominations. We need to do everything in our power to destroy them.
plugin.target: 吸血鬼極其可憎。我們必須盡可能地消滅他們。

plugin.source: Being a priest of Vaermina put me very close to dark sorcery at its worst.
plugin.target: 成為瓦爾迷納的祭司讓我接觸到了最邪惡的黑魔法。

plugin.source: Let's try and stay together, the sorcerers in these places tend to... well, harvest bodies for parts.
plugin.target: 讓我們團結一致，這地方的法師想要……收集有用的肢體。

plugin.source: I've seen my share of black magic; that's all in the past now.
plugin.target: 我發現了我的黑魔法天賦，但那都是往事了。

plugin.source: This place must be cleansed. These draugr were once living beings and they deserve better.
plugin.target: 我們一定要清洗一下這裡。這些屍鬼以前曾經是生物，他們應該受到更好的待遇。

plugin.source: These poor souls... suffering in eternal servitude.
plugin.target: 這些可憐的靈魂……遭受著永恆的奴役。

plugin.source: The thought of the dead rising... makes me sick to my stomach.
plugin.target: 死而復生的想法……讓我感到很噁心。

plugin.source: Bandits know nothing of pity or mercy. No need to show them any either.
plugin.target: 強盜根本不懂憐憫與仁慈。我們也沒必要可憐他們。

plugin.source: A group of bandits descended on Dawnstar once... if it wasn't for the guard, who knows what they could have done to the place.
plugin.target: 曾有一群強盜襲擊了晨星城……如果不是衛兵，誰知道他們會對這片土地做出什麼事。

plugin.source: Bandits are the worst lot. They'd steal from their own mothers given the chance.
plugin.target: 強盜毫無人性。如果有機會，他們甚至會向自己的母親下手。

plugin.source: I thought I heard footsteps. Be careful.
plugin.target: 我想我聽到了腳步聲。小心。

plugin.source: When I was a young acolyte of Vaermina, I paid my dues in a shrine located within the catacombs of a fort in Cyrodiil.
plugin.target: 當我還是維耶米拉的小侍祭時，我的職責就是照顧希羅帝爾的一個堡壘地下墓穴中的聖壇。

plugin.source: I served as a healer in a fort not unlike this one long ago.
plugin.target: 我很久以前在一座類似的堡壘裡當治療師。

plugin.source: I can't imagine what happened to the dwarves. How could a race with the capability to build a place like this simply vanish?
plugin.target: 我不敢想像矮人出了什麼事。一個有能力建造這種地方的種族怎麼會憑空消失？

plugin.source: I've never been inside a dwarven ruin. They are simply astounding.
plugin.target: 我從未去過矮人的遺跡。他們十分驚人。

plugin.source: Did you hear that? A metal on stone sound... hmmm, perhaps it was nothing.
plugin.target: 你聽到沒？金屬撞擊石頭的聲音……嗯，也許我聽錯了。

plugin.source: This place could be massive... very easy to get lost. We have to be careful not to lose our way.
plugin.target: 地方會很大……很容易走丟。我們得小心別走岔了。

plugin.source: What a marvel of engineering. The ancient Nords were ingenious builders.
plugin.target: 多麼高超的技術。古代諾德人都是天才建築師。

plugin.source: Ugh, this place... horrible.
Watch yourself, these Nordic ruins are notorious for their traps.
plugin.target: 小心，這些諾德遺跡是出了名的陷阱多。

plugin.source: These ruins are old, maybe a thousand years or more.
plugin.target: 這些遺跡很古老，也許有上千年了。

plugin.source: Why anything would chose to reside down here is beyond me.
plugin.target: 我不能理解為什麼會有任何生物選擇住這裡。

plugin.source: These caves... they harbor ill omens, I can sense it.
plugin.target: 這些洞穴……滲著惡兆，我能感覺到。

plugin.source: Trust in Mara... she'll protect us in this dark place.
plugin.target: 相信瑪拉……她會在這暗處保佑我們的。

plugin.source: I don't like the looks of this place... not at all.
plugin.target: 我不喜歡這地方……一點也不。

plugin.source: I don't know what persuaded you to assist me when we met in Dawnstar, but I'm glad you did.
plugin.target: 我不知道為什麼你在晨星城見到我時願意伸出援手，但我很高興。

plugin.source: I've done a lot of... questionable things in my life. Serving Vaermina was a horrible mistake, and I hope Mara will forgive me one day.
plugin.target: 我的一生做了很多……有爭議的事。為瓦爾迷納做事是個可怕的錯誤，希望瑪拉能寬恕我。

plugin.source: I was recruited as an acolyte of Vaermina as a young elf. I had no real childhood to speak of... we weren't permitted to socialize.
plugin.target: 我當時是被作為瓦爾迷納的助手而招募進來的年幼精靈。我基本沒有童年……我們不允許和外界有交往。

plugin.source: I always felt a great deal of guilt running from Nightcaller Temple and leaving my friends to die. I'll never forgive myself for that.
plugin.target: 我總是為自己逃離喚夜神殿、放任朋友等死的行為而感到愧疚。我永遠不會原諒自己。

plugin.source: After running from Nightcaller Temple, I wandered Skyrim for years, until I was taken in by a priest of Mara who lived in Morthal.
plugin.target: 逃離喚夜神殿之後，我在天霜浪跡了好多年，之後我被住在墨索爾城的一位瑪拉的教士收留了。

plugin.source: Finding Mara was the greatest moment of my life. I'll never forget the warmth that spread through my heart when we embraced.
plugin.target: 投身瑪拉是我一生中最美好的時刻。我永遠不會忘記我們相擁時那傳遍全身的溫暖感覺。

plugin.source: It was a bit difficult to come to the ways of Mara at first, but my fellow priests were kind and quite patient with me.
plugin.target: 瑪拉之道剛開始還是很難適應的，但我的教士同伴們對我都很好且很有耐心。

plugin.source: I've never admitted this before, but I've killed more than I care to admit. I'll just leave it at that.
plugin.target: 雖然之前我很少承認過，但我殺的人已經不計其數了。對此我也沒什麼辦法。

plugin.source: My parents are long dead, but they lived wonderful lives... I have no sad stories to tell about them. Perhaps one day I'll visit their resting place.
plugin.target: 我父母很早就死了，但他們活著的時候很開心……沒啥傷心事可以說的。也許某天我會去祭奠他們。

plugin.source: I've been enjoying this journey with you. Not for the wealth we've accumulated, but just being able to carry Mara's will to every corner of Skyrim.
plugin.target: 和你同行很愉快。這並不因為我們所積攢的財富，而是因為我們把瑪拉的願望帶到了天霜的每個角落。

plugin.source: It's wonderful to be able to sleep soundly, don't you think?
plugin.target: 能夠安然入睡是多麼美好，不是嗎？

plugin.source: The Greybeards are an amazing lot. Imagine, living your entire life without speaking to a friend or a loved one. I couldn't stand it.
plugin.target: 灰鬍子們是一群神奇的人。試想，活一輩子都不對任何一個朋友或愛人說話。我可不行。

plugin.source: I've been to Ivarstead a few times, but never climbed High Hrothgar. I wouldn't mind visiting the monastery at the summit.
plugin.target: 我去過幾次紫杉鎮，但從沒登過高吼修道院。我倒是挺想去看看山頂的那座修道院。

plugin.source: When the weather permitted, Aerin and I would often walk the Rift's forests. The trees here are so beautiful.
plugin.target: 天氣好的時候，艾靈和我經常在裂谷的森林裡散步。那裡的樹很美。

plugin.source: Ah, Winterhold. I've always wanted to visit this place. The secrets locked inside must be astounding.
plugin.target: 啊，冬駐。我總想去那裡看看。裡面藏著的奧秘肯定很驚人。

plugin.source: Incredible... imagine the manpower and ingenuity needed to carve the buildings of Markarth.
plugin.target: 不可思議……想想要多少人力和天賦才能修築馬卡斯城的建築啊。

plugin.source: Whiterun is a such beautiful city. Have you ever seen the likes of this place?
plugin.target: 白漫真是個美麗的城市，你看到過類似的地方嗎？

plugin.source: This is the first time I've set foot in Windhelm. What a dreary place.
plugin.target: 這是我第一次踏進風舵城。真是個悶地方。

plugin.source: My mother always loved the sea. When I was young, we'd visit Solitude and watch the ships from the bluff. Ah... better times.
plugin.target: 我母親一直都很喜歡海。我小的時候，我們曾去獨孤城然後站在懸崖上看海上的船。啊……那時候多美好。

plugin.source: It feels good to walk the streets of Riften again.
plugin.target: 能再次走在裂谷城的街上感覺真棒。

plugin.source: Vampires... an unclean lot. It will be a pleasure to clear this place.
plugin.target: 吸血鬼……骯髒的傢伙們。很樂意清理一下這種地方。

plugin.source: Don't let the vampires strike you or else you may get infected with their blood poisoning.
plugin.target: 別讓吸血鬼咬到你，不然你的血可能會感染上他們的毒。

plugin.source: Be aware of rune traps on the ground or else this could be a very short expedition.
plugin.target: 注意地上的法印陷阱，不然你的旅程可能就得到此為止了。

plugin.source: Kill these casters as fast as you can, otherwise they may summon creatures we don't want to deal with.
plugin.target: 儘快殺掉這些施法者，不然他們會召喚那些難纏的生物。

plugin.source: Ugh... dark sorcery. Always makes my skin crawl.
plugin.target: 呃……黑魔法。總讓我起雞皮疙瘩。

plugin.source: If there's one thing I'm certain of, it's that draugr burn like tinder. We could use that to our advantage.
plugin.target: 我至少可以確定的是，屍鬼很容易被燒死。我們可以善用這一點。

plugin.source: Many have fallen in this crypt. The draugr show no mercy.
plugin.target: 很多人都死在這地穴裡了。屍鬼可是冷酷無情的。

plugin.source: Ugh, draugr. They reek of decay.
plugin.target: 呃……屍鬼。一股腐爛的惡臭。

plugin.source: When I was a child, my village was burned to the ground by bandits. Do you know I actually saw one laugh as he ran my brother through...
plugin.target: 我還是個孩子的時候，村子被強盜燒光了。要知道我甚至親眼目睹一個強盜一邊獰笑一邊刺穿了我的母親。

plugin.source: I hope there's more bandits around... their numbers could use a little more thinning.
plugin.target: 我希望這附近再多點兒強盜……多殺點才好。

plugin.source: These bandits would stab each other in the back if it meant an extra coin in their pockets.
plugin.target: 這些強盜為了多拿點錢甚至可以自相殘殺。

plugin.source: Bandits... the worst type of scum.
Perhaps we can find some treasure if we search the grounds of the fort thoroughly.
plugin.target: 如果我們能好好搜一下要塞的話，說不定能找到些寶藏。

plugin.source: I fought more than my share of bandits in places like this.
plugin.target: 我真希望自己能殺更多的強盜。

plugin.source: Keep your eyes open for ambushes. These forts have too many blind corners.
plugin.target: 注意伏擊。這些要塞盲點太多。

plugin.source: These are the most dangerous, but the most profitable types of ruins. The dwarves must have been a prosperous race.
plugin.target: 這些是最危險，同時也是回報最豐厚的遺跡。矮人肯定很富有。

plugin.source: Watch the walls for the sphere constructs... they can appear in the blink of an eye.
plugin.target: 注意牆邊的球狀物……它們可以在你眨眼的瞬間出現。

plugin.source: The dwarves were masters at subterranean construction... these ruins show only a fraction of their capabilities.
plugin.target: 矮人可是地下建築的大師……這些遺跡只展示了他們能力的冰山一角。

plugin.source: Mzinchaleft. I swore I'd never return here.
plugin.target: 姆津查夫特。我曾發誓以後再也不來這裡了。

plugin.source: I almost died in a ruin just like this.
plugin.target: 我上次差點死在一個和這裡差不多的遺跡裡。

plugin.source: Danger's about, I can tell. Be cautious.
plugin.target: 有危險，我可以感覺到。提高警惕。

plugin.source: Can you just imagine how ancient this place must be? Hundreds of years? Thousands?
plugin.target: 你能想像這個地方有多古老嗎？幾百年？幾千年？

plugin.source: There could be draugr about, I can smell the decay in the air.
plugin.target: 這附近可能有屍鬼，我能聞到空氣中的腐臭。

plugin.source: I've ventured into quite a few Nord ruins in my day.
plugin.target: 我那時候闖進過好幾個諾德遺跡。

plugin.source: Killed my first creature in a cave just like this... I'll never forget it.
plugin.target: 我就是在一個和這裡差不多的洞穴中殺死了我的第一個活物……我永遠忘不了那一刻。

plugin.source: I'm certain we'll find some treasure down here.
plugin.target: 我敢肯定我們能在這裡找到些寶藏。

plugin.source: Keep your eyes open, I don't like the looks of this place.
plugin.target: 提高警惕，我不太喜歡這裡的感覺。

plugin.source: Exploring these caves feels like coming home. I missed this.
plugin.target: 探索這些洞穴就像歸鄉。太懷念了。

plugin.source: I've really missed traveling like this. Walking the breadth of Skyrim has always filled my heart with excitement.
plugin.target: 我真的很懷念這樣的旅程。在天霜跋山涉水總是讓我很興奮。

plugin.source: I've never been a sellsword... never traded my skills for pay. I've always adventured on my own terms.
plugin.target: 我從來就不是個傭兵……我從不為錢打殺。我總是為了自己而冒險。

plugin.source: You should have seen me at the height of my adventuring career... I was fearless and took too many risks. But that's what it was all about.
plugin.target: 你真應該在我的冒險事業如日中天的時候認識我……我曾經無所畏懼，但生活不就是這麼回事嗎？

plugin.source: I remember a cutpurse trying to rob me on the road once. When I drew Grimsever, I think the poor man soiled his armor!
plugin.target: 我記得有一次在路上有個扒手想偷我錢。當我拔出無情切割者的時候，我想那可憐的傢伙拉護甲裡了。

plugin.source: I've seen enough death to last three lifetimes, yet I never tire of a good fight. What do you make of that?
plugin.target: 我這輩子見過的死亡比別人三輩子見過的還要多，但我從來沒有對戰鬥感到厭倦。你呢？

plugin.source: When I was young, I'd journey with my father on hunting expeditions into Morrowind. The cliff racers made for excellent sport.
plugin.target: 我小時候會隨著父親到塵風進行狩獵探險。絕壁競賽可是很棒的體育活動。

plugin.source: I love the cold air... it's exhilarating. Perhaps it's because of my Nord blood, but there's something about it that makes me feel alive.
plugin.target: 我喜歡那寒冷的空氣……令人興奮。也許是因為我的身上流著諾德之血，總有些東西讓我覺得充滿活力。

plugin.source: My father wanted me to follow in his footsteps as a hunter, but I set my aspirations a bit higher. He never complained... I miss him.
plugin.target: 我父親希望我步他後塵成為一個獵人，但我有更高的理想。他也從沒抱怨過……我真的很想念他。

plugin.source: My mother was a strong woman... she's the one who instructed me on my swordfighting techniques. Can you imagine?
plugin.target: 我母親很強哦……是她教的我劍術。你能想像嗎？

plugin.source: People say Skyrim is one of the most dangerous places in Tamriel. I think they're wrong... it's magnificent and I'm proud to call it home.
plugin.target: 人們說天霜是泰姆瑞爾最危險的地方之一。我覺得他們錯了……她很壯美，我為她是我故鄉而自豪。

plugin.source: As we walk these stone passages, we delve into the very bones of the earth.
plugin.target: 當我們走在這些石頭路上的時候，我們正往大地的深處探索。

plugin.source: There is an unnatural chill in the air. Some evil power is at work in this place.
plugin.target: 空氣冷得不像話，這裡有一些邪惡力量在搗鬼。

plugin.source: I do not envy those creatures that make a home in such a cold, dark place as this.
plugin.target: 我可不嫉妒那些在像這樣又冷又陰暗的地方居住的生物。

plugin.source: Careful. Our footsteps will echo in every chamber and tunnel.
plugin.target: 小心。我們的腳步聲會響徹每個洞穴和通道的。

plugin.source: By the Nine, I'd pay good money for a pint of ale to warm my bones!
plugin.target: 我可以面對九聖靈發誓，為了暖暖身子，我會花大價錢買一品脫麥芽酒！

plugin.source: Curse this chill! I should have dressed more warmly.
plugin.target: 真他媽冷！我應該再穿多點兒的。

plugin.source: If this cold numbs my fingers any worse, I'll scarcely be able to hold a weapon.
plugin.target: 我的手再凍僵一點兒的話就拿不住武器了。

plugin.source: Gods, I'd hate to lose my footing in a place like this. A fall on this stony floor will break bones.
plugin.target: 老天，我可不想在這種地方失足。在這樣堅硬的地上摔一跤肯定骨折。

plugin.source: Take extra care you don't hit your head on a low-hanging bit of stone.
plugin.target: 小心千萬別把頭磕在下垂的石頭上。

plugin.source: Mind your step. I think I spied a patch of ice on the floor.
plugin.target: 小心腳下。我想我在地上發現了一片冰面。

plugin.source: Don't go stopping for a nap. If you fall asleep in this place, you'll never wake up.
plugin.target: 別停下來打盹兒。如果你在這裡睡著了，就醒不了啦。

plugin.source: Are you sure you can find your way? It would be easy to get lost in here.
plugin.target: 你確定你能找到路？這裡很容易迷路的。

plugin.source: This cold is unbearable. It's all I can do not to shiver until my teeth rattle.
plugin.target: 冷得受不了啦。我拼命控制著不發抖，直到我牙齒都打顫了。

plugin.source: Would it be foolish to stop for a while and light a fire? I suppose it would.
plugin.target: 停下來生個火會不會是個餿主意呢？我想是的吧。

plugin.source: Gods willing, we'll find a chest full of gold in one of these chambers.
plugin.target: 一切順利的話，我們會在其中一個洞穴找到滿滿一箱的金幣。

plugin.source: At times like this, I truly appreciate the joys of a warm fire and a stiff drink.
plugin.target: 這時候，我能深切體會到有一團溫暖的火和熱飲是多好的事情。

plugin.source: There are strange echoes in these caves. Keep your eyes open.
plugin.target: 這些洞裡有奇怪的回聲。提高警惕。

plugin.source: If a man can't feel at home in a freezing cave, then he isn't truly a Nord.
plugin.target: 如果一個人在寒冷的洞穴裡覺得不自在，那他肯定不是真正的諾德人。

plugin.source: I have to admit, I admire your courage. Most folk in Skyrim wouldn't go near a place like this.
plugin.target: 我得承認我欣賞你的勇氣。天霜的大部分人都不會靠近這種地方。

plugin.source: When I was a boy, my friends and I used to play "seek the wumpus" in caves much like this.
plugin.target: 我還是孩子的時候，我和朋友們喜歡在這種洞穴裡面玩「捉迷藏」的遊戲。

plugin.source: Caves sounded more exciting in the bard's songs.
plugin.target: 還是在吟遊詩人的歌謠裡的洞穴比較有意思。

plugin.source: It's kind of dark in here.
How deep is this cave?
It feels like a whole mountain of rock is above us.
plugin.target: 感覺整個山的石頭都壓在我們頭上。

plugin.source: In a mine, the poor man labors to find precious stones that only the rich man can afford.
plugin.target: 在礦坑裡，可憐的工人辛苦地找到著那些只有富人們才能擁有的寶石。

plugin.source: I wonder how many poor souls have lost their lives working these tunnels.
plugin.target: 我想知道有多少可憐的人在開鑿這些坑道時候喪了命。

plugin.source: These earthen passages do not agree with me. I already miss the wind and sky.
plugin.target: 這些地道跟我不合拍。我有些想念清風和藍天了。

plugin.source: The fewer of these mines we venture into, the happier I'll be.
plugin.target: 我真是不情願進這些該死的礦坑。

plugin.source: The cloying air in this place is almost unbearable.
plugin.target: 這裡沉重的空氣讓人難以忍受。

plugin.source: By the gods, let this mine be small so we can be done with it quickly.
plugin.target: 以神靈的名義，讓這些礦坑規模小一點這樣我們就可以快點幹完！

plugin.source: My nose and mouth are so full of dust, I can hardly breathe.
plugin.target: 我的鼻子和嘴裡都是灰，都沒法呼吸了。

plugin.source: Wouldn't it be something if we found a vein of gold?
plugin.target: 如果我們找到了金礦礦脈不就值了。

plugin.source: It would be easy for someone -- or something -- to sneak up on us down here.
plugin.target: 我們在這裡很容易被人——或被什麼東西——偷襲。

plugin.source: Are you sure you wouldn't rather explore, say, a nice tavern?
plugin.target: 你確定你不想去找個，比如說，酒館？

plugin.source: Let's try not to make too much noise. I've heard that cave-ins can start that way.
plugin.target: 我們別太大聲，我聽說這樣容易塌方。

plugin.source: I wonder what they were mining down here.
plugin.target: 我想知道他們曾經在這裡挖掘什麼。

plugin.source: Let's hope the miners didn't unearth anything besides precious stones, if you take my meaning.
plugin.target: 讓我們期望那些礦工除了寶石沒挖出些別的什麼，如果你知道我在說些什麼的話。

plugin.source: Not for all the gold in Skyrim would I spend my life working in these tunnels.
plugin.target: 就算給我整個天霜的金幣我也不想挖這些坑道。

plugin.source: I've heard that miners sometimes die from poisonous gases trapped beneath the ground.
plugin.target: 我聽說有時礦工會死於地下的毒氣。

plugin.source: I'm already looking forward to getting back above ground.
plugin.target: 我一直很期待回到地上。

plugin.source: You know what I miss the most right now? Fresh air.
plugin.target: 你知道我現在最想念什麼對吧？新鮮空氣。

plugin.source: It takes uncommon strength to work the mines in Skyrim. The earth here is cold and hard, like the heart of a Nord.
plugin.target: 在天霜挖礦需要非凡的耐力。這裡的土地又冷又硬，跟諾德人的鐵石心腸一樣。

plugin.source: There's an old maid's tale that says our ancestors dug these mines with their bare hands.
plugin.target: 有一個古老的傳說，稱我們祖先用雙手挖了這些礦。

plugin.source: I've half a mind to grab a pickaxe and start digging. Never know what you might find.
plugin.target: 我有點兒想拿把十字鎬開始挖了。你永遠不知道會找到什麼。

plugin.source: It seems warmer down here than it was outside.
plugin.target: 似乎這下面比外面暖和點兒。

plugin.source: Hard to believe people actually have to work in places like this.
plugin.target: 不敢相信有人需要在這做工。

plugin.source: Wonder what they mine from these walls.
plugin.target: 真想知道他們從這些牆上挖些什麼。

plugin.source: I'll take a sword or mace over a pickaxe any day.
plugin.target: 我任何時候都會選擇劍或釘頭槌而不是手鎬。

plugin.source: Do you think we'll find gold nuggets in here?
plugin.target: 你覺得我們會在這裡找到金塊嗎？

plugin.source: It is strange to think that these chambers were once home to the ancient Nords.
plugin.target: 想到這些洞穴曾經是古諾德人的家就覺得很奇怪。

plugin.source: I feel the eyes of angry spirits upon us. We are not welcome here.
plugin.target: 我能感覺到有些憤怒的靈魂在盯著我們。我們在這裡不受歡迎。

plugin.source: Few would dare to trespass in these ruins. What you lack in wisdom, you make up for in courage.
plugin.target: 很少有人敢擅闖這些遺跡。只有那些無知的人才會表現出魯莽的大膽。

plugin.source: Do not ask me to take treasures from this place. I will not risk the anger of the dead.
plugin.target: 別叫我從這裡拿走東西。我不想引起死靈的憤怒。

plugin.source: They say ruins like these are filled with treasure. Of course, they're filled with traps, too.
plugin.target: 據說這樣的遺跡到處有寶。當然了，也到處有陷阱。

plugin.source: I could have sworn I heard something right behind us.
plugin.target: 我可以發誓我剛剛聽到有東西在我們後面。

plugin.source: I'll bet some of these artifacts would fetch a good price. I hope they're not cursed.
plugin.target: 我敢打賭這些寶物的肯定有一部分價值不菲。希望它們沒有被詛咒。

plugin.source: I wonder what the ancient Nords did in these ruins. Unspeakable sacrifices, maybe?
plugin.target: 我想知道古諾德人在這些遺跡裡做了什麼。也許他們作出了不可告人的獻祭？

plugin.source: If these ruins frighten you, take comfort in the knowledge that I am here.
plugin.target: 如果這些遺跡嚇到你了，只要想著有我在就行了。

plugin.source: Do try not to set off any traps, will you?
I suppose you intend to carry off every item of value in these ruins?
plugin.target: 我想你是想把遺跡裡所有值錢的東西都拿走吧。

plugin.source: These ruins might be interesting if I wasn't already an expert on Nordic history.
plugin.target: 這遺跡很有趣；可惜我不是諾德史方面的專家。

plugin.source: Remember to check behind you every once in a while. Who knows what might try to sneak up on us.
plugin.target: 記著時常看看你背後。誰知道什麼東西會襲擊我們。

plugin.source: Keep your eyes open for traps. Old ruins like this are usually filled with them.
plugin.target: 小心陷阱，像這樣的古老的遺跡通常都會有。

plugin.source: The ancient Nords were a savage people, but they built some remarkable crypts and temples.
plugin.target: 古諾德人是群野蠻的傢伙，但他們建造了不少雄偉的地穴和神殿。

plugin.source: There's a lot of history in a place like that. I'll bet these walls could tell some amazing stories.
plugin.target: 像這樣的地方都有豐富的歷史。我打賭這些牆壁有著源遠流長的故事。

plugin.source: Look at this craftsmanship! These old halls fill some folk with dread, but as a Nord, they fill me with pride.
plugin.target: 看看這工藝技術！這些古老的大廳讓有些人害怕，但作為一個諾德人，我很自豪。

plugin.source: We're bound to find some gold in these ruins, but out of respect, let's leave a few coins for the dead.
plugin.target: 我們肯定能在這些遺跡裡找到金幣，但出於敬意，還是留點給亡者吧。

plugin.source: It's strange to think that some of my own ancestors might be buried in here.
plugin.target: 想著一些我自己的祖先可能都埋在這裡就覺得怪怪的。

plugin.source: Plunder these ruins at your peril, friend. The spirits of the dead won't look kindly upon it.
plugin.target: 搜刮這些遺跡的話自擔風險吧，朋友。死者的靈魂是不會甘休的。

plugin.source: Never knew a place could be so ancient. I bet it's over a thousand years old.
plugin.target: 從沒見過一個這麼歷史悠久的地方。我打賭它存在超過一千年了。

plugin.source: Wonder if any of my ancestors ever walked these halls?
plugin.target: 想知道我的祖先中有沒有誰來過這些大廳。

plugin.source: Everything in here seems to be about death. Burial urns, crypts, funeral shrouds. It's a bit depressing.
plugin.target: 這裡的東西看起來都和死亡有關。骨灰甕，地穴，裹屍布。真掃興。

plugin.source: I wonder what the ancient Nords used this place for?
plugin.target: 我想知道古代諾德人為了什麼來使用這裡？

plugin.source: The Dwemer who built this place were sometimes called Dwarves, but history records that they were no shorter than humans.
plugin.target: 建造這裡的鍛莫有時被稱作矮人，但歷史記載他們並不比人類矮。

plugin.source: There are scholars in Cyrodiil who have dedicated their lives to solving the mystery of the Dwemers' disappearance.
plugin.target: 在希羅帝爾有一些學者窮其一生都在試著揭開鍛莫消失之謎。

plugin.source: It is remarkable that so many of these ancient Dwemer creations still function.
plugin.target: 這麼多古鍛莫創造的東西現在都還能用，真是了不起。

plugin.source: There are those who believe that the entire Dwemer race will one day return just as suddenly as it vanished.
plugin.target: 有些人相信有一天所有的鍛莫會像他們突然消失一樣又突然出現。

plugin.source: What good is a sword or an axe against an enemy made of brass and steel?
plugin.target: 對抗一個銅身鐵臂的敵人劍斧有什麼用？

plugin.source: It's unnatural, building all these machines. If you ask me, the Dwemer got what they deserved.
plugin.target: 能建造出這些機械的人都不正常。如果你問我，我得說鍛莫是咎由自取。

plugin.source: I don't like fighting these Dwemer creations. Where's the fun in killing something that doesn't even bleed?
plugin.target: 我不喜歡和這些鍛莫創造的東西打鬥。跟這些都不會流血的東西作戰有什麼意思？

plugin.source: Watch out for the hot steam vents down here. They'll burn you worse than fire.
plugin.target: 注意這裡的熱蒸汽閥。它們吹在你身上比火焰還厲害。

plugin.source: Had they placed their faith in magic instead of machinery, the Dwemer might still be around.
plugin.target: 如果鍛莫相信魔法而不是機械的話，他們可能還活著。

plugin.source: A living Dwemer was once discovered in Morrowind. Can you imagine it, being the last surviving member of your race?
plugin.target: 以前在塵風曾發現一名活著的鍛莫。你能想像自己是族群裡最後一個倖存者嗎？

plugin.source: I should bring some of these Dwemer artifacts to the Arcane University in Cyrodiil for study.
plugin.target: 我應該拿一些鍛莫文物去希羅帝爾的奧術大學研究一下。

plugin.source: I wonder what keeps these machines working so long after their masters disappeared.
plugin.target: 我想知道是什麼讓這些機械在它們的主人死後能工作這麼長時間。

plugin.source: The Dwemer created so many wondrous machines, and yet nobody ever followed in their footsteps. Why is that, I wonder?
plugin.target: 鍛莫創造了這麼多神奇的機械，為什麼沒有人追隨他們的腳步呢？我想知道為什麼。

plugin.source: Among other things, the Dwemer were expert trap-makers. Watch the floor for tripwires and false plates.
plugin.target: 鍛莫尤其善於製造陷阱。當心地上的拌網和機關觸發板。

plugin.source: I've half a mind to dismantle one of these Dwemer machines. I'd like to see how it works.
plugin.target: 我有點兒想拿一個這些鍛莫造的機械拆了。想看看它是怎麼運作的。

plugin.source: I suppose the warmth in this place comes from all the hot steam vents.
plugin.target: 我想這裡的熱量都是從熱蒸汽閥裡出來的。

plugin.source: Scholars say the Dwemer were an advanced culture. Ha! The Nords outlasted their entire race. So much for being advanced.
plugin.target: 學者說鍛莫有著較高的文化。哈！諾德人比他們整個族群都長壽，有文化頂個屁用。

plugin.source: I wonder why the Dwemer came to Skyrim. Why did they build this place? I suppose we'll never know.
plugin.target: 我只想知道鍛莫為什麼來天霜。為什麼建了這個地方。但我想永遠無法搞清楚了。

plugin.source: Do these steel walls and strange Dwemer devices make you uneasy? Perhaps it's just me.
plugin.target: 這些鋼壁和奇怪的鍛莫裝置有讓你感覺不自在嗎？還是說只有我這樣覺得。

plugin.source: I've heard that you can sell Dwemer artifacts on the black market down in Cyrodiil. They fetch a handsome price, too.
plugin.target: 我聽說你可以在希羅帝爾的黑市賣出鍛莫的手工藝品。價格相當公道。

plugin.source: This place is amazing! It's hard to believe that mortal hands built them.
plugin.target: 這地方太棒了！無法想像出自凡人之手。

plugin.source: What do you think these devices were for?
plugin.target: 你覺得這些裝置是做什麼的？

plugin.source: The stories don't say why the dwarves disappeared. I wonder if their machines turned on them.
plugin.target: 流傳的故事中並沒有說鍛莫如何消失的。我想知道是否是他們製造的機器倒戈了。

plugin.source: It's amazing this place is so well preserved. There isn't even a hint of rust.
plugin.target: 這地方保養得真好。一點生銹的痕跡都沒有。

plugin.source: So many shadowy corners to strike from! I could learn to like this place.
plugin.target: 這麼多能發動偷襲的陰暗角落！好吧，說不定這個地方很適合我。

plugin.source: Silence will serve us well in this place. Let us take our foes by surprise.
plugin.target: 在這裡保持安靜為妙。我們可以出其不意攻其無備。

plugin.source: Be wary for traps. If you spy one, try to get an enemy to trigger it.
plugin.target: 當心陷阱。如果你看到了，試著引誘敵人去觸發它。

plugin.source: I can see the battle-lust in your eyes. Doom will surely come to any who cross your path.
plugin.target: 我可以從你眼中看到對戰爭的渴望。真是誰遇到你就該誰倒楣了。

plugin.source: If it wasn't for all the dangers in here, this place could almost be cozy.
plugin.target: 如果不是因為潛在的危險的話，這裡甚至可以說得上舒適。

plugin.source: When I was a child, I dreamed about having a fort like this all to myself.
plugin.target: 當我還是孩子的時候，我夢想過一個人擁有這樣的要塞。

plugin.source: I wonder if we'll come across some bandits who've just finished roasting a rabbit on a spit. Maybe they'll have a keg of ale, too.
plugin.target: 我想知道我們是否會碰到幾個剛剛在叉子上烤完兔肉的強盜。或許他們還有一桶麥芽酒。

plugin.source: If my ma could see me now, she'd scold me good. She'd tell me I should know better than to go poking around in abandoned forts.
plugin.target: 如果我媽媽現在看到我，肯定會大罵我。她會跟我說我應該更懂事而不是在廢棄的要塞到處亂逛。

plugin.source: This smell of dank earth and worm-eaten wood is going to make me lose my last meal.
plugin.target: 這些溼泥和爛木蛀蟲的味道，幾乎都讓我把上頓飯吐出來了。

plugin.source: How pathetic, being forced to eke out a miserable existence in a place like this.
plugin.target: 多可憐啊，被迫在這種地方掙扎求存。

plugin.source: Just look at this place. Is this what passes for a fort in Skyrim?
plugin.target: 看看這地方。和天霜的要塞像不像？

plugin.source: The sooner we can get out of this filth-pit, the better.
plugin.target: 我們還是趕快離開這污穢的坑洞吧。

plugin.source: These timber supports are rotted through. It's a wonder this place is still standing.
plugin.target: 這些木質支柱都爛透了這地方還沒倒真是神奇。

plugin.source: Check every crate, chest and barrel you see. Who knows, maybe a few of them have something valuable inside.
plugin.target: 搜一下你能看到的所有板條箱，寶箱和桶。天曉得，說不定他們留了些寶貝在裡面。

plugin.source: Did you bring a torch? These old forts can get pretty dark inside.
plugin.target: 你帶了火炬嗎？這種古老的要塞會很陰暗。

plugin.source: There are forts like this all over Skyrim. The Imperials abandoned most of them a long time ago.
plugin.target: 天霜還有很多這樣的要塞，大多數都是很多年前帝國軍所遺棄的。

plugin.source: Just look at this place. I've seen better workmanship from Nord children only ten winters old.
plugin.target: 看看這裡，我見過的十歲諾德孩童做的都比這好。

plugin.source: So this is what passes for Imperial craftsmanship? Try not to sneeze, or you might bring the whole fort down.
plugin.target: 這就是所謂的帝國工藝。別打噴嚏啊，不然會讓這要塞塌了的。

plugin.source: What is that stench? Rotting wood, perhaps? That can't be good.
plugin.target: 那是股什麼臭味？爛木頭嗎？那可不是好事。

plugin.source: You'd have to be pretty desperate to want to make a home in this dank hole.
plugin.target: 想在這麼陰溼的洞理安家，看來你已經走投無路了。

plugin.source: The Jarls never want to pay to keep their forts. They just keep slipping further into ruin.
plugin.target: 領主們根本不想花錢維護這些要塞。它們很快就變成廢墟了。

plugin.source: I wonder what great battles were fought here?
plugin.target: 我想知道在這裡發生過什麼大戰。

plugin.source: Do you think Tiber Septim ever fought here?
plugin.target: 你覺得泰伯·賽普汀曾在這裡打過仗嗎？

plugin.source: I can see why they built the fort here. A small force could control most of the nearby land.
plugin.target: 我明白他們為什麼在這裡建造要塞了。這樣一小股人就可以控制周圍大部分的地方。

plugin.source: Outlaws and brigands are the lowest of the low. They prey on their own countrymen for profit.
plugin.target: 逃犯和土匪都是人渣中的敗類，他們靠掠奪自己同胞來發財。

plugin.source: I hope that when I die, I don't end up as a shambling corpse.
plugin.target: 我希望當我死的時候可不要落得這副潦倒樣。

plugin.source: The Forsworn are as wild as wolves. Practice those old magics, so some folk say.
plugin.target: 拒誓者像狼一樣兇猛。練習那些古老的魔法吧，一些市民是這麼說的。

plugin.source: Wizards. Why is it always wizards?
It isn't just your blood that a vampire wants, it's your mortal soul.
plugin.target: 吸血鬼不僅想要你的血，還想要吞噬你凡人的靈魂。

plugin.source: Fighting draugr is as much about controlling your fear as anything else.
plugin.target: 和屍鬼對抗關鍵在於和你的恐懼作鬥爭。

plugin.source: Most bandits are cowards. These seem to be braver than most.
plugin.target: 大多數的強盜都是懦夫。但這些人看起來要比大多數都勇敢。

plugin.source: These wizards are mad beyond reason. They understand only violence.
plugin.target: 這些法師瘋得不可理喻。他們只懂暴力。

plugin.source: There is no greater madness than those who seek to become vampires. That's a dark bargain if there ever was one.
plugin.target: 沒有比那些想成為吸血鬼的人更瘋狂的了。如果有什麼交易的話那可真夠黑暗的。

plugin.source: You can easily break a blade on the metal skin of a Dwemer construct.
plugin.target: 劍在鍛莫的機械上一砍就斷。

plugin.source: I hate bandits and thieves. Men like these raid our town every year.
plugin.target: 我恨土匪和盜賊。他們每年都會掠奪我們的城鎮。

plugin.source: I hope that when I die, I don't end up as a shambling corpse.
plugin.target: 我希望當我死的時候可不要落得這副潦倒樣。

plugin.source: The Forsworn are strange men. They fight to reclaim Markarth, but they live like savages.
plugin.target: 拒誓者是一群怪人。他們為奪回馬卡斯城而戰，但卻活的像個野人。

plugin.source: I don't like wizards and their spells. Give me an axe any day.
plugin.target: 我不喜歡法師和他們的法術。我只要斧頭。

plugin.source: These walking devices are strange yet amazing. What magic powers them?
plugin.target: 這些會走的裝置很奇怪但也很了不起。是什麼魔法駕馭著它們？

plugin.source: I'd rather fight bandits than draugr. At least bandits know when to stay dead.
plugin.target: 我寧願和強盜打也不願碰上屍鬼。至少強盜知道死的時候就該躺著不動。

plugin.source: Taken alone, the draugr aren't so fearsome. They're far more deadly in greater numbers.
plugin.target: 單個屍鬼沒那麼可怕。數量一多就致命了。

plugin.source: These Forsworn are just savages. They live in caves and ruins when civilized folk build towns and cities.
plugin.target: 這些拒誓者就是野人。當文明人建造城鎮的時候他們卻住在岩洞和廢墟裡。

plugin.source: You can't argue with these mages. They'll attack you on sight.
plugin.target: 你無法和這些法師講理。他們一看到你就會攻擊。

plugin.source: It probably took some Dwemer craftsman a year to build one of those things.
plugin.target: 說不定一個鍛莫工匠需要花一年的時間才能造出這些東西裡的一個。

plugin.source: There may be no enemy more foul than a walking corpse.
plugin.target: 恐怕沒有什麼敵人比個行屍走肉更噁心的了。

plugin.source: I thought about becoming a bandit. I decided I preferred clean clothes and fresh mead.
plugin.target: 我曾想過去當個盜賊。不過最後我還是選擇了體面的穿著和醇香的蜂蜜酒。

plugin.source: These ruins and their mechanical inhabitants are all that remain of the Dwemer.
plugin.target: 這些遺跡和裡面的機械是鍛莫僅存的東西。

plugin.source: It's said that the Forsworn make dark pacts with the Hagravens, and that is why they can use magic.
plugin.target: 相傳拒誓者之所以能夠使用魔法，是因為他們和烏鴉鬼婆立下了黑暗之約。

plugin.source: There is no adversary more deadly than a vampire. They are as cruel as they are cunning.
plugin.target: 沒有敵人比吸血鬼更致命。他們既兇殘又狡猾。

plugin.source: Bandits are desperate men. They have nothing to lose, and they fight like it.
plugin.target: 強盜都是一些窮凶極惡的傢伙。因為他們無牽無掛，所以打起來特別拼命。

plugin.source: What some call devotion to the dark arts, I call foolishness.
plugin.target: 人家說的對黑暗巫術的虔誠我認為是愚蠢。

plugin.source: These Forsworn don't even have the decency to dress right.
plugin.target: 這些拒誓者甚至連體面的穿著都不懂。

plugin.source: Draugr are slow and clumsy. Hardly a challenge for a man like me.
plugin.target: 屍鬼行走緩慢笨拙。不足以與我為敵。

plugin.source: I would find the Dwemers' mechanical guardians fascinating if they didn't try to kill everything on sight.
plugin.target: 如果鍛莫的機械護衛不是見人就殺的話，我甚至還會覺得它們很迷人。

plugin.source: Don't get too far ahead.
It's time for us to part ways.
I'd best get back to Master Neloth then. No telling what's happened since I've been gone.
plugin.target: 如你所願。要是改變主意就來學院找我。

plugin.source: You'll be all right on your own? Then I'll see you back at the College.
plugin.target: 你一個人沒問題吧？那我們就學院再見了。

plugin.source: Really? J'zargo was having such fun. Ah, well. Back to the College then.
plugin.target: 真的嗎？吉紮格這趟是很開心的。啊，好吧。我這就回學院。

plugin.source: I understand. We must all follow our own paths. If you wish to find me again, I'll be in Nightcaller Temple.
plugin.target: 我明白。我們各有各的路要走。如果你再次需要我，我就在喚夜神殿。

plugin.source: Such a shame. I thought we were getting along so well. I'll head back to Riften if you should have second thoughts.
plugin.target: 真是遺憾。我以為我們能相處得很好。你要是改了主意我就回裂谷城。

plugin.source: Farewell, then. If you need my services again, just come and look for me in the usual place.
plugin.target: 那我們再會。你要是需要我幫忙，就來老地方找我。

plugin.source: So you think you can make it on your own, then? We'll just see about that.
plugin.target: 所以你認為靠自己就夠了？那我們就等著看吧。

plugin.source: If that's what you want. Watch your back out there, and if you need me again, you know where I'll be.
plugin.target: 如你所願。一路小心，如果你需要我幫忙，你知道該去哪找我。
