plugin.source: It is a lonely thing, facing all the dangers of Skyrim by yourself. Come and find me if you decide that you miss my companionship.
plugin.target: 獨自面對天霜裡的所有危險，是一件很孤獨的事情。要是你想念我們的友誼了，就來找我吧。

plugin.source: You're letting me go? What's wrong, is my skill with a blade making you look bad? Hah! I'm kidding, friend. Until we meet again!
plugin.target: 你要我走？出了什麼問題，是我的劍術讓你感到不快嗎？哈！朋友，我開玩笑的啦。再會！

plugin.source: Well, it's been fun. I guess I'll head back to Rorikstead.
plugin.target: 好吧，真是有趣。我想我要回洛利克鎮了。

plugin.source: I will be back at your house if you need me, Thane.
plugin.target: 您要是需要我，我會在您的住所等您，男爵大人。

plugin.source: I'll keep watch at Lakeview Manor until you return, Thane. Good hunting.
plugin.target: 我會看守著湖景林居直到你的歸來。祝狩獵愉快。

plugin.source: I'll return to Windstad Manor and remain on guard, my Thane.
plugin.target: 我會回到風臨館做好警備工作，男爵大人。

plugin.source: As you command, Thane. I'll guard Heljarchen House until you return.
plugin.target: 謹遵號令，男爵。我會守護好勇士塹山莊直到您的歸來。

plugin.source: I'll wait for you at the Jarl's Longhouse in Falkreath until you need me again, Thane.
plugin.target: 我會在佛克瑞斯領主的長屋等候您再次的傳召，男爵。

plugin.source: I'll return to Highmoon Hall in Morthal until you need me again, Thane.
plugin.target: 我會回到墨索爾城的懸月大廳等候您再次的傳召，男爵。

plugin.source: As you command, Thane. I'll wait at the White Hall in Dawnstar until you need me again.
plugin.target: 謹遵號令，男爵。我會在晨星城的白色會堂等候您再次的傳召。

plugin.source: I'll head back home if you need me.
plugin.target: 那我就先回家了，需要時再來找我吧。

plugin.source: Then back home is where you will find me.
I'll be heading home, then, if you need me.
plugin.target: 我這就回家，需要時再來找我吧。

plugin.source: You need my strength again, I'll be home.
plugin.target: 要是再需要我出一份力，我就在家中。

plugin.source: I'm heading home if you need me.
plugin.target: 那我就回家了，需要時再來找我吧。

plugin.source: It has been an honor, Skaal-friend.
plugin.target: 這是我的榮幸，斯卡爾之友。

plugin.source: I need to trade some things with you.
plugin.target: 我想要跟你交換些東西。

plugin.source: I'm a mage, not a pawnbroker, you know.
plugin.target: 我是個法師，不是開當鋪的，知道嗎？

plugin.source: If it will help you, then certainly.
plugin.target: 如果能幫到你，那當然了。

plugin.source: J'zargo only has so much room to carry things.
plugin.target: 吉紮格只有這麼點空間可以裝東西。

plugin.source: No problem, I can carry a good bit of gear.
plugin.target: 沒問題，我可以裝不少的好裝備。

plugin.source: Running out of room, eh? I'll be glad to help.
plugin.target: 沒空間了嗎？我很樂意幫忙。

plugin.source: Do I get to keep it? Just kidding.
plugin.target: 能把它送給我嗎？開個玩笑啦。

plugin.source: I am an apprentice wizard, not a pack mule! Oh very well, but make it quick.
plugin.target: 我是個法師學徒，不是進城趕集的驢！噢好吧，可別讓我馱太久。

plugin.source: Sure, feel free to hand me all the gold you want.
plugin.target: 當然，不用客氣，把你想給我的金幣全拿出來吧。

plugin.source: If that is what you wish.
Sure, what have you got?
No problem! How can I help?
plugin.target: 沒問題！我能幫你做什麼？

plugin.source: Of course, Thane. How can I be of service?
plugin.target: 沒問題，男爵。我該如何效勞？

plugin.source: Do you need something from me, Thane? Or can I carry something for you?
plugin.target: 有任何需要我的地方，男爵？或著讓我為您負重？

plugin.source: What's mine is yours, Thane.
I am sworn to carry your burdens.
plugin.target: 我已經宣誓替你分擔一切。

plugin.source: I am at your command.
How can I serve you, my Thane?
What do you want me to carry?
I will shoulder some of your burden.
plugin.target: 我會幫你減輕些負重的。

plugin.source: Need me to carry something?
Fine. Let's trade, then.
plugin.target: 很好。既然如此，那就交易吧。

plugin.source: What do you need to take?
Whatever you say, boss.
I like the pretty lights.
Burn the king!
Get your festival meat pie. Specially made.
plugin.target: 拿一個節日肉派吧。特製的。

plugin.source: Try our meats made here at the Festival. They're the best.
plugin.target: 試試我們的節日肉製品。它們是最美味的。

plugin.source: It's time for you to go.
Hey, get out of here!
Leave or be removed.
You need to leave now.
Go, you're not wanted here.
I don't think you belong here.
Leave now or suffer dire consequences.
plugin.target: 現在就滾，不然後果嚴重。

plugin.source: Get out of here before I call the guards!
plugin.target: 現在就滾不然我叫衛兵了！

plugin.source: Both of you... out, out!
I think it's time for you to get going.
Could you please leave now?
You must leave immediately.
You are not welcome here. Go.
You need to leave.
Enough of this! Fight me!
So, you reveal yourself!
You can't hide from me!
Now you die!
Oh come now, resorting to petty tricks are we?
plugin.target: 噢拜託，別玩那種小把戲了。

plugin.source: A bold but foolish move.
Coward.
You cannot escape!
That was fun.
Pathetic.
And that's why I'm the best.
plugin.target: 這就是我為何是最出色的原因。

plugin.source: Shadows consume you.
Hmph. Hardly a challenge.
Sure, pick on the old guy!
Been itching for a fight.
I'll tear you apart!
I'll bury my blade in your heart!
plugin.target: 我會將利刃插入你的心臟。

plugin.source: So, it begins.
There you are!
You can't hide from me!
Come coward, now we fight!
Coward. Come out and fight me!
I'm gettin' too old for this!
Come on!
You're making this too easy!
Shadows take you!
Give up?
I will end you!
I welcome you, friend. How may I serve you?
plugin.target: 歡迎你，我的朋友。有什麼能為你服務的呢？

plugin.source: So many refuse to talk to us. They call us thieves and smugglers. I am glad to see that you are not such a one.
plugin.target: 好多人都不願意跟我們說話，他們說我們是盜賊和走私者。真高興你不是其中一個。

plugin.source: Welcome. If I cannot serve you, I am sure that one of my other traders can do so.
plugin.target: 歡迎。如果我暫時無法服務你，其他商人也會幫忙你的。

plugin.source: I have traveled far across Tamriel to serve you.
plugin.target: 我從泰姆瑞爾另一頭而來，只為了服務你。

plugin.source: Perhaps you have encountered Ma'dran or Akhari? Both are sworn to me, and both have worthy goods to offer.
plugin.target: 也許你曾遇過馬德蘭或阿卡利？他們都向我保證過，會提供顧客傑出的商品。

plugin.source: A peaceful greeting to you.
A welcome to you, fellow traveler.
Khajiit welcomes you, and also your coin.
plugin.target: 凱季特人歡迎你，和你的錢。

plugin.source: Fortune smiles upon this meeting.
Welcome to you.
Warm sands, friend. How may this one serve you?
plugin.target: 溫暖的沙子，朋友。你滿意這服務嗎？

plugin.source: Please, come and browse our goods.
May your bed be warm and your food sweet.
You honor Khajiit with your presence.
plugin.target: 你忠實的凱季特人與你同在。

plugin.source: Many fine things are here for you, friend.
plugin.target: 這裡有很多東西適合你，朋友。

plugin.source: Come and see what is for sale, traveler.
plugin.target: 來看看賣些什麼嗎，旅行者。

plugin.source: May the sun warm your path, friend.
Welcome to Khajiit's humble camp.
plugin.target: 歡迎蒞臨凱季特人簡陋的營地。

plugin.source: Blessings of the moons upon you, traveler.
I've been hunting and fishing in these parts for years.
plugin.target: 我這幾年一直在這區域捕魚打獵。

plugin.source: It's not like my poaching is hurting anyone. The Jarl can hardly eat every deer now can he?
plugin.target: 我的狩獵沒有危害到任何人。領主難道會因為我少吃一頭鹿？

plugin.source: There's enough for all of us if you aren't greedy.
plugin.target: 對知足的人來說，這日子已經很不錯了。

plugin.source: Follow me.
I'm right with you.
J'zargo is ready for more adventure.
plugin.target: 吉紮格已經準備好踏上冒險旅程了。

plugin.source: Of course. Let's go.
Certainly, I'm ready.
I'm ready. Let's go.
Good. I'm ready for anything.
plugin.target: 很好，我現在做什麼都行。

plugin.source: Try not to walk into any spike-filled pits or filthy skeever dens.
plugin.target: 別靠近佈滿釘子或者惡鼠牙的地方。

plugin.source: Onward to our next adventure!
I am the shadow at your back.
Good! Let's go find something to fight.
plugin.target: 很好！我們去找點東西打打。

plugin.source: I'm ready.
Great! Let's go!
My blade is yours to command, Thane.
Lead on, Thane.
I'm with you, Thane.
As you will, my Thane. I will protect you with my life.
plugin.target: 悉聽尊意，男爵大人。我會用生命保護您。

plugin.source: As you command, my Thane.
Let's get going.
Lead the way.
Waaaaah!
Come with me, tribe-kin.
Wait here.
I'll stay here. You try not to get into too much trouble.
plugin.target: 我就待在這裡。你盡量少惹麻煩。

plugin.source: As you wish. Just don't forget about me.
Here? Right here? Very well, J'zargo shall wait.
plugin.target: 這？在這？很好，吉紮格會等的。

plugin.source: Certainly. Be careful.
All right. Don't take too long.
Are you sure? All right. I'll keep guard here.
plugin.target: 你確定？好吧，我來守住這裡。

plugin.source: Don't make me wait too long. I get bored very easily.
plugin.target: 別讓我等太久，我很容易厭倦的。

plugin.source: Patience isn't exactly my strong suit, but alright.
plugin.target: 我的耐心可不怎麼好，不過好吧。

plugin.source: As you wish.
I'll be right here. Be careful now!
Yes, Thane. Be careful.
I'm yours to command, Thane. I'll wait here until you need me.
plugin.target: 聽候您的差遣，男爵。我會在此等候直到您下令跟隨。

plugin.source: Don't be long. My place is by your side.
plugin.target: 別耽擱得久了，我必須與你共進退。

plugin.source: As you wish, my Thane.
I will remain on guard here.
plugin.target: 我會竭盡所能守護這裡。

plugin.source: Very well. Just be careful!
I'll wait here. Just don't start any trouble without me.
plugin.target: 我會在這等你。沒我罩你的時候別惹麻煩！

plugin.source: You go on ahead.
Head on, then. I will keep an eye out.
plugin.target: 出發吧，我會警戒周圍的。

plugin.source: You sure? Fine. I'll stand watch.
plugin.target: 你確定？好吧，我在這看著。

plugin.source: Go on ahead. I'll stand guard.
What does a housecarl do?
As my Thane, I'm sworn to your service. I'll guard you, and all you own, with my life.
plugin.target: 我宣誓為你效忠，男爵。我是你的護衛，以我的生命保護你的一切。

plugin.source: What have you got for sale?
So you're interested in my potions and ingredients?
plugin.target: 你想看看我的藥劑和煉金材料嗎？

plugin.source: Got a pretty full stock of potions and alchemy reagents.
plugin.target: 無論是藥劑的庫存還是煉製試劑都一應俱全。

plugin.source: Ah, so you're an alchemist, then?
plugin.target: 啊，那你是個煉金術士囉？

plugin.source: The finest weapons and armor.
plugin.target: 最好的武器和護甲，請過來看看。

plugin.source: Hmm... Blades, helmets. Pretty much anything to suit your needs.
plugin.target: 唔……刀，頭盔，差不多你想要的都能找到。

plugin.source: Looking to protect yourself, or deal some damage?
plugin.target: 找點保護自己的東西，還是砍人的東西？

plugin.source: Usual guild rate. Let's take a look at them.
plugin.target: 慣例的公會優惠，來看看吧。

plugin.source: What'll you give me for these?
Why don't you take a look at some of my merchandise and we'll see what kind of a deal we can make.
plugin.target: 為何不先看看商品，再商議價錢？

plugin.source: What'll you give me for these?
I've got coin and I've got merchandise. Let's see what we can do.
plugin.target: 我有些錢，還有些貨。我們可以談筆交易。

plugin.source: What'll you give me for these?
I give special rates to members of the Thieves Guild. Show me what you've got.
plugin.target: 我會給盜賊公會成員特別優惠。讓我看看你有什麼。

plugin.source: What'll you give me for these?
Bows and arrows for the mighty huntsman.
plugin.target: 為強大的獵人所準備的弓箭。

plugin.source: An archer, eh? I've got just what you need.
plugin.target: 是弓箭手，對嗎？噢，我有你需要的東西。

plugin.source: What are you hunting? Never mind. I don't want to know.
plugin.target: 你在狩獵什麼呢？算了。我也不想知道。

plugin.source: Drink for the thirsty, food for the hungry.
plugin.target: 渴了美酒暢飲，餓了美食飽餐。

plugin.source: Let's sate that appetite, hmm?
Depends. Are you thirsty, hungry, both?
plugin.target: 看情況。你是餓了，還是渴了，還是兩者皆是？

plugin.source: What's on the menu?
Beautiful things for beautiful people.
plugin.target: 漂亮的飾品得配上美人才行。

plugin.source: Let see what adornments I might have available...
plugin.target: 看看我賣的這些首飾吧。

plugin.source: I've got some wonderful jewelry.
plugin.target: 我有些非常漂亮的珠寶。

plugin.source: Oh, a bit of this and a bit of that.
Trinkets, odds and ends, that sort of thing.
plugin.target: 飾品，一些小物件，之類的東西。

plugin.source: Some may call this junk. Me, I call them treasures.
plugin.target: 有些人可能會說我賣的都是垃圾，而我會說它們是寶貝。

plugin.source: Just what you see here.
plugin.target: 你看到的都是準備賣的。

plugin.source: Everything I've got on display, really.
plugin.target: 我的東西都在貨架上了，真的。

plugin.source: See for yourself.
Spells and incantations for those with the talent to cast them.
plugin.target: 為那些擁有魔法天賦的人們準備的法術和咒語。

plugin.source: So, you wish to master the arcane arts...
plugin.target: 哦，你想要掌握奧法的藝術……

plugin.source: Hmph. I had you figured for a mage. I think you'll appreciate this...
plugin.target: 嗯。我想你是一位法師。我想你可能會喜歡……

plugin.source: Clothes and raiment for the discerning customer.
plugin.target: 為眼光獨到的客人所準備的衣服。

plugin.source: Breeches, gowns... clothes for any occasion, really.
plugin.target: 馬褲，長服……任何場合穿的衣服都有。

plugin.source: Let's see if we can't find an outfit that suits you.
plugin.target: 看看能不能找到適合你的穿著。

plugin.source: Take a look.
I gathered some plants that are useful for making potions, but I have other goods as well.
plugin.target: 我收集了一些用來製作藥品的植物，但我還有其他的商品。

plugin.source: Among other things, I have some fresh bread I baked this morning and vegetables from Finna's garden.
plugin.target: 有今天早上剛出爐的麵包，還有從芬娜花園裡摘來的蔬菜。

plugin.source: Mostly things from the village or the land around it. Have a look.
plugin.target: 大多是村莊或是周邊土地自產的。看看吧。

plugin.source: Fruit, fresh off the boat! The freshest in Skyrim!
plugin.target: 剛運來的新鮮水果，全天霜最新鮮的水果！

plugin.source: Get your fresh fruit and produce here!
plugin.target: 來這裡看看新鮮水果和農產品吧！

plugin.source: Apples, tomatoes, leeks and cabbages! Fresh and ripe!
plugin.target: 新鮮熟透的蘋果、番茄、蔥還有捲心菜！

plugin.source: Fresh fish! Fresh fish!
Fresh Fish! Straight from the Fjords!
plugin.target: 新鮮的魚，從海灣剛剛運來的！

plugin.source: The finest fish, here! Caught daily!
plugin.target: 物美價廉，剛撈上來的鮮魚，過來看看吧！

plugin.source: Spiced Wine to warm the blood!
plugin.target: 香料葡萄酒，讓你熱血沸騰！

plugin.source: Keep the cold at bay with our Spiced Wine!
plugin.target: 香料葡萄酒，使你遠離寒冷侵襲。

plugin.source: Spiced Wine, the taste of home and hearth!
plugin.target: 香料葡萄酒，居家暖爐邊的最佳選擇！

plugin.source: I've got weapons for givin', and armor for gettin'!
Arms and armor! Forged by a master craftsman!
plugin.target: 武器和裝甲！由工匠大師所製造！

plugin.source: A coin or two for a veteran? It's not much to ask...
plugin.target: 給老兵施捨一兩個硬幣吧？不是很過分的要求吧……

plugin.source: You know you can afford a septim or two.
plugin.target: 你可以給個一塊兩塊的嘛。

plugin.source: Lookee here. Looks like we got ourselves a hero.
plugin.target: 看看啊。這裡來了個英雄不是嗎？

plugin.source: You picked a bad time to get lost, friend.
plugin.target: 你迷路迷得可真不是時候啊，朋友。

plugin.source: You'll be so much easier to rob when you're dead...
plugin.target: 等你死了我再從你身上扒走所有的東西……

plugin.source: Can't wait to count out your coin...
plugin.target: 我迫不及待的想要細數你的金幣了……

plugin.source: If you need any jewelry, just let me know.
plugin.target: 如果你需要什麼珠寶，儘管告訴我。

plugin.source: Is it cold in here? I should put more wood on the fire...
plugin.target: 感覺冷嗎？我應該添點兒柴火……

plugin.source: You should stop by my farm if you get a chance. See what life's really about.
plugin.target: 你要是有機會，該來我的農場裡看看，看看真正的生活應該是什麼樣子。

plugin.source: Keep your eyes open for those Stormcloak dogs, yeah?
plugin.target: 注意那些風暴斗篷走狗，聽到了嗎？

plugin.source: Remember, fresh fruit and vegetables every day. Mostly.
plugin.target: 記得，這裡每天都有新鮮蔬果。大多種蔬果都有喔。

plugin.source: Thanks for the business.
I've really got to be going.
Back to my book...
Damn it, I lost my page...
plugin.target: 該死，我把我的書弄丟了……

plugin.source: Stay sharp.
Don't forget to check inside the shop if you need anything.
plugin.target: 如果你需要什麼東西，別忘了去店裡看看。

plugin.source: Thanks for the business.
You always keep us in mind when you need a fresh horse, yeah?
plugin.target: 你需要一匹新馬的時候總是想起我們，對吧？

plugin.source: I'd like to rent a room. (<Global=RoomCost> gold)
plugin.target: 我想要租個房間。（<Global=RoomCost>枚金幣）

plugin.source: Have a good rest. It's the big room with the double bed.
plugin.target: 好好休息吧。那可是間有雙人床的大房間。

plugin.source: I'll rent Tiber Septim's room. (<Global=RoomCost> gold)
plugin.target: 我想租泰伯·賽普汀的房間。（<Global=RoomCost>枚金幣）

plugin.source: Sure thing. It's yours for a day.
plugin.target: 當然可以，這房間今天是屬於你的。

plugin.source: What does this look like, the Temple of Mara? No gold, no bed.
plugin.target: 你當我這裡是什麼，瑪拉的神殿嗎？沒錢，就別想住在這裡。

plugin.source: Long life to you, Thane.
plugin.target: 願您平安健康，男爵大人。

plugin.source: I am your sword and your shield.
plugin.target: 我願為你赴湯蹈火，在所不辭。

plugin.source: Honor to you, my Thane.
plugin.target: 願榮耀與您同在，男爵大人。

plugin.source: What do you need, my Thane?
Honored to see you again, my Thane.
plugin.target: 很榮幸又能見到您，男爵大人。

plugin.source: It was nice to meet you.
Thanks for your business.
Imperial bastard.
Support Ulfric or die trying. There's nothing in between.
plugin.target: 順烏弗瑞克者昌，逆烏弗瑞克者亡，沒有折中選擇。

plugin.source: Farewell.
Sure, leave. Not like you care anyway.
plugin.target: 當然，走吧，反正你也不在乎。

plugin.source: I see I still have much to learn. Lead on.
plugin.target: 我發現要學的還有很多，帶路吧。

plugin.source: I have ore to sell.
I have corundum ore to sell.
plugin.target: 我有些金剛砂礦石要賣。

plugin.source: I have ebony ore to sell.
I have gold ore to sell.
I have iron ore to sell.
I have malachite ore to sell.
I have moonstone ore to sell.
I have orichalcum ore to sell.
I have quicksilver ore to sell.
I have silver ore to sell.
Mining is hard work, but we pay a fair price for any ore you dig up.
plugin.target: 挖礦是很辛苦的工作，不過我們會以合理的價格收購你所挖到的礦石。

plugin.source: Are you looking to work? The mines are nearby. You bring me ore, I'll give you coin.
plugin.target: 你在找工作嗎？附近有個礦坑，你給我礦石，我給你金幣。

plugin.source: I have wheat to sell.
We could always use help picking crops if you need a few extra coins.
plugin.target: 如果你想賺點錢的話我們可以雇你為我們收莊稼。

plugin.source: Umm... are you in trouble? Is that why you're hiding like that?
plugin.target: 呃……你遇到了什麼麻煩？那是你躲起來的原因嗎？

plugin.source: You remind me of the Shadowscales, from the old histories.
plugin.target: 你讓我想起了古老歷史中的影鱗。

plugin.source: Are you playing hide and seek?
You, my friend, need practice...
Are you a member of the College, or did you just steal those robes from a real wizard?
plugin.target: 你是學院的成員，還是從學院的成員那裡偷到這件袍服的？

plugin.source: You must be one of those wizards. From the College in Winterhold.
plugin.target: 你肯定是一個來自冬駐學院的法師。

plugin.source: Wow! Look at that robe. Are you a wizard?
plugin.target: 嗚喔！瞧瞧這身袍服。你是法師嗎？

plugin.source: Those are College of Winterhold robes, aren't they?
plugin.target: 這是冬駐學院的袍服，對不對？

plugin.source: Fancy robes. You a wizard or something?
plugin.target: 真是漂亮的袍服，你是不是一個法師？

plugin.source: I like your robes. Are you a sorcerer? From the College?
plugin.target: 我喜歡你這身的袍服。你是個術士？來自學院？

plugin.source: Go away.
A traitor right up to the end.
Not right now.
Oooh... pretty colors.
What a display of color!
Oh, such colors!
Is that magic? Careful, please...
Oh, look at the colors!
Wow! Look at all the colors!
Colorful...
Whoa.
Brilliant!
Keep that magic away from me.
Well hey, that's not something you see every day.
plugin.target: 呃……嘿！那可不是你每天都能看到的！

plugin.source: Magic is for the weak. Pick up some steel if you want to fight me.
plugin.target: 法術只有弱者才會用。找件武器我們比劃比劃。

plugin.source: You stop that! I will not be violated by some... half-Septim magician!
plugin.target: 快停下！我不想被……半個賽普汀魔法師侵犯！

plugin.source: Can we talk later?
I still can't believe he knew what he was doing when he opened that gate...
plugin.target: 我仍然無法相信他知道他正在做什麼，當他打開那扇門的時候……

plugin.source: Roggvir... Why did it have to be like this?
plugin.target: 羅吉維爾……為什麼會這樣呢？

plugin.source: They should have drawn it out some more. He deserved a slower death.
plugin.target: 他們應該再多拖延一下的，不該讓他死的那麼痛快。

plugin.source: I guess it's all over. I expected... I don't know what I expected.
plugin.target: 我想這一切都結束了。我期望……我不知道我該期望什麼。

plugin.source: A man opens a gate and they cut his head off? Doesn't seem right to me.
plugin.target: 一個男人開了門，而他們把他的頭砍了下來？似乎不對勁。

plugin.source: That's definitely going in my part of the Edda.
plugin.target: 這絕對會成為我詩文的一部分。

plugin.source: Shhhhhh...
Follow me. I need your help.
plugin.target: 跟著我。我需要你的幫助。

plugin.source: Lead the way.
Lead on, Thane. My blade is always yours to command.
plugin.target: 請帶路，男爵。我隨時聽候您的差遣。

plugin.source: Excellent. Lead on, Thane.
Good. My place is by your side, Thane.
plugin.target: 好的，我會在您身邊，男爵。

plugin.source: I'm right behind you.
You already appear to have someone with you.
plugin.target: 看起來你已經尋找到夥伴了。

plugin.source: Time to die, hero!
Die already so I can take your stuff!
plugin.target: 去死吧，你的東西我要了！

plugin.source: Even if that battle is with a dragon?
Can any man hope to be ready for a dragon?
plugin.target: 誰會希望準備好去迎戰一頭龍？

plugin.source: I can but hone their skills and harden their hearts. The rest is up to the gods.
plugin.target: 我只能磨練他們的技巧、堅實他們的內心。除此之外就只能聽天由命了。

plugin.source: You're the Dragonborn aren't you?
I'm sort of hoping you're going to fight the dragons for us. A normal man is no match for a dragon.
plugin.target: 我有點想要你幫我們和那些龍戰鬥。一個普通人可是戰勝不了龍的。

plugin.source: I'll get back to court business, then.
plugin.target: 那麼，我要回去處理宮廷事務了。

plugin.source: I must return to the court. They simply can't make do without me.
plugin.target: 我必須回宮廷去。他們不能沒有我。

plugin.source: Stop back anytime.
Come back to Bits and Pieces anytime.
plugin.target: 歡迎下次再來光臨零珠碎玉。

plugin.source: Make sure to recommend us to your associates.
plugin.target: 一定要向你的同伴推薦我們哦。

plugin.source: Return anytime you need arms or armor. My forge never rests.
plugin.target: 要買武器護甲就來找我。我從不歇工。

plugin.source: I have firewood to sell.
Honest gold for honest work.
plugin.target: 黃澄澄的獎勵給真正做事的人。

plugin.source: Make yourself useful and chop up some firewood. There's a few coins in it for you.
plugin.target: 幹點活吧，去劈柴，我會付報酬的。

plugin.source: If it's work you need, how about chopping up some wood for the fires?
plugin.target: 如果你要找工作，去劈點柴怎麼樣？

plugin.source: Here for work? Get an axe and bring me all the wood you can chop.
plugin.target: 來找工作？找把斧頭，把你能劈的木頭都拿來。

plugin.source: I managed to recover an Eye of the Falmer.
plugin.target: 我設法找到了一顆法莫之眼。

plugin.source: I'm eleven years old, and I could take you.
plugin.target: 我十一歲了，我可不怕你。

plugin.source: If you're here to purchase, I have many spells available. Do come in.
plugin.target: 如果你是想買東西，我這裡有些法術賣。快進來吧。

plugin.source: Welcome, welcome. There are many things here that cannot be found elsewhere.
plugin.target: 歡迎、歡迎。很多東西你在別處是買不到的。

plugin.source: Ah. Good to have a customer! You need food or drink, you say the word.
plugin.target: 啊，有生意真好！要吃要喝，儘管直說。

plugin.source: Always good to see folk come back for more. You need a drink, you just let me know.
plugin.target: 有回頭客總是好的。想喝酒儘管告訴我。

plugin.source: It's down the stairs, dear. Just come right in.
Oh, do come in! I hope I have what you need.
plugin.target: 噢，進來吧！但願我有你需要的東西。

plugin.source: The Mortar and Pestle makes potions, if you can't tell from the name. Just step up to the counter.
plugin.target: 臼和杵子是用來做藥劑的，如果你從名字上分不清它們，就到櫃檯這來吧。

plugin.source: I'm kind of busy, but if you need any potions or ingredients, let me know.
plugin.target: 我有點忙，但如果你需要任何藥劑，或者煉金材料，儘管告訴我。

plugin.source: I'll be over here if you need any potions or ingredients.
plugin.target: 如果你需要任何藥劑或者藥材，我就在這裡。

plugin.source: Hello there, can I pour you a Black-Briar Mead?
plugin.target: 你好，能給你倒杯黑荊棘蜂蜜酒嗎？

plugin.source: Ah good, back for some more Black-Briar Mead, eh?
plugin.target: 啊很好，又回來喝黑荊棘蜂蜜酒了嗎，嗯？

plugin.source: Welcome to the Pawned Prawn. Come on in, take a look around.
plugin.target: 歡迎來到典當小蝦，進來四處看看吧。

plugin.source: Welcome back to the Prawn. Let me know if you need anything.
plugin.target: 歡迎回到典當小蝦，需要什麼就請告訴我。

plugin.source: Let me know if you see anything you like.
plugin.target: 如果你看上了什麼就請告訴我。

plugin.source: Take a good look around. I'm sure you'll find what you're looking for. If not, let me know, I might have it stored away.
plugin.target: 四處好好看看吧，我肯定你能找到你想要的。如果找不到，那就跟我說，也許我把它們收起來了。

plugin.source: Got something for just about everybody in here. Give a holler if you have any questions.
plugin.target: 我這裡的貨一應俱全哦。想買什麼，就招呼一聲。

plugin.source: She's okay. A little breathy and a little harsh on the notes.
plugin.target: 她還不錯啦。就是有點底氣不足，音符有些刺耳。

plugin.source: I could listen to her play all day.
Are your sales going well?
I hope the Divines have been keeping you well.
Hey, ugly!
Hey, slug-breath!
Hey, skeever butt!
Hey, cheese brain!
Hey, melon nose!
Hey, troll bait!
Thanks, Aia. That means a lot.
Glad to hear it, Aia.
plugin.target: 聽到這話我真高興，艾雅。

plugin.source: None of what he collected tasted as good as your Spiced Wine, Evette.
plugin.target: 他收藏的那些酒都沒有你這香料葡萄酒好喝，愛芙緹。

plugin.source: I'm still finding your Spiced Wine to be the best drink I've ever tasted.
plugin.target: 你的香料葡萄酒絕對是我嘗過的所有酒裡最好喝的。

plugin.source: Shiny trinkets for your good lady! All crafted by the great Eorlund Gray-Mane himself!
plugin.target: 閃亮的首飾，專為您的佳人所準備！全部出自偉大的厄倫德·灰鬃之手！

plugin.source: Bits and baubles for sale, all crafted by the best blacksmith in Skyrim.
plugin.target: 販售馬銜和各類小玩意兒，全出自天霜最好的鍛匠之手。

plugin.source: If you have need of hunting supplies then you've come to the right place.
plugin.target: 想買狩獵用品，那你可是來對地方了。

plugin.source: We sell bows, arrows and ale. A unique combination, to be sure.
plugin.target: 我們這裡出售弓箭，還有烈酒。這組合很與眾不同吧。

plugin.source: I'll be happy to assist you if you'd like to purchase something.
plugin.target: 你想買什麼？我很樂意幫忙。

plugin.source: I can tell you're no stranger to the wilds. I'm sure we can meet your hunting needs.
plugin.target: 看得出來您一定常在野外遊蕩。我們這裡賣的東西肯定能符合您的需求。

plugin.source: We've got arms and armor of all kinds.
plugin.target: 我們這裡有各式各樣的武器和護甲。

plugin.source: You look like someone who knows how to wield a weapon. Well, you've come to the right place.
plugin.target: 您看起來就是個善用武器的人哪。哎呀，那您可來對地方了。

plugin.source: If it's armor you need, we've got all kinds, both light and heavy.
plugin.target: 你想要護甲，我們這裡很多，輕甲重甲，應有盡有。

plugin.source: Everything you see here was made with skill and care by my wife Adrianne.
plugin.target: 這裡的每一件東西都是我妻子阿德琳妮精心製作的。

plugin.source: Please, do look around. I'm sure I have something you'll want.
plugin.target: 請隨便看看，我相信您一定能找到自己想要的東西。

plugin.source: I can tell you're a discriminating customer. Perhaps you're a wealthy one, too, hm?
plugin.target: 看得出來您很有挑剔。您一定很有錢吧？

plugin.source: Everything's for sale, my friend! You need visit no other shops today!
plugin.target: 這裡的商品應有盡有，朋友！您今天就別去其他店鋪了！

plugin.source: I assure you, I'm prepared to make any deal.
plugin.target: 我向你保證，我這裡絕對包您滿意。

plugin.source: You'll find tonics, salves, poultices and potions on my shelves. Browse to your heart's content.
plugin.target: 我的貨架上可有各種補品、藥膏、敷劑和藥水。請您隨便挑。

plugin.source: I offer remedies for ailments both common and rare. Do let me know if I can be of service.
plugin.target: 我這裡賣的藥專治各種疑難雜症。需要我服務的話儘管說。

plugin.source: If there's anything I can help you with, you have but to ask.
plugin.target: 如果有什麼幫得上忙的，你儘管開口。

plugin.source: I sell cures for all ills, and I'll be happy to serve you.
plugin.target: 我這裡有賣各種救命良藥，而我也樂意為您服務。

plugin.source: Get on with it.
Stormcloak lover.
Traitor!
Vampire! Burn it!
Vampire! To arms!
Burn it! Burn the vampire!
plugin.target: 燒死它！燒死這個吸血鬼！

plugin.source: Vampire!
May your road lead you to warm sands.
plugin.target: 願你的道路引領你至溫暖的沙地。

plugin.source: I hope that you will come to do business with us again.
May the sun keep you warm even in this land of bitter cold.
plugin.target: 即便在這片嚴酷寒冷的土地上，也願太陽為你帶來溫暖。

plugin.source: Until our next meeting, if such is fated.
plugin.target: 如果命運如此安排，那我們後會有期了。

plugin.source: I hope you will find a warmer welcome in your travels than we have found in ours.
plugin.target: 願你在旅途上所得到的對待比我們更溫暖順遂。

plugin.source: The roads of Skyrim can be treacherous. If you must walk them, be wary.
plugin.target: 天霜的道路相當地不平靜。如果你非得要旅行，請多加小心。

plugin.source: Call upon me if I can be of any service.
plugin.target: 有需要我效勞的請儘管開口。

plugin.source: Browse as much as you like, please.
Look around all you want, but don't try anything funny.
plugin.target: 請隨便看，但不要做傻事。

plugin.source: Hey! You planning to steal something? Don't even think about it.
Steal anything from my shop, and you'll regret it.
plugin.target: 要是敢從我店裡頭偷東西，我讓你吃不完兜著走。

plugin.source: Be seein' you, stranger.
Come and see me again sometime. I might have some use for you.
plugin.target: 有空再來看看我。我也許能幫得上你的。

plugin.source: We're done here, I think.
plugin.target: 看來我們在這裡的事情已了。

plugin.source: I'm a Thane? What does that mean?
The Jarl has recognized you as a person of great importance in the hold. A hero.
plugin.target: 領主視你為領地中的重要人物。一個英雄。

plugin.source: The title of Thane is an honor, a gift for your service. Guards will know to look the other way, if you tell them who you are.
plugin.target: 男爵的頭銜是種榮耀，對你所作貢獻的嘉獎。衛兵要是得知你是男爵，他們對你都會睜一眼閉一眼的。

plugin.source: Welcome to the Vilemyr Inn. If there's anything I can get you, just let me know.
plugin.target: 歡迎來到爛醉如泥旅店。想要什麼儘管開口。

plugin.source: Finally, someone comes in. Kick off your boots, stay awhile. Let me know if there's anything I can help you with. I got nothing but time these days.
plugin.target: 終於終於，來客人了。把靴子脫掉吧，稍坐片刻。有什麼需要的就告訴我。我有的是時間。

plugin.source: Come on in. The Silver-Blood Inn has plenty of strong drink and clean rooms.
plugin.target: 快請進。銀血旅店有上好的烈酒以及乾淨的房間。

plugin.source: Ah, a visitor. Old Hroldan Inn has hundreds of years of history, friend.
plugin.target: 啊，一個顧客。朋友，歡迎來到百年老店古赫洛登旅店。

plugin.source: If you've got the coin, you've come to the right place. Pull up a seat.
plugin.target: 這裡歡迎有錢的主兒。請隨便坐吧。

plugin.source: Come on in. Let me know if you need anything, or take a seat by the fire and I'll send someone over.
plugin.target: 快請進。需要什麼儘管開口，或者到火爐旁坐下，我會叫人過去招呼您。

plugin.source: Come on in. Just stoked the fire. Take a seat and get the cold out.
plugin.target: 快請進。到火爐那邊吧，坐一會兒驅散身上的寒氣。

plugin.source: Welcome. Let me know if you want anything... think I got a clean mug around here somewhere.
plugin.target: 歡迎。想要什麼就跟我說……應該還有個乾淨杯子收著的。

plugin.source: Come on in. We got warm food, warm drinks, and warm beds.
plugin.target: 快請進。我們這裡有溫熱的食物、美酒，以及溫暖的床鋪。

plugin.source: There's still the threat of a dragon attack.
plugin.target: 我們仍然面臨巨龍襲擊的威脅。

plugin.source: And we've done as much as we can to prepare for that.
plugin.target: 我們已經作好了充分的準備。

plugin.source: But remember, Whiterun is home to the Companions. Any dragon that comes here will get more than he's bargained for, I think.
plugin.target: 不過要記住，白漫城是戰友團的根據地。什麼龍敢來這裡惹事的話，我們會讓它吃不了兜著走。

plugin.source: You must have your hands full with the change in government.
plugin.target: 你一定是忙著在跟政府做交換吧。

plugin.source: Well, it could be worse. The former steward, Proventus, kept very detailed records.
plugin.target: 可能會更糟的。前任管家普羅萬圖斯作了極其詳細的記錄。

plugin.source: But yes, it's been a lot of work. Vignar doesn't want the change to disrupt the lives of his people. They've got enough to deal with already.
plugin.target: 不過也是，是費了很大功夫。維吉納不想讓這個改變干擾他同胞的生活。他們的麻煩已經夠多了。

plugin.source: I hope we bump into each other again.
plugin.target: 希望我們有機會再見面。

plugin.source: I have nirnroot to sell.
I have cabbage to sell.
I have gourds to sell.
I have leeks to sell.
I have potatoes to sell.
Auriel's Bow will be mine!
plugin.target: 奧瑞爾之弓將會是我的！

plugin.source: Find your own thrall. This one's mine.
plugin.target: 找你自己的奴僕，這個是我的。

plugin.source: Heard they're reforming the Dawnguard. Vampire hunters or something, in the old fort near Riften. Might consider joining up myself.
plugin.target: 聽說有人正在重組黎明守衛，好像是吸血鬼獵人還是什麼的組織，地點在裂谷城附近的老舊堡壘。我在考慮加入他們。

plugin.source: Oh wow. This is gorgeous.
I'm glad you're here with me.
I'll remember this.
It's like from the stories I used to hear... the two adventurers seeing the world.
plugin.target: 這就像我經常聽到的故事……兩個冒險家看遍全世界。

plugin.source: I never knew it would be this beautiful.
plugin.target: 我從來都不知道，這是如此地美麗。

plugin.source: It'll be good to get out of the sun for a while.
plugin.target: 遠離太陽片刻是很不錯的。

plugin.source: Good, let's get inside there. The sun is starting to get to me.
plugin.target: 很好，我們進去吧。太陽已經快找上我了。

plugin.source: Another cave. I've spent enough time underground, myself, but if you want to go in, I'm right behind you.
plugin.target: 又是洞窟。雖然我自己是受夠了待在地底下，但如果你要進去的話，我還是會跟著你。

plugin.source: Is this a dwarven city? I can't believe they'd let it get so run down.
plugin.target: 這是矮人的城市？真不敢相信它們會變得如此地荒廢。

plugin.source: I always wondered what the dwarves actually looked like. I hear they're like elves, but with beards.
plugin.target: 我一直想知道矮人實際上看起來像什麼。我聽說他們跟精靈很像，不過有蓄著山羊鬍。

plugin.source: So this is the grand tour of Skyrim's caves that you're showing me?
plugin.target: 所以你是要為我進行天霜地方的洞穴遊學活動囉？

plugin.source: You will not leave this valley alive!
Death to those who defile the Chantry!
plugin.target: 殺死那些玷汙教團的人！

plugin.source: That's a fine looking animal you've got there. I had a dog once. Kept getting fur in my mead.
plugin.target: 你帶了很好看的動物。我以前有養過一條狗，牠常常會把身上的毛弄到我的蜂蜜酒中。

plugin.source: What kind of beast is that? No law against it, but if that thing starts attacking people, it's getting a sword in the gullet.
plugin.target: 這是什麼野獸？應該要有法律禁止牠，不然難保牠何時會開始攻擊人類，這簡直就像拿著劍抵著喉嚨。

plugin.source: I'm so hungry...
I await your orders, Thane.
Is it time to move out?
I await your command, Thane.
Yes, my Thane? Do you need something?
plugin.target: 男爵大人，請問有何需要？

plugin.source: What do you need, Thane?
What is it, Thane?
I'll stand guard here.
Be careful, Thane.
I'll wait for you here.
Lead on, my Thane.
I'll follow your lead, Thane.
Onward, then.
I'll give you this warning only once. Stay out of my way, and we'll do just fine.
plugin.target: 我只警告你一次。別妨礙到我，我們就相安無事。

plugin.source: Clumsy oaf!
Watch out! My equipment is fragile.
Careful with that thing!
Am I supposed to be frightened?
Try putting yourself back together now.
I could almost admire these Dwemer machines if they weren't so annoying.
plugin.target: 我真的很欣賞這些鍛莫機械，只可惜它們太惱人了。

plugin.source: Another one for the scrap heap of history.
plugin.target: 這隻也拆了當成垃圾吧。

plugin.source: What do you have for sale?
Well, take a look at what I have and maybe we can make a deal.
plugin.target: 你看看我的貨物，也許我們能夠做成交易。

plugin.source: If you've got something to sell, I'm willing to buy. Why don't we see what kind of deal we can make?
plugin.target: 你願意賣，我就願意跟你買。讓我們試著達成交易吧？

plugin.source: If the quality's right, I'll take those off your hands. Let me take a look.
plugin.target: 品質好的話我就跟你買。我先來看看。

plugin.source: Got the best merchandise on the island. Have a look for yourself.
plugin.target: 我的商品是整座島最好的。你可以自己檢視一下。

plugin.source: What do you have for sale?
Just got some of my merchandise off the latest supply ship. See if anything strikes your fancy.
plugin.target: 我的商品都是最新運來的物資。看看有沒有你喜歡的。

plugin.source: What do you have for sale?
All sorts of useful things. Feel free to browse.
plugin.target: 各種有用的東西。可以多看看。

plugin.source: What do you have for sale?
You must leave this place!
There are so many delightful ways I've pictured you dead.
plugin.target: 你要是死了，生活該會變得多麼的美好啊。

plugin.source: We're one of the same kind, you and I. I'm glad to have met you.
plugin.target: 你和我，我們是同一類人。很高興能認識你。

plugin.source: Azura's wisdom to you, friend.
plugin.target: 願阿祖拉的智慧指引你，我的朋友。

plugin.source: Filth. Run to the horizon before I hunt you down.
plugin.target: 賤人。在我發作之前給我消失。

plugin.source: I'm not going to warn you again.
Stop that.
Watch it!
Hey, be careful!
I'm on your side!
What are you doing?
Sheogorath take fools like you, put that down.
plugin.target: 謝爾格拉斯專門收你這種傻子。把那放下來。

plugin.source: Death does not diminish.
Boethiah devour you. Get out of here!
plugin.target: 波耶西亞吞噬你。給我滾出去！

plugin.source: Weren't expecting this, were you?
You're bleeding!
Not impressed!
You're nothing!
I need you to do something.
What do you have in mind?
No. Never mind.
You're the boss.
Yes. Let me show you.
Very well.
Did you still want me to help you or not?
I need to trade some things with you.
plugin.target: 我想要跟你交換些東西。

plugin.source: If it'll help us get moving quicker, sure.
plugin.target: 要是可以讓我們加快腳步的話，沒問題啊。

plugin.source: Follow me.
About time. Let's go.
Wait here.
You're going ahead without me? Suit yourself...
plugin.target: 你想要一個人先走？隨便你……

plugin.source: It's time for us to part ways.
Oh fine, go on... leave me here. When you decide to return to your senses, you know where to find me.
plugin.target: 喔，太好了，你走吧。把我一個人留在這裡。你恢復理智之後再回來找我吧。

plugin.source: So this is the fabled College of Winterhold. Amazing.
plugin.target: 原來這就是傳說中的冬駐學院啊。太神奇了。

plugin.source: I hope we don't bump into any Forsworn around here. I heard they're as wild as a pack of beasts.
plugin.target: 希望我們不會在這裡遇到拒誓者。聽說他們跟野獸沒兩樣。

plugin.source: The Pale reminds me of the northern part of Solstheim... rife with freezing cold weather and full of unfriendly creatures.
plugin.target: 蒼原讓我想到索瑟海姆的北部……冷呼呼而且充滿不友善的生物。

plugin.source: I can't believe how carelessly the dead are buried here. I can't imagine my body just rotting away like that.
plugin.target: 我不敢相信死者被如此草率地葬在這裡。要是這樣放任我的屍體腐爛的話……

plugin.source: Whiterun... the pride of Skyrim. Doesn't look like much to me. Now Blacklight on the other hand, that's a proper city.
plugin.target: 白漫城……天霜的驕傲。看起來沒什麼了不起的。不像黑光城，那才叫大城市。

plugin.source: I lived in the Gray Quarter of Windhelm for years... it's a wretched place full of bitter Dunmer. Let's be done here quickly.
plugin.target: 我在風舵城的灰民區住過好幾年……那是個可悲的地方，充斥著尖酸的丹莫。我們辦好事就快點離開吧。

plugin.source: Can you imagine what Markarth must have looked like when the dwarves were living here? I can't even begin to imagine.
plugin.target: 你可以想像以前馬卡斯城還有矮人居住時的景象嗎？我根本想像不到。

plugin.source: Solitude... home to the East Empire Company, the heartless bastards.
plugin.target: 獨孤城……東帝國貿易公司的老家，那群沒血沒淚的雜種。

plugin.source: So this is Riften. Glover Mallory told me a good deal about the place. It looks exactly as I'd pictured.
plugin.target: 原來這裡就是裂谷城。葛羅文·馬爾洛里跟我說過很多關於這裡的事情。跟我想像中的一模一樣。

plugin.source: You may want to be careful down here... the Thieves Guild makes the Ratway its home.
plugin.target: 你在這下面最好小心一點……盜賊公會的大本營就在鼠道裡。

plugin.source: Dawnstar is full of struggling miners. Sounds a lot like a certain town in Solstheim, eh?
plugin.target: 晨星城充斥著困苦的礦工。聽起來很像索瑟海姆的某座城市，對不對？

plugin.source: Ugh, what a wretched place. Who would build a town in the middle of a swamp?
plugin.target: 呃……這地方真可悲。怎麼會有人在沼澤中央建造一座城市？

plugin.source: Riverwood looks peaceful. If I had to settle in Skyrim, this might be the place I'd choose.
plugin.target: 河木鎮看起來很平靜。如果要我住在天霜，我應該會選擇這裡。

plugin.source: Vampires are wretched beings. Feeding off others the way they do... it's disgusting.
plugin.target: 吸血鬼是邪惡的生物。他們吸食血液的方式，簡直是……令人作嘔。

plugin.source: Warlocks practice all sorts of foul sorcery. We should proceed with caution.
plugin.target: 巫師熟練各種邪惡的魔法。我們前進時要小心。

plugin.source: Careful, it looks like something's lived here recently.
plugin.target: 小心，看來不久之前，曾有東西住在這裡。

plugin.source: Damn bandits are worse than the vermin that infest the ash wastes back home.
plugin.target: 該死的強盜。比老家那些住在灰燼垃圾堆裡的害蟲還糟。

plugin.source: Dragons, eh? Good, I was looking for a challenge.
plugin.target: 是龍嗎？好，我正需要挑戰。

plugin.source: There are restless dead about... I suggest we proceed with caution.
plugin.target: 這裡有不死者……前進時保持警戒。

plugin.source: Despite the foul beings that infest this place, I'm certain we'll find plenty of wealth to make it worth our time.
plugin.target: 這個地方雖然被一堆邪惡的東西給佔據了，但是我確定能找到寶物，絕對不會空手而歸。

plugin.source: The dwarves were a clever race. I wonder what happened to them?
plugin.target: 矮人是很聰明的種族。不曉得他們發生了什麼事？

plugin.source: To think the Falmer are loosely related to the Dunmer sends shivers down my spine.
plugin.target: 想到法莫跟丹莫有點血緣關係我就全身發毛。

plugin.source: Not much of a farm. How do they expect to grow anything in this ash-free soil?
plugin.target: 這座農場真不像樣。沒有灰燼他們要怎麼種植農作物？

plugin.source: The Forsworn are little more than beasts. They won't listen to reason, so prepare for the worst.
plugin.target: 拒誓者跟野獸沒什麼兩樣。他們絲毫不講道理，所以遇到的時候要做好準備。

plugin.source: Ugh, the stench. We must be nearing a giant's home.
plugin.target: 呃，這惡臭。我們快要接近巨人的家了。

plugin.source: Becoming a hagraven requires a sacrifice to their foul deity. Show them no mercy before we become one of the victims.
plugin.target: 烏鴉鬼婆會提供祭品給她們腐敗的神明。面對她們的時候千萬不可以留情。

plugin.source: I never fancied becoming a miner... didn't want to spend the rest of my days cracking rocks.
plugin.target: 我從沒想過自己會當礦工。我不想要往後的日子是在敲打礦石中度過。

plugin.source: I was briefly in the employ of an orc warrior once. I had to quit because he refused to bathe. Disgusting.
plugin.target: 我曾經被一個獸人戰士雇用。後來辭職是因為他拒絕洗澡。髒死了。

plugin.source: Nice place you have here. I never knew you were so wealthy.
plugin.target: 你這邊還真不賴。我沒想到你那麼有錢。

plugin.source: I wonder how many souls were lost when this ship met its fate.
plugin.target: 當這艘船沉下去的時候，不曉得有多少的靈魂被帶走了。

plugin.source: Spriggan are loathsome creatures. They summon some of the most benign beings of the forest and bend them to their will.
plugin.target: 樹精是令人厭惡的生物。他們會召喚樹林中最和善的生物然後扭曲其意志。

plugin.source: What would possess someone to give their allegiance to Hircine, only to see their free will taken from them like this?
plugin.target: 怎麼會有人對海爾辛宣誓效忠，只為了讓自我意識被奪走？

plugin.source: Anytime you want to head for Skyrim, I'm right with you. I've spent enough time on Solstheim to last a lifetime.
plugin.target: 你想要前往天霜的話，我一定跟你走。我在索瑟海姆已經待太久了。

plugin.source: Hope we don't run into too many ash spawn out here.
plugin.target: 希望我們在這外頭不會遇見太多凝灰鬼。

plugin.source: I'm not sure why House Redoran is so insistent on maintaining Solstheim. Seems like more trouble than it's worth.
plugin.target: 我不知道為何瑞多然家族堅持要留在索瑟海姆。看起來是在自找麻煩。

plugin.source: With the ash from Red Mountain covering half the island, it's astonishing how much Solstheim reminds me of home.
plugin.target: 紅山的灰燼覆蓋半座島嶼。索瑟海姆真的跟家鄉好像。

plugin.source: How can the Skaal stand it up here? It's freezing!
plugin.target: 斯卡爾怎麼能忍受這個地方？這裡冷死了！

plugin.source: The Telvanni are amazing. Look what they've grown from the ash... have you ever seen anything like it?
plugin.target: 泰爾瓦尼簡直是太神奇了。你看他們從灰燼中培育了什麼出來……這東西簡直太不可思議了！

plugin.source: I've called Raven Rock my home for a number of years. Azura knows why... it's a mess.
plugin.target: 我多年來把烏石鎮當成家。天知道為什麼……這裡糟透了。

plugin.source: Seems like things are looking up in Raven Rock now that the mine's open. It's a nice change.
plugin.target: 烏石鎮的礦場開了之後事情終於有點好轉。這樣真不錯。

plugin.source: I'm glad that I'm finally traveling with someone who seems competent. My last patron was killed trying to tackle an entire fort of bandits alone.
plugin.target: 我很高興我終於可以跟一個看起來能幹的人旅行。我上一個老闆堅持要單挑一整座堡壘的強盜，結果當然是被殺了。

plugin.source: I grew up in the city of Blacklight in Morrowind. If you ever get the chance, you should visit there... it's spectacular.
plugin.target: 我在塵風的黑光城長大。要是你有機會的話應該去拜訪看看……非常壯觀。

plugin.source: I don't know why I decided to make my way to Solstheim to seek my fortune. I should have stayed at home.
plugin.target: 我不曉得自己為何要前來索瑟海姆討生活。我應該留在家裡的。

plugin.source: You like my chitin armor? It was specially crafted for me by Grendis Rolovo... one of the finest master armorsmiths in Morrowind.
plugin.target: 你喜歡我的硬殼護甲嗎？這是葛蘭迪斯·羅羅佛專門幫我打造的。他是塵風最有名的護具師之一。

plugin.source: All this walking... I wish there was a silt strider around here.
plugin.target: 走了那麼多路……真希望這裡附近有一頭闊步沙蚤。

plugin.source: I wonder what became of Saint Jiub? I met him once, you know.
plugin.target: 不曉得聖徒傑布現在怎麼樣了。知道嗎，我曾經見過他本人。

plugin.source: Our journey's been quite rewarding so far. Hopefully, you won't mind sharing the spoils.
plugin.target: 我們目前的旅途還算順利。希望你不介意分擔一些重擔。

plugin.source: Follow me. I need your help.
plugin.target: 跟著我。我需要你的幫助。

plugin.source: I suppose Master Neloth won't mind. He's always telling me to get out of his way.
plugin.target: 尼洛施大師應該不會介意吧。他總是要我別礙著他。

plugin.source: Would you prefer coin instead? You just told me that you're having a hard time getting by.
plugin.target: 你更喜歡金幣嗎？ 你剛剛告訴我，你過得很艱困。

plugin.source: I'm serious. Here you go. (750 gold)
plugin.target: 我不是開玩笑，拿去吧。（支付750枚金幣）

plugin.source: No, sorry. What was it you needed help with?
plugin.target: 不是這樣的，抱歉。你想要我怎麼幫你？

plugin.source: Watch it!
Hey, be careful!
Did you hear something?
Anybody there?
Come on!
Die!
Don't fight back, and I promise I'll kill you quickly.
plugin.target: 別抵抗了，我保證會讓你死得痛快。

plugin.source: Get him!
Good enough.
Hmm. Nothing here after all.
plugin.target: 嗯。這裡確實什麼也沒有。

plugin.source: I knew I'd find you!
I knew it!
I know I heard something.
I know you can hear me!
plugin.target: 我知道你能聽得到我說話！

plugin.source: I was sure I heard something.
plugin.target: 我覺得的確聽見了些什麼。

plugin.source: I'll find you...
Mind's playing tricks on me...
Must be my imagination.
No sign of 'em.
There you are!
You're dead!
Show yourself!
You can't hide, father!
There you are, father!
You can't hide from us!
Get back here!
I know you're here somewhere.
Must be gone now.
Ran off, I suppose.
Ahh!
Ah! It burns!
I'm on fire!
Here we go.
This day was always coming!
It's time for you to suffer!
This is what your obsession brings you!
plugin.target: 這就是你所沉迷的東西帶給你來的結果！

plugin.source: Just getting jumpy I guess.
Must have been nothing.
Aha!
Last mistake.
Oh no you don't!
Oh, no you don't!
Hello? Who's there?
You're as good as dead!
Come on, show yourself!
Come on! Come on!
I'll try and make this quick!
Thought I heard something.
Bad idea.
I guess I was just hearing things.
plugin.target: 我剛才好像聽見了什麼。

plugin.source: You afraid to fight me?
Get her!
Hey!
Guess it's all clear now.
Phew!
Vampire!
All right, you want to go?
Archers!
Wizard!
Victory... for now.
We sure showed them, eh?
plugin.target: 我們鐵定讓他們好看了，對吧？

plugin.source: Gone now, I suppose.
I am sorry, but you left me with no choice.
plugin.target: 很抱歉，但是你讓我別無選擇。

plugin.source: I must have imagined it.
I thought I saw... no, surely not.
plugin.target: 我以為我看到了……不對，不可能。

plugin.source: Where did you come from?
I hope there aren't anymore.
plugin.target: 我再也沒有任何希望了。

plugin.source: You just going to stand there and take it? Fight back!
plugin.target: 你就準備傻站那裡挨揍？打回去！

plugin.source: Who's there?
Only a fool lets himself get surrounded.
plugin.target: 只有傻瓜才會讓自己被敵人包圍。

plugin.source: You can't hide from me forever.
plugin.target: 你躲得了一時，躲不了一世。

plugin.source: Cleared out, I guess.
By all the gods...
I'll be glad when this beast is gone from here.
plugin.target: 要是能把這隻野獸除掉就太好了。

plugin.source: Not again.
That's the last of them.
Now that's how it's done!
That takes care of that.
Dragon!
Teach you to mess with me.
plugin.target: 讓你知道惹我會有什麼後果。

plugin.source: That's what I thought.
You're mine!
Kill her!
Kill him!
Ahhh!
Ahhhh!
I'm going to find you.
Behold my power!
The elements are mine to command!
You cannot even conceive of the power I wield...
plugin.target: 你甚至無法想像我所掌控的力量……

plugin.source: Fire, frost, or lightning - you will suffer at my hands!
plugin.target: 火焰，寒霜，或者閃電……你將屈服於我的力量！

plugin.source: Don't you see? I am master of the arcane!
plugin.target: 看到了嗎？我是秘法的掌控者！

plugin.source: Must've scared 'em off.
Wait...
How dare you!

plugin.target: 如果你只是想爽一下，去找愛芙緹弄幾杯香料葡萄酒吧。

plugin.source: It's nice to know someone admires me for more than just my appearance.
plugin.target: 很高興能有人不是因為我的相貌才稱讚我。

plugin.source: Nothing like a good adventure or romance to lose yourself in.
plugin.target: 沒有什麼比一段傳奇的冒險或者浪漫的愛情更能讓你投身的了。

plugin.source: People are having nightmares they swear are real. They go to bed, but they wake up more tired than yesterday.
plugin.target: 人民遭受著真正的噩夢。人們一覺醒來，卻發現身子比昨日更加疲憊。

plugin.source: The war is tearing the land apart, the dragons have returned seeking who knows what... Skyrim is going nowhere fast.
plugin.target: 戰爭踐踏著這片大陸，龍也回來了，也許……天霜很快就會變成廢墟。

plugin.source: Too few remember to honor the god of the dead. Do not be one of those.
plugin.target: 太多的人不懂得塔洛斯的榮耀。別成為他們之中的一人。

plugin.source: Well, looks like you're fitting in well down here.
plugin.target: 啊，看來你很適應這裡的生活。

plugin.source: Fight well, don't be a lout, and you'll be fine.
plugin.target: 好好戰鬥，別魯莽行事，你就會過得很不錯。

plugin.source: If you want to embarrass yourself, I won't stop you.
plugin.target: 如果你想出糗，我不會阻止你。

plugin.source: Since Torygg's death, Falk Firebeard wields the true power of the Jarl's court.
plugin.target: 自從托依格死後，他在宮廷裡就沒什麼實權了。

plugin.source: Talos, who in life was knows as Tiber Septim, united Tamriel and founded the Empire.
plugin.target: 塔洛斯，凡人時期名叫泰伯·賽普汀。他統一了泰姆瑞爾並建立了帝國。

plugin.source: The Empire's elven puppetmasters never cared much for the idea of a human becoming a divine. So the worship of Talos is outlawed.
plugin.target: 帝國的幕後主使——精靈從來都不喜歡一個凡人被尊為神。所以他們取締了對塔洛斯的崇拜。

plugin.source: Looking to stay alive? You should talk to Balimund over at the Scorched Hammer.
plugin.target: 在找保住小命的方法嗎？你該去「滾燙鍛錘」跟巴利穆德談談。

plugin.source: They pay a good wage for any iron ore you dig up, if you're looking for work.
plugin.target: 如果你幫我們挖鐵礦石出來，他們會給你不錯的報酬。

plugin.source: This is the only temple in Skyrim that can openly worship Talos.
plugin.target: 這是天霜唯一公開祭拜塔洛斯的廟。

plugin.source: A little friendly advice - take a bath and get some new clothes.
plugin.target: 友情提示：去沖個澡換身衣服吧。

plugin.source: Absolutely disgusting.
I should get over to Windhelm more. See how the other Morrowind refugees are getting along.
plugin.target: 我得儘快忘掉風舵城。看看塵風的其他難民是怎麼和睦相處的。

plugin.source: Most of the Nords living in Windhelm don't care much for us.
plugin.target: 風舵城大多數諾德人都不怎麼關心我們。

plugin.source: Most people in Skyrim don't care for Dunmer.
plugin.target: 天霜的大部分人都不關心丹莫。

plugin.source: Powerful men have many enemies. More so, in times of strife.
plugin.target: 有權有勢的人樹敵眾多，尤其是在動亂的時候。

plugin.source: Some fresh meat to fill your belly perhaps?
plugin.target: 要來點鮮肉填飽您的肚子嗎？

plugin.source: The only way to find fresher meats is to hunt it yourself.
plugin.target: 除非你親自跑去打獵，否則是找不到比我這裡更新鮮的肉的。

plugin.source: You looking for something?
Congratulations on getting the festival restored.
Have you performed your voice exercises today?
My darling, you've made me a happy woman. I wouldn't want to be with anyone else in the world.
plugin.target: 親愛的，你把我變成了最幸福的女人。這個世上我只願跟他一起。

plugin.source: My husband, are we still meeting later for... combat training?
plugin.target: 老公，我們待會還會來場……戰鬥訓練嗎？

plugin.source: There's nothing like a good song to lift the spirit in troubled times.
plugin.target: 在困難的時候，沒有比一首美妙的歌更能鼓舞人的精神了。

plugin.source: Does your Skyrim ever get warm, husband?
plugin.target: 老公，天霜這邊暖和過嗎？

plugin.source: Eorlund works the Skyforge. He's a marvel with steel.
plugin.target: 厄倫德在天際鍛爐工作。他是鍛鐵的天才。

plugin.source: Fresh fish sounds like just the thing today.
plugin.target: 今天有鮮魚還真是不錯呢。

plugin.source: Here to be a Companion?
High King Torygg's death has turned the whole town on its head.
plugin.target: 至高王托依格的死將整個城市搞得天翻地覆。

plugin.source: Hmm. Reminds me of the standing stones back home.
plugin.target: 嗯、這讓我想起老家（天霜）的那些立石。

plugin.source: I often wonder where we'd be if the dwemer were still around.
plugin.target: 我常想，要是鍛莫沒有消失，那我們會身在何處。

plugin.source: If you want rumors, you should talk to Corpulus.
plugin.target: 如果你想聽傳言，就應該和科普盧斯談。

plugin.source: I'm proud of what we've managed to accomplish.
plugin.target: 而我對於我們成功實現這一點感到自豪。

plugin.source: Laila is a simple and traditional woman.
plugin.target: 萊拉是個單純而傳統的女人。

plugin.source: Many battles have been fought here over the centuries.
plugin.target: 千百年來這裡上演了無數場戰爭。

plugin.source: One thing everyone can agree on. This war is bad for business.
plugin.target: 每個人都同意一件事：戰爭有害商業。

plugin.source: People laugh at things they don't believe. It helps them accept the unknown.
plugin.target: 人們會嘲笑自己不懂的事情。他們藉此才能適應未知。

plugin.source: Riften is drowning in a sea of sin and wickedness.
plugin.target: 裂谷城淹沒在罪孽與邪惡之海中。

plugin.source: See anything useful?
plugin.target: 看到任何有用的東西了嗎？

plugin.source: Someone's been busy.
There's something... wrong here.
Why have you never taken a wife?
You should think about staying the night.
plugin.target: 你應該考慮考慮在這過夜。

plugin.source: You're a good man, my Thane. We're lucky to have you watching over us.
plugin.target: 你是個好人，男爵。有你為我們禱告祈福是我們的幸運。

plugin.source: Bandits are cowards.
If you're looking for a room, you'll want the Four Shields.
plugin.target: 如果你想找住宿的話，你應該去四盾牌。

plugin.source: Many noble Jarls and renowned warriors asked to be buried here.
plugin.target: 有很多貴族領主和著名英雄都要求埋在這裡。

plugin.source: You're bloated with disease.
You look rather pale.
You look rather pale. Could be Ataxia.
plugin.target: 你看起來臉色真蒼白。可能是運動失調症的緣故。

plugin.source: A truly remarkable place, isn't it?
plugin.target: 真是不可思議的地方，是吧？

plugin.source: Nothing tastes better than food you've grown yourself.
plugin.target: 沒有比自己親手種出來的食物更可口的東西了。

plugin.source: Solitude wouldn't be the same without the Fire Festival.
plugin.target: 沒有火焚節的話獨孤城就不再是獨孤城了。

plugin.source: They say these walls show the history of the ancients who built this place.
plugin.target: 有人說這些牆上記載的是建造這裡的古人的歷史。

plugin.source: If you've got an axe, you can always make gold chopping wood.
plugin.target: 如果你有一把斧頭，你總能砍些木頭來賺點錢。

plugin.source: Beware of Frostmere Crypt, friend. Heard some bandits are living in the ruins now.
plugin.target: 小心寒沼墓穴。聽說有群強盜盤踞在那處廢墟中。

plugin.source: If it's a bed you need, talk to Keerava in the Bee and Barb. She'll set you right.
plugin.target: 如果要住宿，去「蜂與鉤」找基拉瓦。她會好好安頓你的。

plugin.source: These wall carvings are ancient.
I keep thinking I see something moving in the shadows...
plugin.target: 我一直在懷疑自己是不是看到了一些東西，在陰影裡穿梭的東西……

plugin.source: The strongholds keep to themselves. Skyrim hasn't always been kind to the Orcs.
plugin.target: 屯砦的位置只有他們知道，因為天霜的人對獸人並不太友善。

plugin.source: You should talk to Ainethach. He runs the mines.
plugin.target: 你去和艾尼塔克談談吧，他經營著礦場。

plugin.source: Every Orc learns the heavy labor of mining. All spend years in the caves.
plugin.target: 每個獸人都學習挖礦的勞力工作。都在洞裡一待好幾年。

plugin.source: It is said that an Orc first learns to wield a hammer in her mother's womb.
plugin.target: 據說，獸人在母親子宮裡就開始學習如何掄錘子了。

plugin.source: It will be a good day. I can feel it in my gut.
plugin.target: 一定會是美好的一天。我有這種直覺。

plugin.source: Poisons can kill your enemies faster than any blade.
plugin.target: 毒藥能比任何兵刃更快置敵人於死地。

plugin.source: Shuftharz can forge you some armor.
plugin.target: 舒夫薩茲能替你鍛造護甲。

plugin.source: A smart warrior keeps a potion to cure diseases at all times.
plugin.target: 聰明的戰士祛病藥劑絕不離身。

plugin.source: Do not allow Ataxia to fester.
plugin.target: 別讓運動失調症快速惡化。

plugin.source: You should see Sharamph, if you need a cure or a poison.
plugin.target: 如果你需要藥劑或毒劑，去找沙拉菲。

plugin.source: Perhaps I'll join the Legion one day, as my father had done.
plugin.target: 也許我有一天能追隨父親的腳步，加入軍團。

plugin.source: Only a true Orc knows how to temper Orichalcum properly.
plugin.target: 只有真正的獸人才知道如何正確地給山銅回火。

plugin.source: Murbul knows many poisons and cure if you need them.
plugin.target: 莫布林知道很多毒藥和解藥。

plugin.source: Orc poisons are to be feared, if you wish to trade.
plugin.target: 如果你想交易的話，獸人的毒藥是值得畏懼的。

plugin.source: You should see Gharol if you're looking for a blade or armor.
plugin.target: 如果需要刀或者護甲的話，去找加洛爾吧。

plugin.source: Do you miss your days training at the college?
plugin.target: 你懷念在學院裡受訓的日子嗎？

plugin.source: Even if we can't openly worship him, Talos the god was once Tiber Septim the man, and this is his empire.
plugin.target: 即使我們不能光明正大地擁戴他，神明塔洛斯曾經是人類泰伯·賽普汀也是個不爭的事實，而這是他的帝國。

plugin.source: I haven't found my special someone yet, but there's still hope.
plugin.target: 雖然我還沒找到合適的人，旦希望仍在。

plugin.source: I just can't wait to be a bride someday. Someday...
plugin.target: 我急切期待某一天我也能當新娘。某一天……

plugin.source: I'm still finding Spiced Wine to be the best drink I've ever tasted.
plugin.target: 香料葡萄酒絕對是我嘗過的所有酒裡最好喝的。

plugin.source: Salmon sounds good today. How about you?
plugin.target: 鮭魚，聽起來不錯，你覺得呢？

plugin.source: There's nothing quite like a good vegetable.
Would like to buy a lady a drink?
plugin.target: 你能請一位女士喝一杯嗎？

plugin.source: You can buy me whatever you want!
I prefer Dibella's teachings myself.
plugin.target: 我個人比較喜歡迪貝拉的教誨。

plugin.source: If you're looking for potions you should talk to Angeline Morrard.
plugin.target: 如果你在尋找藥劑，你可以與安吉靈·莫蘭德談談。

plugin.source: If you're not interested in music or drink, you can at least talk to Corpulus. He can fill you in on any of the latest gossip.
plugin.target: 如果你對聽歌喝酒不感興趣，可以去找科普盧斯聊天，他會告訴你最新的八卦傳聞。

plugin.source: I could listen to her play all day.
I could listen to him play all day.
If you want a real drink, try the Cornerclub in the Gray Quarter.
plugin.target: 如果你想喝到真正的酒，去試試灰色居住區的街角吧。

plugin.source: Vampires are clever hunters.
plugin.target: 吸血鬼可是個機靈的獵人。

plugin.source: The Fear spell has saved the life of many an Illusion mage.
plugin.target: 懼逃術挽救了許多幻象系法術師的性命。

plugin.source: The Flame Atronach is vital companion for anyone relying on Conjuration.
plugin.target: 對於依靠於召喚系的人，烈焰屬靈是他們重要的夥伴。

plugin.source: The Magelight spell is useful to any mage.
plugin.target: 魔光術對任何法師都很有用。

plugin.source: The College is an asset to Skyrim, even if it goes unnoticed or unappreciated.
plugin.target: 學院是天霜的一大標誌，雖然很多人都沒有意識到這一點，甚至對此心懷怨恨。

plugin.source: All I know is that the sap makes you feel as healthy as a cave troll, but slow as a drunk horker.
plugin.target: 我知道的就是這棵樹的汁液會讓你感覺和洞穴三眼巨猿一樣健壯，但實際上卻是和一頭喝醉的海象一樣行動遲緩。

plugin.source: I hope you're enjoying the music, ma'am.
plugin.target: 我希望你喜歡這音樂，女士。

plugin.source: I hope you're enjoying the music, sir.
plugin.target: 希望你能喜歡這音樂，先生。

plugin.source: All the miners, farmers, and laborers in the Reach get their daily wages through the Silver-Blood family.
plugin.target: 所有的礦工、農民、和整個邊峪的耐力勞動者也是透過銀血家族拿工資的。

plugin.source: Oh, darling. You know you're the only stone-biting, knuckle-dragging Nord for me.
plugin.target: 哦，親愛的。你知道對我來說，你是唯一一個又蠢又笨的諾德人。

plugin.source: Do you have anything... exotic? Something no other woman would be wearing.
plugin.target: 你有什麼……外國貨嗎？是其他女人沒見過的新鮮貨。

plugin.source: Have you ever been to Darkwater Crossing? Terrible name for such a beautiful place.
plugin.target: 你到過黑水渡橋嗎？這麼個漂亮地方起這麼個爛名字。

plugin.source: Honest gold for honest work. If you're ever interested.
plugin.target: 真金獎勵給真正做事的人，要是你有興趣的話。

plugin.source: I just want to find a good husband, and start a family of my own.
plugin.target: 我只想找個好丈夫，然後建立自己的家庭。

plugin.source: I still can't believe it. Married, to the Dragonborn. Never would have guessed it.
plugin.target: 我真是不敢想信，與龍裔結婚啊。這絕對令人意想不到。

plugin.source: I wonder what happens when a customer can't afford to pay for a meal or a drink?
plugin.target: 我在想當一個顧客付不起一頓飯或者一杯酒的錢時，會怎樣勒？

plugin.source: Is lavender and herb or a poison? Hmm...
plugin.target: 薰衣草是良藥還是毒藥？嗯……

plugin.source: It's thousands of years old. Who knows what we might find?
plugin.target: 這裡已有上千年歷史了。誰知道我們能找到什麼？

plugin.source: I've heard that shadowy figures are being seen coming in and out of the Black Door. Gods help us.
plugin.target: 我聽說有鬼祟的身影在那黑門裡進進出出。神啊救救我們。

plugin.source: I heard they live their entire life without uttering a single word; can you even imagine?
plugin.target: 我聽說他們可以活一輩子卻一個字也不說；你能夠想像嗎？

plugin.source: Nirnroot grows only by the water and makes a unique chiming noise.
plugin.target: 奈恩根生長於水邊，會發出一種獨特的聲響。

plugin.source: Please stop looking at me like that. I'm so embarrassed.
plugin.target: 請別這樣看著我，我會很尷尬的。

plugin.source: Some wine, please?
That's disgusting.
The Bunkhouse isn't an inn. I'd recommend the Bee and Barb.
plugin.target: 工棚不是旅店。我建議你去「蜂與鉤」。

plugin.source: There's no better way to face the cold Skyrim nights than with a belly full of ale.
plugin.target: 沒有比灌上一肚子啤酒更好地消磨天霜冰冷長夜更好的方法了吧。

plugin.source: There's no better way to face the cold Skyrim nights than with a warm body to lay with.
plugin.target: 沒有比暖被更好地消磨天霜冰冷長夜更好的方法了吧。

plugin.source: These Khajiit make a living traveling the roads and selling their wares.
plugin.target: 那些凱季特人四海漂泊，就靠沿路兜售他們的貨物為生。

plugin.source: This is a little creepy.
plugin.target: 這裡有點讓人毛骨悚然。

plugin.source: We Nords are strong, and we're as tough as stone.
plugin.target: 我們諾德人很強壯，而且身體堅若磐石。

plugin.source: Whatever you do, stay away from that Black Door. Being near it chills you to the bones.
plugin.target: 不管你做什麼，離那個黑門遠遠的。只要離它近一點，你就會感到透骨的寒意。

plugin.source: When the Stormcloaks took control of Whiterun, it was a victory for all true Nords.
plugin.target: 當風暴斗篷掌控白漫城的時候，曾是所有諾德人的驕傲。

plugin.source: You know, this is one of a very few places where you can receive a real education in the schools of magic.
plugin.target: 你知道，這裡是僅存的幾處能好好學習魔法的地方。

plugin.source: Are you my gallant hero? Have you come to whisk me away, to a life of adventure and romance?
plugin.target: 你是我的大英雄嗎？你是來帶我離開這裡，開始浪漫的冒險生涯的嗎？

plugin.source: Everyone needs work, right?
If you want to hide out in Riften, the Ratway's where you'd be.
plugin.target: 如果你想在裂谷城中藏身，鼠道是個好地方。

plugin.source: It's a new day in Windhelm. The Stormcloaks are gone, and so is their prejudice.
plugin.target: 這是風舵城嶄新的一天，風暴斗篷帶著他們的偏見離開了。

plugin.source: Madesi. One of the few traditional Saxhleel Jewelers that remains in Tamriel; it's becoming a lost art.
plugin.target: 瑪德希是一名泰姆瑞爾大陸上為數不多的正宗薩喀瀝爾寶石匠，其手藝算是瀕危藝術了。

plugin.source: So long as my love is happy, I'm happy.
plugin.target: 只要我的寶貝高興，我也會高興的。

plugin.source: Stay alert.
The Nords don't like anybody who's not a Nord, but they're not bad people, deep down.
plugin.target: 諾德人不喜歡任何非諾德人，但是他們本質不壞，真的。

plugin.source: The only thing colder than Skyrim is the Nords themselves.
plugin.target: 唯一比天霜還冰冷的是諾德人本身。

plugin.source: The Shadowscales are all but forgotten. An ancient tradition, from another time.
plugin.target: 影鱗幾乎被人們遺忘，那是來自另一個時代的古老種族。

plugin.source: Trust me, marsh-friend. You do not want to live in this city.
plugin.target: 相信我吧沼澤朋友，你不會想要生活在這個城市裡的。

plugin.source: You'll be able to run circles around those big, slow brutes in heavy armor.
plugin.target: 你將學會如何與那些穿著重甲，與大又蠢的傢伙周旋。

plugin.source: Be careful around the burial stones.
If I find anyone working against my wife, I'll beat them to death with their own severed head.
plugin.target: 如果讓我知道有人敢對付我妻子，我會讓他身首分離而死。

plugin.source: Romantic, isn't it?
Do not spare them your blade.
If the Empire and the Stormcloaks want to kill each other over some foolish cause, I say let 'em.
plugin.target: 如果帝國跟風暴斗篷為了某些愚蠢的理由想要互相殘殺，我得說隨他們去吧。

plugin.source: Show them no mercy.
The Companions welcome anyone with the heart of a warrior.
plugin.target: 戰友團歡迎任何內心渴望成為戰士的人。

plugin.source: 7,000 steps indeed... next time they need to build it closer to the ground...
plugin.target: 實際上，有7000臺階……下次他們應該修得更近點……

plugin.source: Bloodsuckers. Vampires. Take every precaution. One bite, and you could end up as one of them.
plugin.target: 都是些噬血者。也就是吸血鬼。要做好萬全保護，否則只要被咬一口，你就落得跟他們一樣的下場。

plugin.source: Careful of the molten metal. That gets on you, kiss your fingers goodbye.
plugin.target: 當心鐵水。如果不小心碰到了，你的手指就拜拜了。

plugin.source: I do not like fish.
I've heard of stealing things from people, but never thought you could steal someone's mind.
plugin.target: 我有聽過偷東西，但是我真的沒想到連心智都可以偷。

plugin.source: Looking for something?
Nothing like the smell of a white-hot blade, eh?
plugin.target: 沒有什麼比燒紅的刀刃更美麗的了，不是嗎？

plugin.source: Nothing but a bunch of lowly bandits.
plugin.target: 只是一些差勁的強盜罷了。

plugin.source: Tread lightly.
Ysgramor was the hero who started the Companions.
plugin.target: 伊斯格拉謨是創立戰友團的英雄。

plugin.source: The restless dead. Not pretty.
plugin.target: 是一些沒有安息的死屍。現在還未發生問題。

plugin.source: The Forsworn. Unpredictable, unknowable, and dangerous. Be careful.
plugin.target: 拒誓者是難以預料，也無法預料的，所以相當危險。千萬小心。

plugin.source: Rouge wizards. I've never trusted magic types. The College is bad enough. Destroy them.
plugin.target: 是些流浪法師。我從不相信這些耍魔法的，有學院在就夠糟的了。除掉他們。

plugin.source: What weapon do you like, Harbinger?
plugin.target: 你喜歡什麼武器，先驅者？

plugin.source: The tenacity of the Imperial Legion is legendary.
plugin.target: 帝國軍團出了名的頑強。

plugin.source: The Forsworn. This was their city once. They won't stop until we're all dead.
plugin.target: 是拒誓者。這裡曾經是他們的城市，他們想殺光我們！

plugin.source: Always coin to be made killing off some Forsworn in the hills.
plugin.target: 想要賺錢一般得去滅掉山裡的拒誓者。

plugin.source: The Silver-Bloods. They have a whole mine filled with prisoners to dig up silver ore, get smelted by workers they pay, and they own half the city.
plugin.target: 是銀血家族。他們有整整一座礦的犯人再挖銀礦，礦石由他們雇人熔煉。他們擁有半座城。

plugin.source: It's surprising the Council is allowing a Nord to rule Riften under the Imperial flag. That can't be their first choice.
plugin.target: 議會居然讓一個臣服於帝國的諾德人治理裂谷城，太令人驚訝了。那肯定是他們的權宜之計。

plugin.source: Selection looks very delicious. I'll take an apple.
plugin.target: 看起來很好吃啊，我要一個蘋果。

plugin.source: You look like you could use a drink.
A man who feels no fear has no heart. I know fear. But it does not control me.
plugin.target: 一個沒有心靈的人也會無視恐懼。我知道恐懼，但不會被恐懼所控制。

plugin.source: We are the true spirit of Skyrim. Honor is in our blood. Death in our hearts.
plugin.target: 我們是真正的天霜精神代表，我們的血液裡流淌著尊嚴之血，我們的內心視死如歸。

plugin.source: What kind of weapon do you prefer?
I've heard that dragons have been seen in the skies over Morrowind. I'll believe it when I see it for myself.
plugin.target: 聽說有人在塵風的天空看見龍。我要親眼看到才會相信。

plugin.source: Keep your eyes to the ground. Ash spawn like to spring up from nowhere.
plugin.target: 眼睛最好緊緊盯著地面，以防那些凝灰鬼冷不防跳出來。

plugin.source: They're saying that the dragons have returned. As if we didn't have enough to worry about already.
plugin.target: 有人說龍回來了。我們的煩惱還不夠多嗎？

plugin.source: I am at a loss for words.
Damn if I ain't almost sober.
plugin.target: 該死的，我要是能清醒才怪呢。

plugin.source: Got any ale or mead?
Hey, you don't look so good...
I want to go fight something.
I'm not much use at labor or learning, but I can throw a punch with the best of them.
plugin.target: 雖然做工、學習都不在行，但我揮出的拳頭可不比人差。

plugin.source: It is damnably cold out here.
plugin.target: 這裡的外面可是冷得要死。

plugin.source: No breaks for a good worker out here.
plugin.target: 這裡優秀的工人都不休息。

plugin.source: Oh, the fruit looks so good. So juicy.
plugin.target: 噢，這些水果看起來美味又多汁。

plugin.source: There's not enough drinking in the world today, wouldn't you agree?
plugin.target: 你不覺得現今這世界很難喝到什麼好酒了嗎？

plugin.source: What does a fellow need to do to get a drink around here?
plugin.target: 難道在這裡想找點喝的還得做些什麼？

plugin.source: When I have troubles, I always have someone on my side. Thanks to you. Friend.
plugin.target: 當我身陷危險之時，總有人陪伴在我左右。感謝你。我的朋友。

plugin.source: When you can just take what you want, there's no need to lie.
plugin.target: 當你能想要什麼就得到什麼，就沒有撒謊的必要了。

plugin.source: You can smell the honey on the wind.
plugin.target: 你能聞到隨風飄來的蜂蜜香味。

plugin.source: It seems like every farmer is Skyrim is short on supplies these days.
plugin.target: 這段日子似乎天霜的每個農民都缺乏供給。

plugin.source: Got a loving wife, what more could a man ask for.
plugin.target: 我有一個可愛的妻子，我還需要奢求什麼呢？

plugin.source: My wife's a good woman. She can be a little hard-headed sometimes, but I love her just the same.
plugin.target: 我妻子是個好女人。她有時候會變得有點頑固，但是我還是一樣的愛她。

plugin.source: Most bandits are cowards. These seem to be braver than most.
plugin.target: 大多數的強盜都是懦夫。但這些人看起來要比大多數都勇敢。

plugin.source: There is no greater madness than those who seek to become vampires. That's a dark bargain if there ever was one.
plugin.target: 沒有比那些想成為吸血鬼的人更瘋狂的了。如果有什麼交易的話那可真夠黑暗的。

plugin.source: I've half a mind to dismantle one of these Dwemer machines. I'd like to see how it works.
plugin.target: 我有點兒想拿一個這些鍛莫造的機械拆了。想看看它是怎麼運作的。

plugin.source: I suppose the warmth in this place comes from all the hot steam vents.
plugin.target: 我想這裡的熱量都是從熱蒸汽閥裡出來的。

plugin.source: These timber supports are rotted through. It's a wonder this place is still standing.
plugin.target: 這些木質支柱都爛透了這地方還沒倒真是神奇。

plugin.source: Check every crate, chest and barrel you see. Who knows, maybe a few of them have something valuable inside.
plugin.target: 搜一下你能看到的所有板條箱，寶箱和桶。天曉得，說不定他們留了些寶貝在裡面。

plugin.source: Did you bring a torch? These old forts can get pretty dark inside.
plugin.target: 你帶了火炬嗎？這種古老的要塞會很陰暗。

plugin.source: There are forts like this all over Skyrim. The Imperials abandoned most of them a long time ago.
plugin.target: 天霜還有很多這樣的要塞，大多數都是很多年前帝國軍所遺棄的。

plugin.source: At times like this, I truly appreciate the joys of a warm fire and a stiff drink.
plugin.target: 這時候，我能深切體會到有一團溫暖的火和熱飲是多好的事情。

plugin.source: Not for all the gold in Skyrim would I spend my life working in these tunnels.
plugin.target: 就算給我整個天霜的金幣我也不想挖這些坑道。

plugin.source: I've heard that miners sometimes die from poisonous gases trapped beneath the ground.
plugin.target: 我聽說有時礦工會死於地下的毒氣。

plugin.source: I'm already looking forward to getting above ground.
plugin.target: 我一直很期待回到地上。

plugin.source: The Dwemer created so many wondrous machines, and yet nobody ever followed in their footsteps. Why is that, I wonder?
plugin.target: 鍛莫創造了這麼多神奇的機械，為什麼沒有人追隨他們的腳步呢？我想知道為什麼。

plugin.source: Among other things, the Dwemer were expert trap-makers. Watch the floor for tripwires and false plates.
plugin.target: 鍛莫尤其善於製造陷阱。當心地上的拌網和機關觸發板。

plugin.source: Fighting draugr is as much about controlling your fear as anything else.
plugin.target: 和屍鬼對抗關鍵在於和你的恐懼作鬥爭。

plugin.source: These wizards are mad beyond reason. They understand only violence.
plugin.target: 這些法師瘋得不可理喻。他們只懂暴力。

plugin.source: You can easily break a blade on the metal skin of a Dwemer construct.
plugin.target: 劍在鍛莫的機械上一砍就斷。

plugin.source: This cold is unbearable. It's all I can do not to shiver until my teeth rattle.
plugin.target: 冷得受不了啦。我拼命控制著不發抖，直到我牙齒都打顫了。

plugin.source: Would it be foolish to stop for a while and light a fire? I suppose it would.
plugin.target: 停下來生個火會不會是個餿主意呢？我想是的吧。

plugin.source: Gods willing, we'll find a chest full of gold in one of these chambers.
plugin.target: 一切順利的話，我們會在其中一個洞穴找到滿滿一箱的金幣。

plugin.source: You know what I miss the most right now? Fresh air.
plugin.target: 你知道我現在最想念什麼對吧？新鮮空氣。

plugin.source: Remember to check behind you every once in a while. Who knows what might try to sneak up on us.
plugin.target: 記著時常看看你背後。誰知道什麼東西會襲擊我們。

plugin.source: Keep your eyes open for traps. Old ruins like this are usually filled with them.
plugin.target: 小心陷阱，像這樣的古老的遺跡通常都會有。

plugin.source: The ancient Nords were a savage people, but they built some remarkable crypts and temples.
plugin.target: 古諾德人是群野蠻的傢伙，但他們建造了不少雄偉的地穴和神殿。

plugin.source: There's a lot of history in place like that. I bet these walls could tell some amazing stories.
plugin.target: 像這樣的地方都有豐富的歷史。我打賭這些牆壁有著源遠流長的故事。

plugin.source: Nothing refreshes the soul like an honest day's labor in good, tilled earth.
plugin.target: 沒什麼能比在這肥沃的土地裡工作一整天更能讓人愉悅的了。

plugin.source: My wife. How I was ever able to meet such a gorgeous creature is one of life's mysteries.
plugin.target: 我的妻子啊！能遇見如此美麗的尤物是我生命中的奇跡。

plugin.source: Khajiit is always watching for thieves and pickpockets.
plugin.target: 凱季特人總是警惕著盜賊與小偷。

plugin.source: Do you think there's treasure here?
plugin.target: 你覺得這裡會有寶物嗎？

plugin.source: (shivers)... The wind blows bitter cold in this place.
plugin.target: （顫抖）……這個地方真是寒風凜冽啊。

plugin.source: Who knows what we might find in here.
plugin.target: 天知道我們會在這裡發現什麼。

plugin.source: You know, there might be gold somewhere in here.
I'm betting bodies. Lots and lots of bodies. And maybe some valuables...
plugin.target: 我打賭是屍體。不計其數的屍體，沒準有些值錢的……

plugin.source: All this talk of dragons returning to the world makes me more than a little nervous.
plugin.target: 到處都有龍出現的消息，聽得我心慌啊。

plugin.source: Don't try blocking if you have two weapons. You will only get confused. Much better to hit twice anyway.
plugin.target: 如果你雙持武器的話不要試圖格擋。你只會使自己暈頭轉向。總之，打對方兩次比格擋要好得多。

plugin.source: Ah, Moon Sugar.
Let us hope that if there are dragons, there are only a few and they are not too foul-tempered.
plugin.target: 還是祈禱即使有龍，也只有少數幾頭，而且脾氣也不要特別暴躁。

plugin.source: Skyrim could not be more different from Elsweyr. But magic... magic is the same no matter where you go.
plugin.target: 天霜和艾斯維爾可謂天差地別。不過魔法嘛……魔法到哪裡都是一樣的。

plugin.source: Skyrim is filled with all manner of dangerous beasts.
plugin.target: 天霜到處都有危險的野獸。

plugin.source: The dragons and the war have scared many other traders away, but for those with courage, there is much profit to be made.
plugin.target: 龍族和戰亂確實讓很多商人望而卻步，但對於有勇氣的人來說，這樣反而能賺的更多。

plugin.source: These Nords have no love for us. They look upon us and see only thieves and smugglers.
plugin.target: 這幫諾德人不喜歡我們這種人，在他們眼裡我們就是小偷跟走私者。

plugin.source: A word if advice, my friend -- do not mix gambling and drink. Taken together, they will empty your pockets of every septim.
plugin.target: 朋友，給你提個建議——不要既喝酒又賭博。如果你這樣做了，很快你的錢包就空了。

plugin.source: The wise trader finds the best opportunities, even if he must travel far to find them.
plugin.target: 明智的商人總會嗅到最佳的商機，即使需要跋山涉水也無所謂。

plugin.source: We are creatures of the desert. The north wind chills us to the bones.
plugin.target: 我們是沙漠的孩子，北風對我們來說太冷了些。

plugin.source: Everyone knows General Tullius wields the real power in Solitude.
plugin.target: 人人都知道圖留斯將軍在獨孤城裡掌管大權。

plugin.source: Hows about we figure out some way to keep warm tonight?
plugin.target: 我們想想今晚用什麼辦法保持暖和吧？

plugin.source: I promised to keep you safe and I'm not going to break my word.
plugin.target: 我答應過要保護你的安全，而我一定會堅守諾言。

plugin.source: I wouldn't stay here long if I were you.
plugin.target: 換做是我，我就不會久留於此。

plugin.source: I'll have some mead.
Lisette's a fine lass.
Men aren't good or bad. They're just men.
plugin.target: 人無好壞之分，只是人而已。

plugin.source: Need a room? Maybe a drink? See old Hulda, she'll take care of you.
plugin.target: 要住宿？還是要喝的？去找老胡爾妲吧，她會好好地招呼你。

plugin.source: So, when are you going to get yourself a woman?
plugin.target: 那麼，你什麼時候再給自己找個女人呢？

plugin.source: Something just ain't right about that Sybille.
The bard's got talent, I'll give him that.
plugin.target: 那位詩人有才能，我會把那個給他。

plugin.source: The sunrise is almost as pretty as you are.
plugin.target: 旭日初升的美景和你的臉龐一樣迷人。

plugin.source: The Reach is a beautiful but dangerous place, eh? One false step and you'll fall to your death, that is if those Forsworn don't get you first.
plugin.target: 邊峪是一個美麗，但卻兇險的地方，是吧？只要走錯一步就死定了，當然前提在那之前沒被拒誓者捉到。

plugin.source: Have you seen those Briarheart men? That's some evil magic right there.
plugin.target: 你沒看到那些荊棘之心的人嗎？他們那可都是些邪門歪道。

plugin.source: A warrior expects nothing, and therefore is ready for anything.
plugin.target: 戰士什麼都不期待，所以什麼都不畏懼。

plugin.source: Until we know the limits of our courage, we don't really know ourselves.
plugin.target: 知道自己勇氣的極限在哪，才算是真正了解自己。

plugin.source: This city is corrupt. Rotten to the core.
plugin.target: 這座城市墮落了！你們都墮落了！

plugin.source: Too bad we can't read these carvings. Who knows what secrets we'd uncover?
plugin.target: 很遺憾我們讀不懂這些刻上去的文字。否則天知道我們會發現什麼秘密？

plugin.source: These old ruins... My father always told me to stay away from them. Good advice, I'd say.
plugin.target: 這些古老的遺跡……我父親總是讓我遠離這些地方。我說，最好聽我爸爸的話。

plugin.source: Ah, the air is good today. I welcome the smell of blood from all the kills I will make.
plugin.target: 啊，今天天氣不錯。我渴望嗅到獵物的血腥味。

plugin.source: An Elder Scroll is an instrument of immense knowledge and power.
plugin.target: 上古卷軸是一種蘊含浩瀚知識與強大力量的工具。

plugin.source: I'm eager to prove my skills today.
It's a fine day to work the mines.
plugin.target: 今天是進礦場工作的好日子。

plugin.source: Many Orcs leave the stronghold to join the Legion. They welcome our skill in battle and smithing, and we welcome a chance to see the world.
plugin.target: 很多獸人離開屯砦加入軍團。他們很歡迎我們高超的戰鬥技巧和鍛造技術，而我們很高興有機會看看世界增廣見聞。

plugin.source: Need a poison for your hunting? Murbul knows several.
plugin.target: 打獵需要毒藥嗎？莫布林知道好多毒藥種類。

plugin.source: Need a poison for your hunting?
Serving in the Legion taught me to respect leadership.
plugin.target: 在軍團中服役教會我服從命令。

plugin.source: There is a freedom the roads give you that the stronghold does not.
plugin.target: 有種自由是只有旅途能給你，而屯砦所不能給的。

plugin.source: You need steel? Speak to Gharol.
plugin.target: 你需要鋼鐵嗎？去找加洛爾談談吧。

plugin.source: Your muscles have grown strong from the metal shaping!
All this knowledge might have been lost, were it not for you.
plugin.target: 要不是你在，所有這些智慧的結晶就都付之東流了。

plugin.source: Have you seen their eyes? They don't have any! Gross.
plugin.target: 你見過他們的眼睛嗎？他們沒有眼睛！真噁心。

plugin.source: You will be remembered for generations for this.
plugin.target: 你的貢獻將為後世所銘記。

plugin.source: Every Orc learns the heavy labor of mining. All spend years in the caves.
plugin.target: 每個獸人都學習挖礦的勞力工作。都在洞裡一待好幾年。

plugin.source: The Code of Malacath. It is both tradition and law in the strongholds. Break the code, and you must pay Blood Price.
plugin.target: 瑪拉凱斯的戒律。在屯砦裡既是傳統又是法律。只要破壞了規矩，就得血債血償。

plugin.source: It is said that an Orc first learns to wield a hammer in his mothers womb.
plugin.target: 據說，獸人在母親子宮裡就開始學習如何掄錘子了。

plugin.source: It will be a good day. I can feel it in my gut.
plugin.target: 一定會是美好的一天。我有這種直覺。

plugin.source: There's a wicked shadow over this place.
plugin.target: 這個地方被一種邪惡的陰影所籠罩著。

plugin.source: Your muscles ripple when you work the forge. It's pleasing.
plugin.target: 你打鐵使上了力氣。我很滿意。

plugin.source: The strongholds keep to themselves. Skyrim hasn't always been kind to the Orcs.
plugin.target: 屯砦的位置只有他們知道，因為天霜的人對獸人並不太友善。

plugin.source: "Dragonborn" huh? Was it your ma or your pa that was the dragon?
plugin.target: 「龍裔」嗎？那麼你爸還是你媽是龍？

plugin.source: I understand what potions do, but I don't always understand how they do it.
plugin.target: 我知道藥劑的作用，但不知道它是如何起作用的。

plugin.source: Too bad we can't read these carvings. Who knows what secrets we'd uncover?
plugin.target: 很遺憾我們讀不懂這些刻上去的文字。否則天知道我們會發現什麼秘密？

plugin.source: Can we go somewhere else, please? I am embarrassed.
plugin.target: 我們可以去別的地方，好嗎？這裡讓我很尷尬。

plugin.source: It's nice to be back in a friendly spot, huh?
plugin.target: 回到熟悉友好的地方感覺不錯吧？

plugin.source: The fall forest makes me miss my childhood; playing among the towering trees in Valenwood and living with my brethren.
plugin.target: 秋天的森林讓我想起了兒童時期；和我的同胞生活在威木的高大樹木中。

plugin.source: Trees... they're beautiful here.
Such a fine day, smell the air! Isn't it wonderful?
plugin.target: 美好的一天啊，聞聞空氣中的味道！這一切不是很美好嗎？

plugin.source: You should talk to Ainethach. He's in charge.
plugin.target: 你去和艾尼塔克談談吧，他是負責人。

plugin.source: We all come into Arkay's light in the end, but there's no need to rush.
plugin.target: 我們早晚都會去見阿爾凱的，但不用著急。

plugin.source: Ah, Camilla. Fair as the morning sun.
plugin.target: 啊，卡蜜拉，如清晨的陽光般美麗。

plugin.source: If it's horses you want, you'll want to speak to Hofgrir at the stables.
plugin.target: 如果你想要馬匹，去馬廄那裡與霍夫圭爾談談吧。

plugin.source: Our stock of arrows is running a bit low.
You should try the venison.
Draugr. Dammit. I hate those things.
plugin.target: 屍鬼，該死的。我討厭那些怪物。

plugin.source: Spriggans. Ugh.
Be careful, friend. This place doesn't seem too... forgiving.
plugin.target: 小心，朋友。這地方看來不太……對勁。

plugin.source: Stick close. This place gives me the creeps.
plugin.target: 跟緊點。這地方讓我毛骨悚然。

plugin.source: These old ruins... They don't want us here, the ancient ones. Better left alone.
plugin.target: 這些古老遺跡……它們不希望我們造訪，還是別靠近比較好。

plugin.source: Leave and never come back!
Door's over there. Why don't you use it?
You should leave. Now.
Finally. I got stuff to do, ya know.
plugin.target: 終於，我有事情做了，你懂的。

plugin.source: We done?
You're a damn fool.
I consider this conversation over.
plugin.target: 我認為此次對話已經結束。

plugin.source: Idiot...
Yeah, whatever.
Foreigners. What a nuisance!
Don't sass me, little girl.
Just... leave us. Please.
Crawl back into whatever swamp you came from, lizard man.
plugin.target: 可以爬回你原先待著的沼澤裡，蜥人。

plugin.source: Now, shove off.

plugin.source: I've collected some of the Edda for you.
plugin.target: 我收集到了一些詩文要給你。

plugin.source: Take your time. I shall follow you when you are ready.
plugin.target: 你慢慢來。等你準備好我就會跟著你。

plugin.source: We can proceed when you are ready.
plugin.target: 你準備好之後我們就繼續前進。

plugin.source: We will not forget what you have done.
Amazing to think they built this so long ago; still it survives.
plugin.target: 他們那麼久以前建造的東西居然還能存活，真是了不起啊。

plugin.source: Be careful...
Good.
Hmm. I do not like this place.
plugin.target: 唉，我一點都不喜歡這地方。

plugin.source: I do not think that is wise.
I understand. Walk with the All-Maker, Dragonborn.
plugin.target: 我能理解。追隨萬物之始，龍裔。

plugin.source: Impressive!
Interesting. This may be worth exploring.
Let us go.
It is rather impressive.
Ready yourself.
Thank you.
The Skaal have always avoided ruins such as these. Nothing of the All-Maker is to be found within.
plugin.target: 斯卡爾一直以來都迴避這類廢墟。裡頭完全沒有萬物之始的創作存在。

plugin.source: Very well, if you need my help, seek me out here in the village.
plugin.target: 好吧，如果你需要我的幫助，就來村莊找我。

plugin.source: We must be careful in these ruins.
plugin.target: 在這些廢墟裡我們必須格外小心。

plugin.source: You. You've ruined everything!
Oh, no you don't!
Oh, I know who you are. Don't be so surprised.
plugin.target: 哦，我知道你是誰了。別這麼吃驚。

plugin.source: Gah! The Forsworn. Madanach. Dead!
plugin.target: 嘎！邁德納奇，就是那個拒誓者，死了！

plugin.source: Now I'm going to have to kill you!
I'll have your head!
What?!
Why you...
We'll see about that!
You must be joking?!
Ha ha! Are you kidding me?
The Reach will ours again!
plugin.target: 邊峪領將再次回歸我們手中！

plugin.source: How dare you!
I'm going to put you down!
You know, I think you're right.
Sigh. You win.
What? Fine. Here.
Indeed.
As you will.
Have it your way, then. But if you need me, just give the order.
plugin.target: 那隨你吧。但如果你有需要，就儘管開口。

plugin.source: For the Forsworn!
Glory to the Forsworn!
Stop hiding, coward. I'll make it quick, I promise.
plugin.target: 別再躲了，懦夫。牙一咬就過了，我答應你。

plugin.source: Sigh. What is it?
Enough of this!
Listen you impudent cur.
plugin.target: 你這無禮的混蛋給我聽好了。

plugin.source: I'm going to put you down!
You liar!
You're nothing!
Not impressed!
Enough! I yield! I yield!
Please... mercy...
Mercy!
I value my life, you know.
plugin.target: 你要知道我很懂得珍惜自己的性命啊。

plugin.source: I'll kill you!
I don't have time for this.
Excuse me?
I don't understand...
With Madanach gone, what's left to fight for?
plugin.target: 邁德納奇已經不在了，還打什麼呢？

plugin.source: Madanach couldn't kill me and neither can you.
plugin.target: 邁德納奇殺不死我，你也一樣。

plugin.source: Another Forsworn? I'll gladly kill you myself. Come on!
plugin.target: 其他的拒誓者？我很樂意動手殺死，來吧！

plugin.source: You don't stand a chance of killing me and you know it.
plugin.target: 你很清楚，你根本沒機會能殺死我。

plugin.source: Kill me? By yourself? You stand no better chance than Madanach.
plugin.target: 殺我？你嗎？與邁德納奇相比，你毫無勝算。

plugin.source: But if you want to foolishly throw your life away, that's your choice.
plugin.target: 不過要是你想愚蠢的拋棄生命，那就是你自找的。

plugin.source: Sorry for leading you on, I really will bring something later.
plugin.target: 很抱歉誤導了你，晚點我真的會為你帶點東西的。

plugin.source: Sorry for continuously teasing you, I really will have something next time.
plugin.target: 很抱歉都在捉弄你，下次我真的會帶點東西的。

plugin.source: I never wanted you to be my friend anyway.
plugin.target: 我從未想過與你成為朋友。

plugin.source: I never wanted you to be my friend anyway.
plugin.target: 我從未想過與你成為朋友。

plugin.source: Nevermind. Take care, now.
No, I'm completely serious.
Fool. Now you'll be even easier to kill!
plugin.target: 蠢貨。現在殺你更加簡單了！

plugin.source: Plenty of fresh fish for ya.
I do not like fish.
I... see.
I'm buying a fish for Noster. He likes fish.
plugin.target: 我得為諾斯特買條魚。他喜歡吃魚。

plugin.source: That's kind of you.
A war veteran should be respected.
plugin.target: 歷經沙場的老兵理應得到尊重。
